pinyin: xī lán huā chǎo niú ròu
versionNote: The American take is a sweet brown glaze. The home-style version is lighter, with velvety beef and a savory oyster-soy sauce.
versionNoteZh: 美式做法是甜口的深色酱汁。家常版更清爽：牛肉上浆滑嫩，蚝油酱油汁咸鲜。
story: A favorite in Cantonese home kitchens and takeout menus alike. The difference between 'good' and 'soggy' comes down to two things: velveted beef, and broccoli that's blanched then flash-fried, never stewed.
storyZh: 广东家常厨房和外卖菜单上的常客。“好吃”和“软塌”的区别在于两件事：牛肉上浆，以及西兰花先焯后快炒、绝不炖煮。

ingredients.nameEn: flank steak (or sirloin), sliced thin against the grain
ingredients.note: Slicing against the grain is 80% of tender beef.
ingredients.noteZh: 逆纹切片占嫩牛肉的 80%。

ingredients.nameEn: cornstarch slurry (1 tsp starch + 2 tbsp water)

steps.text: Slice beef thinly against the grain. Marinate with soy, Shaoxing, and cornstarch; finish with 1 tsp oil to seal. Rest 10 minutes.
steps.textZh: 牛肉逆纹切薄片。用生抽、料酒、淀粉腌制，最后加 1 茶匙油封住。静置 10 分钟。
steps.zhHint: 牛肉逆纹切片，上浆腌10分钟

stateNote.visual: Beef coated in a glossy starchy glaze
stateNote.visualZh: 牛肉裹上一层有光泽的淀粉浆
stateNote.signal: Glaze clings evenly, no dry patches
stateNote.signalZh: 浆液均匀附着，无干斑

steps.tip: Freeze the beef 20 minutes first for easier thin slicing.
steps.tipZh: 先把牛肉冷冻 20 分钟，更容易切薄片。

steps.text: Blanch broccoli in boiling salted water 60-90 seconds, then shock in cold water. Drain well.
steps.textZh: 西兰花放入沸盐水焯 60-90 秒，再过冷水。充分沥干。

stateNote.visual: Broccoli turns bright green and is crisp-tender
stateNote.visualZh: 西兰花变翠绿，口感脆嫩
stateNote.signal: Stem pierces easily with a fork but florets still hold shape
stateNote.signalZh: 叉子能轻易扎透梗部，花朵仍保持形状

steps.tip: Shocking stops the cooking — this is what keeps it green and snappy.
steps.tipZh: 过冷水能停止加热——这是保持翠绿爽脆的关键。

steps.text: Mix sauce: oyster sauce + soy + cornstarch slurry in a small bowl.
steps.textZh: 小碗中调好碗汁：蚝油 + 生抽 + 水淀粉。

stateNote.visual: Slurry fully dissolved, sauce uniform
stateNote.visualZh: 淀粉完全溶解，碗汁均匀
stateNote.signal: No starch lumps at the bottom of the bowl
stateNote.signalZh: 碗底无淀粉结块

steps.text: Heat 1.5 tbsp oil in a wok over high until smoking lightly. Add beef in one layer; sear 1 minute, then stir-fry until 80% cooked. Remove.
steps.textZh: 锅中放 1.5 汤匙油，大火烧至微微冒烟。牛肉平铺入锅，煎 1 分钟，再翻炒至八成熟。盛出。

stateNote.visual: Beef sears brown on edges, still slightly pink inside
stateNote.visualZh: 牛肉边缘煎至棕褐，内部依然微粉
stateNote.signal: Beef releases from the pan easily (don't stir too early)
stateNote.signalZh: 牛肉能轻松从锅底脱离（别过早翻动）

steps.text: Add remaining oil + garlic + ginger; stir 15 seconds until fragrant. Return beef with any juices.
steps.textZh: 加入剩余油和蒜片姜片，爆香 15 秒。牛肉连汁回锅。

stateNote.visual: Garlic edges just begin to color
stateNote.visualZh: 蒜片边缘刚开始变色
stateNote.signal: Fragrant immediately
stateNote.signalZh: 香气立刻迸发

steps.text: Add broccoli, pour in the sauce. Toss rapidly 30-45 seconds until glossy and everything is coated.
steps.textZh: 下西兰花，倒入碗汁。快速翻炒 30-45 秒，直到汤汁光亮、裹住所有食材。

stateNote.visual: Sauce thickens to a glossy coat over beef and broccoli
stateNote.visualZh: 碗汁变浓，在牛肉和西兰花上形成光泽挂汁
stateNote.signal: Sauce clings, no puddle left in the pan
stateNote.signalZh: 汤汁挂住食材，锅底无积水

tips: Slicing against the grain + velveting = restaurant-tender beef at home.
Blanching the broccoli means the stir-fry is only 1 minute — nothing gets soggy.
Vegetarian? Swap beef for firm tofu (1:1) and use mushroom oyster sauce.
tipsZh: 逆纹切片 + 上浆 = 在家做出餐厅级嫩牛肉。
西兰花先焯水，炒制只需 1 分钟——什么都不会软塌。
素食？牛肉换成老豆腐（1:1），用菌菇蚝油。

regionZh: 全国家常（江南一带最爱）
versionNote: The restaurant version deep-fries the tofu first and uses a rich master stock. The family version sears it in a little oil and builds the classic hongshao sauce — light soy, dark soy, sugar, Shaoxing — at home in one pan.
versionNoteZh: 餐厅版先宽油炸豆腐再用老卤烧。家常版少油煎出香味，在一口锅里调出经典红烧汁——生抽、老抽、糖、绍兴酒。
story: 红烧 is the great home-cooking technique of eastern China: dark soy for color, sugar for shine, and a long, patient simmer. Braised tofu is the budget family's version of red-braised pork — the same glossy sauce, a fraction of the cost. In Jiangnan households it's often made with shiitake mushroom soaking water, which turns an ordinary block of tofu into something that tastes like a much longer story.
storyZh: 红烧是中国东部家庭烹饪的看家技法：老抽上色、糖提亮、文火慢煨。红烧豆腐就是普通家庭的红烧肉平替——一样的红亮酱汁，价格却只是零头。江南人家常用泡香菇的水来烧，让一块普通豆腐吃出满满的故事感。

ingredients.note: Firm holds its shape through the braise; silken will fall apart.
ingredients.noteZh: 老豆腐耐烧不散；嫩豆腐会碎。

ingredients.nameEn: dried shiitake mushrooms, soaked (reserve the soaking water)
ingredients.note: The soaking water replaces stock — this is the secret.
ingredients.noteZh: 泡菇水代替高汤——这就是秘诀。

ingredients.nameEn: scallions, white and green parts separated

ingredients.note: For color only — it's not the salty one.
ingredients.noteZh: 只用来上色——它不是咸味的来源。

ingredients.nameEn: sugar (rock sugar if you have it)
ingredients.note: Rock sugar gives the most beautiful gloss.
ingredients.noteZh: 冰糖的亮泽最漂亮。

ingredients.nameEn: cornstarch slurry (1 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water)

steps.text: Slice tofu into 1.5 cm thick rectangles. Drain on paper towels. Slice rehydrated shiitake (keep 200 ml of the soaking water).
steps.textZh: 豆腐切 1.5 厘米厚的块，放厨房纸上沥干。泡发的香菇切片（留 200 毫升泡菇水）。

stateNote.visual: Tofu surfaces look dry, shiitake plump and rehydrated
stateNote.visualZh: 豆腐表面干燥，香菇吸足水分、饱满
stateNote.signal: Tofu no longer weeps water
stateNote.signalZh: 豆腐不再渗水

steps.text: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high. Sear tofu in a single layer until golden on both sides. Remove.
steps.textZh: 锅中热油，中大火。豆腐单层煎至两面金黄后盛出。

stateNote.visual: Golden-brown crust forms; tofu feels springy when pressed
stateNote.visualZh: 金黄色脆皮形成；按压时豆腐有弹性
stateNote.signal: Tofu slides easily in the pan
stateNote.signalZh: 豆腐在锅中能轻松滑动

steps.text: Lower to medium. Add garlic, ginger, and shiitake slices. Stir 30 seconds until fragrant.
steps.textZh: 转中火，下蒜、姜和香菇片，翻炒 30 秒出香。

stateNote.visual: Shiitake edges start to brown; aroma turns nutty and deep
stateNote.visualZh: 香菇边缘开始金黄，香气变得浓郁深沉
stateNote.signal: Fragrant — before the garlic turns brown
stateNote.signalZh: 香气扑鼻——别等蒜片变焦

steps.text: Add light soy, dark soy, sugar, and Shaoxing wine. Stir 20 seconds — the sauce should darken and smell sweet-savory.
steps.textZh: 加入生抽、老抽、糖和料酒，翻炒 20 秒——酱汁变深，甜咸香扑鼻。

stateNote.visual: Sauce coats the pan in a deep reddish-brown, glossy sheen
stateNote.visualZh: 酱汁在锅底形成深红棕色的油亮涂层
stateNote.signal: Sugar has dissolved and sauce smells caramelized, not burnt
stateNote.signalZh: 糖已融化，酱汁有焦糖香而不糊

steps.text: Pour in the reserved shiitake water (200 ml). Return the tofu, bring to a simmer, and cook 6-8 minutes, spooning sauce over the tofu occasionally.
steps.textZh: 倒入预留的泡菇水（200 毫升）。放回豆腐，煮开后小火煨 6-8 分钟，期间不时把汤汁浇在豆腐上。

stateNote.visual: Tofu absorbs the red-brown sauce; sauce bubbles gently and reduces
stateNote.visualZh: 豆腐吸饱红棕色酱汁；汤汁微微冒泡收浓
stateNote.signal: Sauce has reduced by half and turns glossy
stateNote.signalZh: 汤汁收掉一半且变得油亮

steps.tip: Resist the urge to stir — a gentle spoon-over keeps the tofu intact.
steps.tipZh: 忍住别翻——用勺子浇汁保持豆腐完整。

steps.text: Add half the cornstarch slurry; swirl the pan to thicken. Add more slurry only if you want a heavier coat.
steps.textZh: 倒入一半水淀粉，晃动锅身让汤汁变稠。想要更浓的芡再补。

stateNote.visual: Sauce turns translucent and clings to tofu edges
stateNote.visualZh: 汤汁变半透明，挂在豆腐边缘
stateNote.signal: Sauce coats the back of a spoon without running off
stateNote.signalZh: 酱汁能挂在勺背而不滑落

steps.text: Off heat, scatter the green scallions. Serve over steamed rice.
steps.textZh: 关火，撒上葱花。配米饭吃。

stateNote.visual: Deep red-brown glaze, glossy tofu, fresh green scallions
stateNote.visualZh: 深红棕色酱汁、油亮的豆腐、翠绿葱花
stateNote.signal: Glaze looks lacquered — serve immediately
stateNote.signalZh: 酱汁如漆亮——立刻上桌

tips: The shiitake soaking water is the whole trick — it replaces stock with deep umami.
Dark soy is for color only; don't let anyone convince you to add more than a teaspoon.
Sear the tofu in a single layer; crowded tofu steams and loses its crust.
Leftover braised tofu tastes even better the next day — the sauce keeps soaking in.
tipsZh: 泡菇水是全部秘诀——它用浓郁的鲜味代替高汤。
老抽只负责上色；别超出一茶匙。
豆腐要单层煎；挤在一起会变成蒸豆腐。
剩的红烧豆腐隔夜更好吃——酱汁越浸越入味。

versionNote: Restaurant version velvet-fries the chicken in oil and flashes the cashews through hot oil for extra crunch. The family version sears both in the same pan with less oil — same silky chicken, same nutty finish.
versionNoteZh: 餐厅版先把鸡丁滑油、腰果过油炸得酥脆。家常版在同一口锅里少油煎炒——鸡丁一样嫩滑，腰果一样焦香。
story: Cashew chicken is what happens when Cantonese stir-fry meets a can of nuts — a dish that appears at family dinners and banquet tables alike. The home version is beloved for one reason: it's almost impossible to overcook into misery. The velveted chicken stays silky, the cashews add a toasty crunch, and the sauce is a simple savory-sweet glaze that children and adults agree on.
storyZh: 腰果鸡丁是粤式炒锅与一把坚果相遇的产物——既上得了家宴，也出得了餐厅。家常版受宠只有一个原因：它几乎不可能被炒砸。上浆的鸡丁滑嫩不柴，腰果带着焦香脆口，酱汁是简单的咸甜口，大人小孩都买账。

ingredients.nameEn: boneless chicken thighs, cut into 2 cm cubes
ingredients.note: Thighs stay juicy; breast works if velveted properly.
ingredients.noteZh: 鸡腿肉多汁；鸡胸上浆到位也可以。

ingredients.note: Raw, unsalted — you control the salt. Roasted work too, add at the very end.
ingredients.noteZh: 用原味生腰果——咸淡自己控。熟腰果也行，最后再放。

ingredients.note: Classic is cucumber + carrot for color; use whatever is crisp.
ingredients.noteZh: 经典搭配是黄瓜+胡萝卜配色；任何脆的蔬菜都行。

ingredients.nameEn: scallions, white part for the wok, green for garnish

steps.text: Velvet the chicken: mix with 1 tbsp soy, Shaoxing, white pepper, and 1 tbsp cornstarch. Rest 10 minutes.
steps.textZh: 上浆：鸡丁与 1 汤匙生抽、料酒、白胡椒和 1 汤匙淀粉拌匀，静置 10 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Chicken is coated in a thin, even starchy film
stateNote.visualZh: 鸡丁裹上一层薄而均匀的淀粉膜
stateNote.signal: Coating feels tacky, not dry or clumpy
stateNote.signalZh: 裹层有黏感，不干也不结块

steps.tip: Velveting is what keeps the chicken silky — see the term card.
steps.tipZh: 上浆是鸡丁滑嫩的秘诀——看术语卡片。

steps.text: In a small bowl mix the sauce: remaining 1/2 tbsp soy, oyster sauce, 1/2 cup water (125 ml), and 1 tbsp cornstarch.
steps.textZh: 调汁：小碗里放剩余半汤匙生抽、蚝油、半杯水（125 毫升）和 1 汤匙淀粉，搅匀。

stateNote.visual: Sauce is a smooth, uniform brown liquid, no lumps
stateNote.visualZh: 酱汁是顺滑均匀的棕色液体，没有结块
stateNote.signal: Cornstarch fully dissolved — shake if needed
stateNote.signalZh: 淀粉完全化开——不行就晃一晃

steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over medium. Toast cashews until golden and fragrant, about 2 minutes. Remove immediately.
steps.textZh: 锅中放 1 汤匙油，中火。腰果炒至金黄出香，约 2 分钟，立刻盛出。

stateNote.visual: Cashews turn pale golden and release a nutty aroma
stateNote.visualZh: 腰果变成浅金色，散发出坚果香
stateNote.signal: A few cashews show faint golden spots — they keep cooking off-heat, so pull them now
stateNote.signalZh: 部分腰果出现淡金色斑点——离火后还会继续熟，现在就要捞出

steps.tip: Cashews burn in seconds after they start coloring. When in doubt, take them out early.
steps.tipZh: 腰果一变色几秒内就会糊。拿不准就早一步盛出。

steps.text: Add remaining 1 tbsp oil to the wok, raise to high heat. Stir-fry the chicken in one layer until the exterior turns opaque and lightly golden, about 2-3 minutes.
steps.textZh: 锅中加剩余 1 汤匙油，转大火。鸡丁单层下锅翻炒至表面变白微金黄，约 2-3 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Chicken turns from pink to pale golden with a light crust
stateNote.visualZh: 鸡丁从粉色变成淡金色，带一层薄壳
stateNote.signal: No pink remains; edges just starting to brown
stateNote.signalZh: 看不到粉色，边缘刚开始上色

steps.tip: High heat is the point — you want sear, not steam. Crowding the pan steams it.
steps.tipZh: 大火是关键——要的是煎香不是蒸。一次别放太多。

steps.text: Add garlic, ginger, and scallion whites. Stir 30 seconds until fragrant. Add cucumber and carrot, stir-fry 1 minute.
steps.textZh: 下蒜末、姜末和葱白，炒 30 秒出香。加入黄瓜丁和胡萝卜丁，翻炒 1 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Vegetables turn glossy and bright, carrot slightly softened
stateNote.visualZh: 蔬菜变得油亮鲜艳，胡萝卜微微变软
stateNote.signal: Cucumber still crisp but warmed through
stateNote.signalZh: 黄瓜依然脆，但已热透

steps.text: Give the sauce bowl a stir (cornstarch settles!), pour it in. Toss quickly — the sauce should turn glossy and coat everything within 30 seconds.
steps.textZh: 先搅一下碗汁（淀粉会沉底！），倒入锅中快速翻炒——酱汁应在 30 秒内变得油亮并裹住所有食材。

stateNote.visual: Sauce turns from cloudy to glossy and clings to chicken and veggies
stateNote.visualZh: 酱汁从浑浊变油亮，挂在鸡丁和蔬菜上
stateNote.signal: Sauce coats the back of a spoon — thick enough
stateNote.signalZh: 酱汁能挂勺背——浓稠度刚好

steps.text: Off heat, fold in the toasted cashews and scallion greens. Serve immediately — cashews stay crunchiest this way.
steps.textZh: 关火，拌入炒香的腰果和葱花。趁热上桌——这样腰果最脆。

stateNote.visual: Glossy golden chicken, colorful veg, crunchy cashews on top
stateNote.visualZh: 油亮的金黄鸡丁、彩色蔬菜、表面脆腰果
stateNote.signal: Serve hot before the cashews soften
stateNote.signalZh: 趁腰果还没软立刻吃

tips: Raw cashews toast fast — pull them out the moment they smell nutty.
Always re-stir the sauce right before pouring; cornstarch sinks like a rock.
For extra crunch, add a handful of water chestnuts or celery at the veggie step.
This dish scales beautifully to a party: double everything, keep the high heat.
tipsZh: 生腰果熟得很快——一闻到坚果香就出锅。
倒汁前一定要再搅一次；淀粉沉底比石头还快。
想要更脆，蔬菜步骤可加一把马蹄丁或芹菜丁。
这道菜特别适合聚会：全部翻倍，大火不变。

titleEn: Chive and Egg Dumplings (韭菜鸡蛋饺)
versionNote: Family version makes the filling with scrambled eggs and chives — no pork. Restaurant version sometimes adds glass noodles or dried shrimp for extra texture.
versionNoteZh: 家常版用炒蛋和韭菜做馅，不加猪肉。餐厅版有时加粉丝或虾皮增加口感层次。
story: Chive and egg dumplings are the vegetarian corner of every Northern Chinese dumpling table. On New Year's Eve, one plate of these always sits next to the pork ones — the chives symbolize 'longevity' (jiu cai, a homophone for 'forever'), and the golden eggs bring luck. The trick is salting the chives first so the filling stays dry and easy to wrap.
storyZh: 韭菜鸡蛋饺是北方饺子桌上永远的一角素。除夕夜，猪肉饺子旁边总有一盘它——韭菜谐音“久财”，寓意长久，金黄的炒蛋寓意吉祥。秘诀是先把韭菜撒盐杀水，馅料保持干爽才好包。

ingredients.note: Regular chives are too thin — look for flat, wide garlic chives.
ingredients.noteZh: 普通小葱太细——要买宽叶的韭菜。

ingredients.note: Or buy ready-made dumpling wrappers to save time — about 50 wrappers needed.
ingredients.noteZh: 也可以直接买现成饺子皮省时间——大约需要 50 张。

ingredients.note: Soaked, chopped short. Adds a springy texture and soaks up egg juices.
ingredients.noteZh: 泡软切短。增加弹韧口感，还能吸收蛋汁。

steps.text: Make the dough: mix flour with about 200 ml warm water, knead into a smooth ball, cover and rest 30 minutes.
steps.textZh: 和面：面粉加约 200 毫升温水，揉成光滑面团，盖保鲜膜醒 30 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Dough is smooth, soft, and springs back when pressed
stateNote.visualZh: 面团光滑柔软，按压会回弹
stateNote.signal: No dry cracks on the surface
stateNote.signalZh: 表面没有干裂纹

steps.text: Scramble the eggs: heat 1 tbsp oil, pour in beaten eggs, stir until softly set, then chop into small pieces with the spatula. Let cool completely.
steps.textZh: 炒蛋：热 1 汤匙油，倒入蛋液炒至刚凝固，用锅铲切碎。彻底放凉。

stateNote.visual: Eggs are in small, soft curds — not browned
stateNote.visualZh: 蛋碎小块、柔软——没有炒黄
stateNote.signal: No raw liquid remains
stateNote.signalZh: 没有生蛋液残留

steps.text: Chop the chives into 5 mm pieces. Toss with 1/2 tsp salt and let sit 10 minutes, then gently squeeze out excess water — don't squeeze bone-dry.
steps.textZh: 韭菜切 5 毫米小段。加半茶匙盐拌匀，静置 10 分钟，然后轻轻挤掉多余水分——不要挤得太干。

stateNote.visual: Chives release a small pool of green-tinted water
stateNote.visualZh: 韭菜渗出一点淡绿色的水
stateNote.signal: Chives are wilted but still bright green
stateNote.signalZh: 韭菜变软但依然翠绿

steps.text: Combine cooled eggs, chives, optional glass noodles, ginger, sesame oil, and a pinch more salt. Mix gently until uniform — the filling should smell fresh and bright.
steps.textZh: 把放凉的鸡蛋、韭菜、可选粉丝、姜末、香油和少许盐拌在一起，轻轻拌匀——馅料应该闻起来清新鲜亮。

stateNote.visual: Golden egg and green chive are evenly distributed
stateNote.visualZh: 金黄蛋碎和绿韭菜分布均匀
stateNote.signal: No pooling liquid at the bottom of the bowl
stateNote.signalZh: 碗底没有积水

steps.text: Roll the dough into a long log, cut into 12 g pieces, flatten each into a disc, and roll out into thin round wrappers (about 8 cm across).
steps.textZh: 面团搓成长条，切成 12 克一个的小剂子，压扁后擀成约 8 厘米直径的薄圆皮。

stateNote.visual: Wrappers are even, thin at the edges, slightly thicker in the middle
stateNote.visualZh: 饺子皮厚薄均匀，边缘薄、中间略厚
stateNote.signal: You can faintly see your hand through the thin edge
stateNote.signalZh: 透过薄边缘能隐约看到手

steps.text: Fill each wrapper with a heaping teaspoon of filling, fold into a half-moon, and pinch the edge shut. Press out any trapped air.
steps.textZh: 每张皮放一满勺馅，对折成半月形，捏紧边缘。挤出里面的空气。

stateNote.visual: Dumplings are plump, sealed tightly, no filling leaking
stateNote.visualZh: 饺子饱满、封口严实，没有露馅
stateNote.signal: Seam holds firm when gently squeezed
stateNote.signalZh: 轻捏时封口不松开

steps.text: Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Add dumplings in batches, stir gently once, and cook until they float and the water boils again — then add 1/2 cup cold water. Repeat once more. Drain and serve with black vinegar.
steps.textZh: 大锅水烧开，分批下饺子，轻轻推一下防止粘连。煮到饺子浮起水再次沸腾——点入半杯凉水。再重复一次。捞出配镇江香醋食用。

stateNote.visual: Dumplings float to the surface and look slightly translucent
stateNote.visualZh: 饺子浮起，皮呈半透明状
stateNote.signal: Press a dumpling — it springs back (fully cooked)
stateNote.signalZh: 按压饺子——回弹说明熟了

tips: Salt the chives first — it's the difference between a dry, wrappable filling and a soggy mess.
Never mix the filling until the eggs are fully cool, or the chives will wilt and turn watery.
Ready-made wrappers work great: buy a pack, save an hour.
Freeze uncooked dumplings on a floured tray, then bag them — boil straight from frozen, add 2 minutes.
tipsZh: 韭菜先杀水——这是馅料干爽可包和湿塌一滩的区别。
鸡蛋必须彻底放凉才能拌馅，否则韭菜会被烫蔫出水。
现成饺子皮完全可行：买一包，省一小时。
生饺子可以铺面粉冷冻，冻硬后装袋——冷冻状态直接下锅，多煮 2 分钟。

versionNote: The family version is a one-pan braise: wings caramelized, then simmered in cola until the sauce turns into a glossy glaze. Restaurant versions add star anise and a splash of Shaoxing for depth.
versionNoteZh: 家常版一锅到底：鸡翅煎上色，用可乐焖煮到酱汁收成亮泽糖浆。餐厅版会加八角和一勺料酒增加层次。
story: Coke chicken wings is the dish that 90s Chinese kids begged their parents to make — because cola was a treat, and putting it in dinner felt like magic. The caramel from the coke glazes the wings a deep amber, sweet-salty, sticky and glossy. It's still the gateway dish for teaching teenagers to cook: hard to mess up, impossible to forget.
storyZh: 可乐鸡翅是 90 后孩子央求爸妈做的菜——因为可乐本身就是零食，放进菜里像变魔术。可乐的焦糖把鸡翅裹成深琥珀色，咸甜交织、黏稠油亮。它至今仍是教青少年做饭的入门菜：不容易翻车，吃过就忘不掉。

ingredients.note: Ask for wings already split. Pat completely dry before searing.
ingredients.noteZh: 买切好的翅中。下锅前一定擦干水分。

ingredients.note: Regular cola only — diet versions have no sugar to caramelize and taste thin.
ingredients.noteZh: 必须用原味可乐——无糖版没有糖分可焦化，味道寡淡。

steps.text: Pat the wings completely dry with paper towels. Score each wing once on both sides through the skin.
steps.textZh: 鸡翅用厨房纸彻底擦干。两面各划一刀，划到皮肉之间。

stateNote.visual: Wings are dry, with shallow diagonal cuts visible on both sides
stateNote.visualZh: 鸡翅表面干燥，两面可见浅浅的斜刀口
stateNote.signal: No water droplets on the skin
stateNote.signalZh: 皮上没有水珠

steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wide pan over medium-high. Sear wings skin-side down until golden, about 2-3 minutes per side. Don't crowd the pan — do two batches if needed.
steps.textZh: 平底锅放 1 汤匙油，中大火加热。鸡翅皮朝下煎至金黄，每面约 2-3 分钟。不要挤在一起——可以分两批。

stateNote.visual: Skin turns golden-brown and releases from the pan easily
stateNote.visualZh: 鸡皮变金黄，能轻松从锅底脱离
stateNote.signal: Edges are crispy and browned, not burnt
stateNote.signalZh: 边缘焦脆金黄，没有糊

steps.text: Add ginger, scallion whites, and Shaoxing wine. Stir 30 seconds until fragrant.
steps.textZh: 下姜片、葱段和料酒，翻炒 30 秒出香。

stateNote.visual: Ginger and scallion sizzle; wine evaporates with a puff of steam
stateNote.visualZh: 姜葱滋滋作响；料酒化成一团蒸汽
stateNote.signal: The raw alcohol smell is gone, replaced by a savory aroma
stateNote.signalZh: 生酒味消失，取而代之的是咸香

steps.text: Pour in the cola, light soy sauce, and oyster sauce (if using). The liquid should come about halfway up the wings. Bring to a boil, then reduce to medium-low.
steps.textZh: 倒入可乐、生抽和蚝油（如果用）。液体大约到鸡翅一半高度。大火烧开，转中小火。

stateNote.visual: Liquid bubbles vigorously, dark brown with cola foam
stateNote.visualZh: 汤汁翻滚冒泡，深棕色带可乐泡沫
stateNote.signal: Steam smells sweet and savory, not boozy
stateNote.signalZh: 蒸汽闻起来甜咸交织，没有酒味

steps.text: After 15 minutes, turn the wings and continue simmering until the sauce has reduced by half and coats the wings.
steps.textZh: 15 分钟后翻面，继续小火焖到汤汁收掉一半、能挂在鸡翅上。

stateNote.visual: Sauce is thick, glossy, and clings to the wings
stateNote.visualZh: 酱汁浓稠油亮，挂在鸡翅上
stateNote.signal: Run a spatula through the sauce — the trail holds for 2 seconds
stateNote.signalZh: 锅铲划过酱汁——划痕能保持 2 秒

steps.text: Turn the heat to high and stir constantly for 1 minute to glaze the wings. Sprinkle sesame seeds and serve hot.
steps.textZh: 转大火，不断翻动 1 分钟让鸡翅裹上糖浆。撒上白芝麻，趁热上桌。

stateNote.visual: Wings are deep amber with a sticky, glossy coat
stateNote.visualZh: 鸡翅呈深琥珀色，挂着黏稠亮泽的糖衣
stateNote.signal: Sauce barely clings — stop before it burns
stateNote.signalZh: 酱汁刚好能挂住——再收就糊了，立刻停

tips: Dry wings are the secret — wet wings steam instead of sear.
Don't use diet coke. The sugar is the entire sauce.
If the sauce gets too thick before the wings are tender, add 2 tbsp hot water and keep simmering.
This glaze also works beautifully on pork ribs or tofu puffs.
tipsZh: 鸡翅擦干是秘诀——带水下锅会变成蒸而不是煎。
不要用无糖可乐。糖就是整道菜的酱汁。
如果汤汁收太干而鸡翅还没软，加 2 汤匙热水继续焖。
这个糖汁做排骨或豆腐泡一样好吃。

titleEn: Cold Wood Ear Mushroom (凉拌木耳)
versionNote: Family version: quick toss of rehydrated wood ear with a garlicky vinegar dressing. Restaurant version may blanch briefly and add a touch of sesame oil finish for extra gloss.
versionNoteZh: 家庭版：泡发木耳直接拌蒜香醋汁。餐厅版会快速焯水后过冷，淋香油增加光泽。
story: Wood ear mushroom (木耳, mù ěr) is one of the most widely used ingredients in Chinese cooking — not for its flavor (it's nearly neutral), but for its extraordinary crunch. Found dried in Asian grocers, it rehydrates in warm water in under 10 minutes. The cold tossed salad version (凉拌) is a staple on every Chinese dinner table in summer: crisp, tangy, garlicky, and impossibly light. It is often served alongside heavier meat dishes as a palate-cleansing counterpoint.
storyZh: 木耳是中国厨房最普及的食材之一——不是为了它的味道（近乎中性），而是为了它那绝妙的脆爽口感。亚超干货区有售干木耳，温水泡发不到 10 分钟。夏日凉拌木耳是每个中国家庭餐桌上的常客：脆、酸、蒜香、极轻口，常与厚重的肉类菜肴搭配，起到清口解腻的作用。

ingredients.note: Will expand to about 150 g when rehydrated — a small amount goes a long way.
ingredients.noteZh: 泡发后约 150 克，少许即可。

ingredients.note: Skip for a milder version; add more for Sichuan heat.
ingredients.noteZh: 不吃辣可省；想吃辣多放。

steps.text: Place dried wood ear mushrooms in a bowl and cover with warm (not boiling) water. Let soak for 10–15 minutes until fully expanded and tender-crisp. Discard any tough core pieces. Rinse under cold water and tear or cut into bite-sized pieces if they are larger than a coin.
steps.textZh: 干木耳放入碗中，加温水（非沸水）没过。泡 10–15 分钟至完全膨胀、脆嫩。丢弃任何过硬的根部。冷水冲洗，较大的撕成一口大小。

stateNote.visual: Dried shriveled ears transform into dark, gelatinous, frilly sheets — roughly 8–10× their dry volume
stateNote.visualZh: 干瘪的木耳变成深色、胶质、边缘卷曲的片状，体积膨胀约 8–10 倍
stateNote.signal: Pieces are flexible, not brittle; no hard centers remain
stateNote.signalZh: 木耳柔韧不脆硬，中心无硬芯

steps.text: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add a pinch of salt. Blanch the rehydrated wood ear for exactly 30 seconds. Drain immediately and transfer to a bowl of ice water (or run under cold tap water) to shock and stop cooking.
steps.textZh: 锅中烧开水，加一撮盐。木耳入沸水焯 30 秒后立即捞出，投入冰水（或冷水）快速冷却，锁定脆感。

stateNote.visual: Wood ear turns a deeper, more glossy black; edges curl slightly from the heat
stateNote.visualZh: 木耳颜色更深、更油亮，边缘因受热微微卷曲
stateNote.signal: Immediately transfer to cold water — overcooking makes wood ear slimy
stateNote.signalZh: 立刻过冷——煮久会变黏

steps.text: Drain the shocked wood ear thoroughly. Squeeze gently with clean hands to remove excess water — this is critical, as leftover water will dilute the dressing. Transfer to a mixing bowl.
steps.textZh: 充分沥干木耳，用手轻捏挤出多余水分——这步很关键，多余水分会稀释酱汁。放入拌菜碗中。

stateNote.visual: No more water pooling at the bottom of the colander;木耳表面略干、有弹性
stateNote.visualZh: 滤网底部无水积存，木耳表面略干、有弹性
stateNote.signal: When pressed lightly between fingers, no water droplets emerge
stateNote.signalZh: 手指轻压无水渗出

steps.text: Add minced garlic, sliced scallions, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar, salt, and chili oil (if using). Toss gently until every piece is evenly coated. The dressing will be thin and glossy.
steps.textZh: 加入蒜末、葱花、米醋、生抽、香油、糖、盐和辣椒油，轻拌均匀。酱汁应稀薄油亮，包裹每一片木耳。

stateNote.visual: Wood ear pieces are glossy and dark, flecked with green scallion and minced garlic; a thin amber dressing pools at the bottom
stateNote.visualZh: 木耳片油亮深黑，点缀绿色葱花和蒜末，碗底有薄薄一层琥珀色酱汁
stateNote.signal: Every piece is coated; no dry or pale patches remain
stateNote.signalZh: 每片都裹上酱汁，无干涩空白处

steps.text: Let the dressed wood ear rest for 10 minutes at room temperature to allow the flavors to penetrate. Toss once more before serving. The dish is best served at cool room temperature — not ice-cold, not warm. Pairs beautifully with roasted meats or fried rice.
steps.textZh: 拌好的木耳室温静置 10 分钟入味。上桌前再拌一次。最佳食用温度：微凉（非冰镇）。与烤肉或炒饭绝配。

stateNote.visual: The dressing has been partially absorbed; the wood ear has taken on a slight translucency at the edges
stateNote.visualZh: 部分酱汁已被吸收，木耳边缘略呈半透明
stateNote.signal: The garlic aroma is mellowed; the vinegar bite has softened
stateNote.signalZh: 蒜味变柔和，醋的尖锐感减弱

tips: Do not soak wood ear in hot water — it makes the exterior mushy while the interior remains hard. Warm water (not hot) is the sweet spot.
Always blanch for just 30 seconds. Over-blanching destroys the signature crunch that makes this dish worth making.
Wood ear mushrooms have no strong flavor of their own — the dish relies entirely on the dressing. Make the dressing bold: extra garlic, a good splash of vinegar.
Leftover dressed wood ear keeps in the refrigerator for up to 2 days. The crunch softens slightly but the flavor deepens.
tipsZh: 千万别用热水泡——外烂内生。温水是最优解。
焯水严格 30 秒。煮久会毁掉木耳的标志性脆感。
木耳本身味淡——全靠酱汁撑场。酱汁要做足：多蒜、多醋。
拌好的木耳冷藏可保存 2 天。脆感略降，但味道更融合。

titleEn: Cucumber Scrambled Eggs Recipe | Quick 15-Min Chinese Home Cooking
versionNote: Family version uses gentle heat and minimal seasoning to highlight the fresh, cool crunch of cucumber and tender eggs — no cornstarch, no stock, no MSG.
versionNoteZh: 家常版用小火慢炒，少盐少酱，突出黄瓜的清脆与鸡蛋的嫩滑，不加淀粉、高汤或味精。
story: A humble summer staple in Beijing hutongs, this dish appears on dinner tables when cucumbers are crisp and abundant. Grandmothers teach children to salt cucumbers first — not to squeeze out water, but to draw out their natural sweetness and stabilize texture during stir-frying.
storyZh: 这是北京胡同人家夏日餐桌上的朴素常客。黄瓜应季脆嫩时，家家户户都做这道菜。老辈人教孩子先用盐轻拌黄瓜——不是为了挤水，而是激发其天然甘甜，并稳定炒制时的口感。

ingredients.note: Use English or Persian cucumber for low-seed, firm flesh; avoid hothouse varieties with watery centers.
ingredients.noteZh: 推荐用英国黄瓜或波斯黄瓜，籽少肉紧；避免温室大棚黄瓜（水分过多）。

ingredients.note: Use a balanced, mild light soy sauce (e.g., Pearl River Bridge or Lee Kum Kee Premium).
ingredients.noteZh: 选用咸鲜均衡的生抽（如李锦记精选生抽或珠江桥牌）。

ingredients.note: Toasted sesame oil only — added at the end for aroma.
ingredients.noteZh: 仅限焙炒芝麻油，出锅前淋入增香。

steps.text: Thinly slice cucumber (¼ cm thick) on diagonal. Toss with 2 g (¼ tsp) fine sea salt and let sit 5 minutes. Gently pat dry with paper towel — do not rinse or squeeze.
steps.textZh: 黄瓜斜刀切薄片（约¼厘米厚），加2克（¼茶匙）细海盐拌匀，静置5分钟。用厨房纸轻轻拍干表面水分——不可冲洗，不可用力挤。

stateNote.visual: Cucumber slices look slightly translucent and lightly damp, not dripping wet.
stateNote.visualZh: 黄瓜片略显半透明，表面微潮但不滴水。
stateNote.signal: Surface moisture beads but no pooling liquid remains.
stateNote.signalZh: 表面有水珠凝结，但无积水。

steps.tip: Salting draws out excess water *and* enhances natural sweetness — skipping this step leads to soggy eggs.
steps.tipZh: 盐腌既去多余水分，又激发甜味；省略此步会导致鸡蛋湿软。

steps.text: Whisk eggs with 10 ml (2 tsp) water until just combined — no froth. Season lightly with white pepper (optional).
steps.textZh: 鸡蛋加10毫升（2茶匙）清水搅打至刚融合即可，勿起泡；可酌加少许白胡椒粉提味。

stateNote.visual: Egg mixture is pale yellow and homogenous, with no streaks or foam.
stateNote.visualZh: 蛋液呈浅黄色，均匀无条纹、无泡沫。
stateNote.signal: No visible air bubbles or separated whites.
stateNote.signalZh: 无明显气泡或蛋白分离。

steps.text: Heat wok over medium-high heat until a drop of water sizzles and evaporates instantly. Add 10 g (2 tsp) neutral oil (e.g., canola or peanut). Swirl to coat.
steps.textZh: 旺火烧热炒锅，滴一滴水能‘滋啦’爆开即达温度。倒入10克（2茶匙）无味油（如菜籽油或花生油），旋转润锅。

stateNote.visual: Oil shimmers faintly with thin, even ripples.
stateNote.visualZh: 油面泛起细微均匀涟漪，略有光泽。
stateNote.signal: Water droplet dances and vanishes in <1 second.
stateNote.signalZh: 水滴入锅即弹跳并1秒内汽化。

steps.text: Pour in egg mixture. Let sit undisturbed 5 seconds, then gently push from edges toward center with spatula as curds form. Stop cooking when eggs are ~90% set — still slightly glossy and soft.
steps.textZh: 倒入蛋液，静置5秒，待边缘初凝后，用锅铲从四周向中心轻推成块；蛋液约九分熟时即停火——仍带微光、质地柔嫩。
steps.zhHint: 蛋液初凝即推，九分熟即出锅

stateNote.visual: Eggs form large, soft curds with visible sheen; no browning or dry edges.
stateNote.visualZh: 蛋块大而柔软，表面有光泽；无焦边、无褐斑。
stateNote.signal: Edges lift cleanly from wok; center remains slightly runny.
stateNote.signalZh: 边缘自然离锅；中心仍略带湿润。

steps.text: Transfer eggs to a plate. Wipe wok clean. Reheat over medium heat, add remaining 5 g (1 tsp) oil, then add cucumber. Stir-fry 60 seconds until just warmed through and bright green. Return eggs, drizzle with light soy sauce and sesame oil. Toss gently 10 seconds and serve immediately.
steps.textZh: 将蛋盛出备用。擦净炒锅，中火加热，加余下5克（1茶匙）油，下黄瓜片快炒60秒至断生、翠绿明亮。倒回鸡蛋，淋入生抽和香油，轻翻10秒即出锅。
steps.zhHint: 黄瓜快炒断生，回锅轻拌即上

stateNote.visual: Cucumber retains vibrant green color and crisp-tender bite; eggs remain moist and separate.
stateNote.visualZh: 黄瓜翠绿鲜亮、脆嫩爽口；蛋块湿润分明，不粘连。
stateNote.signal: Cucumber emits fresh, grassy aroma; no steam plume or darkening.
stateNote.signalZh: 散发清新青草香；无大量蒸汽或颜色变暗。

tips: Use cold eggs straight from the fridge — they set more evenly and resist overcooking.
Never add salt directly to raw egg mixture; it breaks down proteins and makes eggs rubbery.
Resist the urge to over-stir eggs — gentle folding preserves tenderness.
tipsZh: 鸡蛋用冷藏状态直接打散——受热更均匀，不易老硬。
生蛋液中切勿直接加盐，会破坏蛋白质结构，导致蛋质变韧。
炒蛋时切忌反复翻搅，轻柔推叠才能保持嫩滑。

versionNote: Restaurant version deep-fries the beans until wrinkled, then tosses with preserved mustard greens (suimiyacai). The family version pan-fries them in less oil — same blistered, savory result with far less fuss.
versionNoteZh: 餐厅版把四季豆油炸到起皱，再配碎米芽菜翻炒。家常版用更少的油煎炒——同样的虎皮褶皱和咸香，但省事得多。
story: Dry-fried green beans is the Sichuan dish that converts people who 'don't like vegetables'. The beans are blistered in hot oil until their skins wrinkle and turn sweet, then tossed with garlic, chilies, and the salty pop of preserved mustard greens. It's the vegetable equivalent of a perfectly seared steak — all surface, all flavor.
storyZh: 干煸四季豆是让“不爱吃蔬菜”的人改观的川菜。豆角在热油里煎到表皮起皱变甜，再配蒜末、干辣椒和咸鲜的芽菜碎翻炒。它是蔬菜界的完美煎牛排——全是表面焦香，全是风味。

ingredients.nameEn: green beans (haricot verts or Chinese long beans)
ingredients.note: Trim ends and pull off the strings. Pat very dry before frying.
ingredients.noteZh: 去头尾撕掉筋。下锅前一定擦干。

ingredients.nameEn: preserved mustard greens (suimiyacai / 碎米芽菜)
ingredients.note: The umami backbone. Substitutes: finely chopped pickled mustard or 1 tbsp doubanjiang.
ingredients.noteZh: 咸鲜的灵魂。替代：剁碎的大头菜，或 1 汤匙郫县豆瓣酱。

ingredients.nameEn: dried red chilies, cut into 1 cm pieces
ingredients.note: Use fewer seeds for less heat — or remove seeds entirely for aroma only.
ingredients.noteZh: 想少辣就减少辣椒籽——或者完全去籽只取香气。

steps.text: Trim the beans and pat them completely dry — water in the oil causes dangerous splatter and prevents blistering.
steps.textZh: 四季豆去头尾、撕筋，彻底擦干——带水下油会溅油，也无法起虎皮。

stateNote.visual: Beans are dry, bright green, with stems trimmed flush
stateNote.visualZh: 豆角干爽翠绿，两头修剪平整
stateNote.signal: No water droplets on the surface
stateNote.signalZh: 表面没有水珠

steps.text: Heat oil in a wok over medium-high. Add the beans in one layer and pan-fry, turning occasionally, until the skins blister and wrinkle, about 5-6 minutes. Remove and drain.
steps.textZh: 锅中放油，中大火加热。豆角单层下锅，不时翻动，煎到表皮起皱起泡，约 5-6 分钟。盛出沥油。

stateNote.visual: Bean skins are blistered, wrinkled, and golden-green in spots
stateNote.visualZh: 豆角皮起泡起皱，部分呈金黄绿色
stateNote.signal: Beans bend easily but still have structure — not limp
stateNote.signalZh: 豆角可以轻松弯折但仍挺括——不是软塌塌

steps.text: If using pork, add it to the wok now and stir-fry until it turns opaque and starts to brown, about 2 minutes.
steps.textZh: 如果用肉末，现在下锅，炒到变色微焦，约 2 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Pork turns from pink to pale brown, releasing fat
stateNote.visualZh: 肉末从粉色变浅褐，开始出油
stateNote.signal: Pork is crumbly with browned edges
stateNote.signalZh: 肉末松散，边缘微焦

steps.text: Lower heat to medium. Add garlic, dried chilies, and Sichuan peppercorns. Stir 20 seconds until fragrant — don't let the chilies burn black.
steps.textZh: 转中火。下蒜末、干辣椒段和花椒，翻炒 20 秒出香——别把辣椒炒糊发黑。

stateNote.visual: Chilies turn glossy and darker red; oil takes on a reddish tint
stateNote.visualZh: 辣椒变油亮深红，油色泛红
stateNote.signal: Sharp, spicy aroma — before the chilies smoke
stateNote.signalZh: 尖锐的香辣味——在辣椒冒烟之前

steps.text: Add the preserved greens and stir-fry 30 seconds to toast them.
steps.textZh: 下碎米芽菜，翻炒 30 秒炒出干香。

stateNote.visual: Preserved greens darken slightly and smell toasty
stateNote.visualZh: 芽菜颜色略深，散发干香
stateNote.signal: Aroma is deeply savory — like fried bacon bits
stateNote.signalZh: 香气浓郁咸鲜——像炒过的培根碎

steps.text: Return the beans to the wok. Add soy sauce and sugar, toss everything over high heat for 30 seconds until the beans are coated and glistening. Serve immediately.
steps.textZh: 把豆角倒回锅中，加生抽和糖，大火翻炒 30 秒让豆角裹匀酱汁、油亮发光。立即上桌。

stateNote.visual: Beans are glossy, coated in a thin savory glaze, with chili flecks
stateNote.visualZh: 豆角油亮，裹着薄薄一层咸鲜酱汁，点缀辣椒碎
stateNote.signal: No raw soy smell — everything is piping hot
stateNote.signalZh: 没有生酱油味——全部热透

tips: Blistering is the point — wrinkled skins turn sweet and absorb seasoning. Undercooked beans are chewy.
Keep the beans moving so they brown evenly instead of charring in spots.
Ya cai is worth hunting for at an Asian grocer — it's the salty pop that makes this dish.
If beans start to smoke, drop the heat: oil smoke ruins the flavor.
tipsZh: 起皱才是关键——皱皮会变甜并吸收调味。没煎透的豆角是韧的。
保持翻动让豆角上色均匀，避免局部焦黑。
碎米芽菜值得去亚超找——它是这道菜咸鲜的爆点。
豆角开始冒烟就转小火：油烟的糊味会毁掉整道菜。

versionNote: Restaurant version flings rice in a screaming-hot wok with separate scrambled egg ribbons. Home version is more forgiving — same flavor, easier technique.
versionNoteZh: 餐厅版用猛火炒饭、蛋液单独滑成蛋丝。家常版容错更高——同样的味道，更简单的技法。
story: The ultimate leftover dish: day-old rice + egg + whatever's in the fridge. Every Chinese household has a version. The two rules: cold rice, and don't stir too much.
storyZh: 终极剩饭料理：隔夜饭 + 鸡蛋 + 冰箱里随便什么。每个中国家庭都有自己的版本。两条铁律：用冷饭，别炒太狠。

ingredients.note: Fresh rice is too sticky — spread it out and fridge it 1 hour if needed.
ingredients.noteZh: 新鲜米饭太黏——需要的话摊开冷藏 1 小时。

ingredients.nameEn: optional: peas, ham, char siu, or lap cheong

steps.text: Break up the cold rice with your hands so there are no clumps. This is the single most important step.
steps.textZh: 用手把冷饭搓散，确保没有结块。这是最重要的一步。

stateNote.visual: Every grain is separate; no big lumps
stateNote.visualZh: 米粒颗颗分明，没有大块结团
stateNote.signal: Rice feels dry and loose
stateNote.signalZh: 米饭手感干爽松散

steps.text: Beat the eggs with the salt. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over medium-high. Add eggs and scramble until just set, then push to one side.
steps.textZh: 鸡蛋加盐打散。锅中放 1 汤匙油，中大火加热。倒入蛋液炒至刚刚凝固，推到一边。

stateNote.visual: Eggs softly set, still glossy
stateNote.visualZh: 鸡蛋刚刚凝固，依然有光泽
stateNote.signal: No raw liquid; curds still moist
stateNote.signalZh: 没有生蛋液；蛋块依然湿润

steps.text: Add the white scallion parts and any optional add-ins (ham, peas). Stir-fry 30 seconds.
steps.textZh: 下葱白部分和可选配料（火腿、豌豆）。翻炒 30 秒。

stateNote.visual: Scallion whites soften and release aroma
stateNote.visualZh: 葱白变软并释放香气
stateNote.signal: Fragrant, edges barely browning
stateNote.signalZh: 香气四溢，边缘微微上色

steps.text: Add the rice and the remaining 1 tbsp oil. Toss and press gently with the spatula to coat every grain — don't mash.
steps.textZh: 下米饭和剩余 1 汤匙油。用锅铲轻轻翻拌按压，让每粒米都裹上油——不要压碎。

stateNote.visual: Rice turns from white to glossy and evenly oiled
stateNote.visualZh: 米饭从白色变得油亮，裹油均匀
stateNote.signal: Grains start to 'dance' and jump slightly in the pan
stateNote.signalZh: 米粒开始“跳舞”，在锅里微微跳动

steps.text: Push rice to one side, pour soy sauce into the empty side, let it sizzle 5 seconds, then fold through. (This 'wok-ting' the soy removes raw sauce taste.)
steps.textZh: 把米饭推到一边，在空处倒入生抽，让其滋啦 5 秒再翻拌均匀。（这种“炝酱油”能去掉生酱味。）

stateNote.visual: Soy sizzles immediately and smells toasty
stateNote.visualZh: 酱油立刻滋啦作响，散发焦香
stateNote.signal: Steam smells roasted, not raw-soy
stateNote.signalZh: 蒸汽闻起来是焦香，而不是生酱油味

steps.text: Fold in the green scallions. Serve immediately.
steps.textZh: 拌入葱花。立即出锅。

stateNote.visual: Rice is hot, glossy, and every grain separate
stateNote.visualZh: 米饭热透油亮，粒粒分明
stateNote.signal: Each grain separate, steam rising
stateNote.signalZh: 米粒颗颗分离，热气升腾

tips: Cold rice is non-negotiable — fresh rice turns to paste.
Don't over-stir; let the rice hit the pan and toss instead of mashing.
Lap cheong (Chinese sausage) + a few drops of sesame oil at the end = instant upgrade.
tipsZh: 冷饭是硬性要求——新鲜米饭会炒成糊。
别过度翻炒；让米饭落锅后颠勺翻动，而不是压捣。
加腊肠 + 出锅前几滴香油 = 立刻升级。

titleEn: Garlic Chives Scrambled Eggs Recipe | Chinese Scrambled Eggs with Chives
versionNote: True Shandong style: no garlic or ginger — just chives, eggs, and a whisper of light soy. The chives must be freshly cut, never pre-chopped, to preserve their pungent-sweet aroma.
versionNoteZh: 地道山东做法：不放蒜姜，仅用韭菜、鸡蛋与微量生抽。韭菜须现割现切，不可提前切好，以锁住辛香甘甜之气。
story: In Shandong’s farming villages, this dish marks the first warm days of spring — when young garlic chives emerge from thawing soil. Families harvest them at dawn, stir-fry within hours, and serve with steamed millet rice. It’s believed the sharp aroma ‘opens the liver’ and wakes the body after winter.
storyZh: 在山东乡村，这道菜是春日初暖的信使——当嫩韭破土而出，家家清晨采割，数小时内快炒上桌，配小米饭同食。民间认为其辛香之气可‘疏肝醒神’，助人驱散冬寒。

ingredients.amountUS: 2 loosely packed cups, cut into 4-cm lengths
ingredients.note: Look for deep green, stiff stalks with tight buds — avoid yellowing or limp leaves. Substitution: 120 g leek greens (top ⅔ only) + 1 tsp minced scallion root.
ingredients.noteZh: 选深绿挺直、花苞紧实者；避黄叶萎蔫。替代：120克韭葱青叶（仅上三分之二）+ 1茶匙葱根末。

ingredients.note: Use a light, aromatic soy sauce — not dark or thick.
ingredients.noteZh: 选清香型生抽，非浓色或浓稠款。

ingredients.note: Canola, grapeseed, or refined peanut oil — high smoke point essential.
ingredients.noteZh: 菜籽油、葡萄籽油或精炼花生油——必须高烟点。

steps.text: Rinse chives under cold water, shake off excess, and pat dry thoroughly. Cut into 4-cm lengths on diagonal — keep white and green parts together.
steps.textZh: 韭菜冷水冲洗，甩干后用厨房纸彻底拍干。斜刀切成4厘米段，白绿部分保持相连。

stateNote.visual: Chives lie flat and dry, with no clinging water droplets.
stateNote.visualZh: 韭菜平铺干燥，无附着水珠。
stateNote.signal: Leaves feel crisp and snap when bent gently.
stateNote.signalZh: 叶片脆嫩，轻弯即断。

steps.text: Whisk eggs with 15 ml (1 tbsp) water and 1 g (⅛ tsp) fine sea salt until just blended — no bubbles. Set aside.
steps.textZh: 鸡蛋加15毫升（1汤匙）清水与1克（⅛茶匙）细盐，搅打至刚融合（无泡沫），静置备用。

stateNote.visual: Mixture is uniform pale yellow with no streaks or air pockets.
stateNote.visualZh: 蛋液均匀浅黄，无条纹、无气泡。
stateNote.signal: Lifts smoothly off whisk without dripping or stringing.
stateNote.signalZh: 离筷顺滑，无滴落或拉丝。

steps.text: Heat wok over high heat until smoking lightly. Add oil and swirl — it should shimmer immediately.
steps.textZh: 大火烧锅至微冒青烟，下油并快速旋锅——油面即刻泛光。

stateNote.visual: Thin blue-gray smoke rises from wok surface; oil flows like liquid glass.
stateNote.visualZh: 锅面升起淡青灰色薄烟；油如流质玻璃般顺滑流动。
stateNote.signal: A chopstick tip held 2 cm above oil sizzles steadily.
stateNote.signalZh: 筷子尖距油面2厘米处持续发出嘶嘶声。

steps.text: Pour in egg mixture. Let sit 3 seconds, then stir vigorously with spatula in figure-8 motion until eggs form small, fluffy curds — about 45 seconds. Transfer to plate while still slightly moist.
steps.textZh: 倒入蛋液，静置3秒，随即用锅铲以‘8’字形猛力划炒，至蛋成细嫩蓬松小块（约45秒）。趁尚湿润盛出。

stateNote.visual: Curds are golden-yellow, airy, and separate — no browning or greasy pooling.
stateNote.visualZh: 蛋块金黄蓬松、粒粒分明，无褐斑、无浮油。
stateNote.signal: Eggs release easily from wok with audible ‘shush’ sound.
stateNote.signalZh: 蛋块离锅时发出清晰‘唰’声。

steps.text: Return wok to high heat. Add chives and stir-fry 30 seconds until fragrant and edges turn vivid green. Immediately return eggs, add light soy sauce, and toss 10 seconds — chives should remain crisp and bright. Serve hot.
steps.textZh: 锅重烧至旺火，下韭菜大火快炒30秒至辛香扑鼻、叶缘转鲜绿。立刻倒入鸡蛋，淋入生抽，轻翻10秒即出锅——韭菜须脆嫩翠亮。
steps.zhHint: 韭菜快炒断生，回蛋轻拌即盛

stateNote.visual: Chives glow emerald-green; eggs stay fluffy and cling lightly to stems.
stateNote.visualZh: 韭菜翠如翡翠；蛋块蓬松，轻裹韭茎。
stateNote.signal: Sharp, garlicky aroma fills the kitchen — no bitterness or burnt smell.
stateNote.signalZh: 满屋辛香蒜气——无苦涩或焦糊味。

tips: Cut chives right before cooking — their volatile oils oxidize fast and lose potency.
Add soy sauce *after* returning eggs — adding it earlier makes chives wilt and dulls color.
Use a well-seasoned carbon-steel wok or heavy nonstick pan — aluminum reacts with chive sulfur compounds and causes gray discoloration.
tipsZh: 韭菜务必临炒前切，其挥发性精油氧化极快，香气易散失。
生抽要在回锅后淋入——过早加入会使韭菜萎软、色泽黯淡。
务必用熟铁锅或厚重不粘锅；铝锅遇韭菜硫化物易发灰变色。

versionNote: Quick stir-fry at high heat — the garlic gets fragrant in seconds, and the romaine stays crisp-tender with a slight char.
versionNoteZh: 大火快炒——蒜香几秒出，油麦菜保持脆嫩，边缘微焦。
story: Romaine lettuce is an unlikely star in Chinese cooking — most Westerners toss it into salads. But in China, its sturdy ribs and slightly bitter leaves hold up beautifully to high-heat stir-frying. Paired with a generous amount of garlic, it becomes one of the fastest and most reliable weeknight greens on the table.
storyZh: 油麦菜在中式烹饪中是个异类——大多数西方人把它扔进沙拉。但在中国，它坚实的菜帮和微苦的叶片在高温快炒下表现极佳。配上大量蒜蓉，成为工作日餐桌上最快最可靠的绿叶菜之一。

ingredients.note: If you can't find romaine, use choy sum or baby bok choy as substitutes — they'll change the flavor slightly but keep the texture.
ingredients.noteZh: 买不到油麦菜可用菜心或小白菜替代——风味略变但口感相近。

steps.text: Trim the woody base of the romaine, then cut into 5 cm (2-inch) lengths. Separate leaves if they're large. Wash and spin dry — wet leaves will steam instead of stir-fry.
steps.textZh: 削去油麦菜根部老硬部分，切成 5 厘米段。大叶撕开。洗净沥干——带水的叶子会蒸而不是炒。

stateNote.visual: Cut surfaces are pale green and firm; leaves are perky, not wilted
stateNote.visualZh: 切口淡绿结实，叶片挺立不萎蔫
stateNote.signal: Leaves should feel dry to the touch — pat with a towel if needed
stateNote.signalZh: 叶片摸起来是干的——必要时用厨房纸吸干

steps.text: Slice garlic thinly — not minced. Thin slices release aroma more evenly and don't burn as easily as minced garlic.
steps.textZh: 大蒜切薄片——不是蒜末。薄片受热均匀、不易焦。

steps.text: Heat oil in a wok over high heat until a drop of water sizzles on contact. Add garlic and swirl for 5-8 seconds until fragrant.
steps.textZh: 大火热锅至滴水滴入立刻滋滋作响。下蒜片快速翻炒 5-8 秒至出香。

stateNote.visual: Garlic edges turn pale gold and the kitchen fills with aroma
stateNote.visualZh: 蒜片边缘微金，厨房充满蒜香
stateNote.signal: Garlic is aromatic but NOT brown — if it browns, start over with fresh oil
stateNote.signalZh: 蒜香但**不发黄**——如果变黄就换油重来

steps.tip: High heat is essential. Low heat = soggy garlic and steamed lettuce.
steps.tipZh: 大火是关键。火小了→蒜软烂、叶子变蒸。

steps.text: Add romaine immediately. Toss constantly for 60-90 seconds. The leaves should wilt just enough to coat in oil but still retain crunch.
steps.textZh: 立刻下油麦菜。不停颠炒 60-90 秒。叶片微微塌软、裹上油但依然脆。

stateNote.visual: Leaves darken to a deeper green, edges curl slightly, but stems remain opaque and crisp
stateNote.visualZh: 叶片颜色变深绿，边缘微卷，但菜帮仍不透明且脆
stateNote.signal: Stems are still rigid when you bite — if they bend, you've overcooked
stateNote.signalZh: 咬下去菜帮仍然硬挺——如果弯了说明炒过头了

steps.text: Sprinkle salt and sugar (if using) over the greens. Drizzle soy sauce around the edge of the wok (not directly on the leaves) for even distribution.
steps.textZh: 撒盐和糖。沿锅边淋入生抽——不要直接浇在菜上，让热锅激发酱香。

stateNote.visual: Soy sauce hits the hot wok and sizzles, releasing a toasted aroma
stateNote.visualZh: 生抽碰到热锅立刻滋滋作响，释放焦香
stateNote.signal: Aroma shifts from raw garlic to toasted, savory
stateNote.signalZh: 香气从生蒜转为焦香咸鲜

steps.text: Toss one final time for 10 seconds. Plate immediately — romaine continues cooking from residual heat.
steps.textZh: 再颠炒 10 秒。立刻装盘——余温会继续烹饪。

tips: Romaine lettuce has a naturally bitter edge — that's a feature, not a bug. It balances the salty garlic sauce beautifully.
Do not cover the wok at any point — trapped steam makes romaine slimy.
If your romaine is very large, trim the bottom 2 cm — that's the woody, inedible part.
For extra umami, add a pinch of chicken powder (or vegetarian mushroom seasoning) at the end.
tipsZh: 油麦菜自带微苦——这是亮点，不是缺点。和咸香蒜蓉正好平衡。
全程不要盖锅盖——蒸汽会让油麦菜变软塌。
如果油麦菜很大棵，切掉底部 2 厘米——那是木质化、不能吃的部分。
想要更鲜：出锅前加一撮鸡精（或素食菌菇粉）。

versionNote: Restaurant version velvet-fries the beef in warm oil (slow-oil method). The family version sears marinated beef over high heat in one pan — the secret is cutting against the grain and not overcooking.
versionNoteZh: 餐厅版用温油滑牛肉。家常版把腌好的牛肉直接大火快煎——秘诀是逆纹切肉、别炒过头。
story: 青椒牛柳 is the weekday beef dish of northern Chinese cities: tender strips of beef against the sharp, fresh bite of green pepper. It exists to solve the two great weeknight problems — beef that turns to rubber, and dinners that take an hour. Velvet the meat, heat the pan until it whispers, and the whole thing is done before the rice cooker beeps.
storyZh: 青椒牛柳是北方城市工作日晚上的牛肉担当：嫩牛肉条遇上青椒的爽脆微辣。它专治两大工作日难题——一炒就老的牛肉，和一做就一小时的家常饭。把肉上浆、把锅烧到微冒烟，电饭煲还没响，这道菜就出锅了。

ingredients.nameEn: beef sirloin or flank, thinly sliced against the grain
ingredients.note: Slicing against the grain is the #1 tenderness trick.
ingredients.noteZh: 逆纹切是嫩肉的第一秘诀。

ingredients.nameEn: green bell peppers, cut into strips

ingredients.note: The 'velvet beef at home' trick — 15 min, then rinse. Optional.
ingredients.noteZh: 在家嫩化牛肉的小妙招——腌 15 分钟后冲掉。可选。

steps.text: Slice beef thinly against the grain. Velvet: mix with 1 tbsp soy, Shaoxing, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and (optional) baking soda. Rest 15 minutes.
steps.textZh: 牛肉逆纹切薄片。上浆：与 1 汤匙生抽、料酒、1 汤匙淀粉和（可选）小苏打拌匀，静置 15 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Beef strips are evenly coated, slightly sticky
stateNote.visualZh: 牛肉条裹料均匀，微微发黏
stateNote.signal: Marinade absorbed; no pooled liquid at the bottom
stateNote.signalZh: 料汁被吸收，碗底无积液

steps.tip: If using baking soda, rinse the beef quickly and re-pad dry before cooking.
steps.tipZh: 用了小苏打的话，下锅前快速冲洗并重新擦干。

steps.text: In a small bowl mix: remaining 1/2 tbsp soy, oyster sauce, black pepper, 1/2 cup water (125 ml), 1 tbsp cornstarch.
steps.textZh: 调碗汁：剩余半汤匙生抽、蚝油、黑胡椒、半杯水（125 毫升）、1 汤匙淀粉，搅匀。

stateNote.visual: Uniform dark-brown sauce, cornstarch dissolved
stateNote.visualZh: 均匀的深棕色酱汁，淀粉化开
stateNote.signal: No lumps at the bottom
stateNote.signalZh: 碗底无结块

steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok until it just starts to shimmer (about 30 seconds over high). Add beef in one layer — let it sear 30 seconds before moving it.
steps.textZh: 锅中放 2 汤匙油，大火烧到微微泛光（约 30 秒）。牛肉单层下锅——先让它煎 30 秒再翻动。

stateNote.visual: Oil shimmers; beef edges brown within seconds of contact
stateNote.visualZh: 油面泛光；牛肉接触锅面后边缘几秒内上色
stateNote.signal: Beef releases from the pan — that's the sear, now toss
stateNote.signalZh: 牛肉能离锅了——煎到位了，现在开始翻

steps.tip: Leave the beef alone for 30 seconds. Moving it too early = gray, rubbery beef.
steps.tipZh: 前 30 秒别碰它。翻太早 = 灰白橡皮牛肉。

steps.text: Stir-fry until beef is about 80% cooked (mostly brown, tiny pink center), about 1 minute. Remove to a plate.
steps.textZh: 翻炒至牛肉约八成熟（大部分变棕，中心一点粉色），约 1 分钟，盛出。

stateNote.visual: Beef is browned outside with a faint pink core
stateNote.visualZh: 牛肉外棕里微粉
stateNote.signal: Slight pink remains — it will finish cooking in the sauce
stateNote.signalZh: 还带一点粉色——会在酱汁里焖熟

steps.text: Add remaining 1 tbsp oil. Stir-fry garlic, ginger, onion (30 sec), then green peppers (1-2 min) until bright green with charred edges.
steps.textZh: 加剩余 1 汤匙油。下蒜片、姜片、洋葱炒 30 秒，再下青椒炒 1-2 分钟，至颜色鲜绿、边缘微焦。

stateNote.visual: Peppers turn glossy bright green with golden-brown char spots
stateNote.visualZh: 青椒油亮翠绿，带金褐色焦斑
stateNote.signal: Peppers still crisp but starting to soften at the edges
stateNote.signalZh: 青椒依然脆，边缘开始变软

steps.tip: A little char on the peppers is wok hei in disguise — don't be shy.
steps.tipZh: 青椒上的微焦其实是镬气的化身——别客气。

steps.text: Return the beef. Give the sauce a stir and pour it in. Toss 30 seconds until everything is glossy.
steps.textZh: 放回牛肉。搅一下碗汁倒入，翻炒 30 秒至全部油亮。

stateNote.visual: Sauce turns glossy and coats beef and peppers evenly
stateNote.visualZh: 酱汁油亮，均匀裹住牛肉和青椒
stateNote.signal: Sauce thickens and clings — beef is exactly done
stateNote.signalZh: 酱汁变稠挂壁——牛肉火候刚好

steps.text: Serve immediately over steamed rice. Don't leave it in the pan — carryover heat keeps cooking the beef.
steps.textZh: 立刻盛出配米饭。别留在锅里——余热会继续把牛肉焖老。

stateNote.visual: Shiny sauce, tender beef, bright peppers — steam rising
stateNote.visualZh: 油亮酱汁、嫩牛肉、鲜亮青椒——热气腾腾
stateNote.signal: Plate now
stateNote.signalZh: 现在就装盘

tips: Slice against the grain — this single habit fixes 90% of tough beef.
A screaming-hot pan and 30 seconds of patience is the whole secret.
Don't skip the brief rest in the marinade; 15 minutes matters more than you think.
Green peppers: use 1 hot + 1 sweet for a gentle kick.
tipsZh: 逆纹切肉——这一个习惯能解决九成的牛肉老硬问题。
锅要烧到冒烟，再给肉 30 秒耐心，这就是全部秘诀。
别省腌制那 15 分钟；它比你想象的更重要。
青椒：1 个微辣的+1 个甜椒，能带出一点俏皮的辣味。

titleEn: Home-Style Pork with Peppers (农家小炒肉)
versionNote: The farmhouse version is pure pork belly + green chilies + garlic, fast and aggressive. Restaurant versions add black bean paste (douchi) and a splash of stock for extra depth.
versionNoteZh: 农家版就是五花肉+青椒+蒜，猛火快炒。餐厅版会加豆豉和一勺高汤增加层次。
story: Nongjia xiaochao rou — 'farmhouse stir-fried pork' — is what Hunan grandmothers cook when they want dinner on the table in twenty minutes. Paper-thin pork belly, seared until the fat turns glassy, then tossed with blistered green chilies and a fistful of garlic. The whole dish is built on one idea: high heat, no fuss, and pork fat doing the heavy lifting.
storyZh: 农家小炒肉是湖南奶奶二十分钟上桌的拿手菜。五花肉切薄片，煎到肥肉变透明，再配起虎皮的青椒和一把蒜爆炒。整道菜就一个理念：大火、不折腾、猪油唱主角。

ingredients.note: Slice against the grain, 2-3 mm thick. Partially frozen meat slices easier.
ingredients.noteZh: 逆纹切 2-3 毫米薄片。肉微冻时更好切。

ingredients.nameEn: green chilies (long hot peppers or banana peppers)
ingredients.note: Long green chilies with some heat. For milder, use shishito or Anaheim.
ingredients.noteZh: 带辣味的长青椒。想温和用 shishito 或 Anaheim 椒。

ingredients.note: Rinse and mash lightly before adding. Adds a deep fermented note.
ingredients.noteZh: 提前冲洗并稍微压碎。带来深沉的发酵咸香。

steps.text: Slice the pork thinly. Cut peppers into long diagonal slices about 4 cm long. Smash the garlic cloves flat.
steps.textZh: 五花肉切薄片。青椒斜切约 4 厘米长的段。蒜瓣拍扁。

stateNote.visual: Pork slices are thin and even; peppers are similar in size
stateNote.visualZh: 肉片薄而均匀；辣椒大小一致
stateNote.signal: You can see light through the thinnest pork slices
stateNote.signalZh: 最薄的肉片能透光

steps.text: Heat a wok over high heat until it starts to smoke. Add the oil, then the pork. Spread it out and let it sear, without stirring, for 1 minute.
steps.textZh: 大火烧锅至微微冒烟。放油，下肉片摊开，先不要翻动，让它煎 1 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Pork edges turn golden and fat turns translucent
stateNote.visualZh: 肉片边缘金黄，肥肉变半透明
stateNote.signal: The pork releases from the pan easily — it has a crust
stateNote.signalZh: 肉片能轻松脱离锅底——已经起焦壳

steps.text: Stir-fry the pork for 2-3 more minutes until the fat renders and the slices are golden at the edges. Remove to a plate, leaving the fat in the wok.
steps.textZh: 继续翻炒 2-3 分钟，直到肥肉出油、肉片边缘金黄。盛出，油留在锅里。

stateNote.visual: Pork is golden-crisp at the edges, fat rendered and shiny
stateNote.visualZh: 肉片边缘焦脆金黄，肥肉出油油亮
stateNote.signal: A spoonful of clear pork fat pools in the wok
stateNote.signalZh: 锅底积起一勺清澈的猪油

steps.text: In the reserved fat, add the smashed garlic and (optional) douchi. Stir 15 seconds until fragrant.
steps.textZh: 用锅里的油，下拍扁的蒜瓣和（可选的）豆豉，翻炒 15 秒出香。

stateNote.visual: Garlic turns pale golden; douchi releases a fermented aroma
stateNote.visualZh: 蒜瓣变浅金色；豆豉散发发酵的咸香
stateNote.signal: Aroma hits you — garlic is fragrant but not brown
stateNote.signalZh: 蒜香扑鼻——蒜还是淡色，没焦

steps.text: Add the peppers and stir-fry over high heat for 2 minutes until the skins blister slightly.
steps.textZh: 下青椒，大火翻炒 2 分钟，直到椒皮微微起皱。

stateNote.visual: Pepper skins blister and char lightly in spots; color brightens
stateNote.visualZh: 椒皮微微起泡焦斑，颜色变鲜亮
stateNote.signal: Peppers are tender-crisp — bend one: it snaps, doesn't sag
stateNote.signalZh: 辣椒脆嫩——掰一根：是脆断而不是软垂

steps.text: Return the pork to the wok. Splash in Shaoxing wine, add soy sauces, and toss on high heat for 30 seconds until everything is glossy and coated. Serve with rice.
steps.textZh: 把肉倒回锅里。沿锅边烹入料酒，加生抽老抽，大火翻炒 30 秒裹匀酱汁。配米饭上桌。

stateNote.visual: Pork and peppers are evenly coated in a glossy brown sauce
stateNote.visualZh: 肉片和辣椒均匀裹上油亮的棕色酱汁
stateNote.signal: Sauce clings to the meat — no pooling liquid
stateNote.signalZh: 酱汁挂在肉上——没有积汁

tips: Render the pork fat fully before adding anything else — this is where the flavor comes from.
Peppers first, seasoning second: letting the chilies blister before saucing keeps them bright.
Don't be shy with garlic — Hunan cooking treats it as a main character.
Serve with steamed rice and something cool, like smashed cucumber.
tipsZh: 先把猪油完全煸出来再加别的——风味全在这里。
先炒椒后调味：辣椒起皱后再下酱汁，颜色才鲜亮。
蒜别小气——湘菜把蒜当主角。
配白米饭和一道凉菜（比如拍黄瓜）一起吃。

versionNote: The family version pan-fries tofu to a golden crust first, then braises it in a doubanjiang sauce with vegetables — richer than a plain stir-fry, faster than a full red-braise. No deep frying, no MSG.
versionNoteZh: 家常版先把豆腐煎出金黄脆壳，再用豆瓣酱配蔬菜烧制——比清炒更香浓，比整锅红烧更省时。不用宽油，不加味精。
story: In Sichuan homes, 家常豆腐 is the tofu dish grandma makes when she wants something heartier than mapo. The tofu is pan-fried first — that golden, slightly chewy skin is called the 'tiger skin' (虎皮), and it's what lets the squares soak up sauce without falling apart. Every family's sauce is a little different; this one uses doubanjiang for the red base, a few pork slices for richness, and whatever vegetables are in the fridge.
storyZh: 在四川家庭里，家常豆腐是奶奶想做一道比麻婆豆腐更实在的豆腐菜时的选择。豆腐先煎——那层金黄微韧的皮叫“虎皮”，正是它让豆腐块吸饱汤汁却不散架。每家酱汁都略有不同；这一版用豆瓣酱打底，几片五花肉增香，再加冰箱里现成的蔬菜。

ingredients.note: Firm or extra-firm — the golden crust needs structure.
ingredients.noteZh: 用老豆腐或硬豆腐——煎出脆壳需要结构支撑。

ingredients.nameEn: pork belly or shoulder, thin slices
ingredients.note: Optional — skip for a vegetarian version.
ingredients.noteZh: 可选——素食版不放。

ingredients.nameEn: green bell pepper, cut into squares

ingredients.note: Soak in warm water 20 min; or skip and add 1 more veggie.
ingredients.noteZh: 温水泡 20 分钟；没有可省，多放一种蔬菜即可。

ingredients.nameEn: cornstarch slurry (1 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water)

steps.text: Cut tofu into 1.5 cm thick slices, then into triangles or squares. Pat completely dry with paper towels — dry tofu sears instead of splattering.
steps.textZh: 豆腐切成 1.5 厘米厚的片，再切三角或方块。用厨房纸彻底吸干水分——干豆腐才能煎出脆壳而不溅油。

stateNote.visual: Tofu surface looks matte and dry, no beading water
stateNote.visualZh: 豆腐表面哑光干燥，没有渗水珠
stateNote.signal: Paper towel comes away nearly dry
stateNote.signalZh: 纸巾按上去几乎不湿

steps.tip: Extra-firm tofu needs almost no pressing; soft-firm tofu benefits from 10 minutes under a light weight.
steps.tipZh: 硬豆腐几乎不用压；稍软的豆腐压 10 分钟更好。

steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high. Fry tofu in a single layer until deep golden, about 3 minutes per side. Set aside.
steps.textZh: 锅中放 2 汤匙油，中大火加热。豆腐单层铺开煎至深金黄，每面约 3 分钟。盛出备用。

stateNote.visual: Bottom edge turns golden then deep amber; a crisp 'tiger skin' forms
stateNote.visualZh: 底部边缘先变金黄再转深琥珀色，形成脆韧的“虎皮”
stateNote.signal: Tofu releases from the pan easily — it's ready to flip
stateNote.signalZh: 豆腐能轻松离锅——说明可以翻面了

steps.text: Lower heat to medium, add remaining 1 tbsp oil. Fry pork slices until they start to render and brown slightly at the edges.
steps.textZh: 转中火，加剩余 1 汤匙油。下五花肉片炒至出油、边缘微焦。

stateNote.visual: Pork edges turn light brown and fat turns translucent
stateNote.visualZh: 肉片边缘微焦，肥肉部分变半透明
stateNote.signal: Fat has rendered and the pan bottom glistens
stateNote.signalZh: 肥肉出油，锅底泛着油光

steps.tip: Vegetarian: skip the pork and start directly at step 4 with an extra teaspoon of doubanjiang.
steps.tipZh: 素食版：跳过猪肉，直接从第 4 步开始，豆瓣酱多加 1 茶匙。

steps.text: Add doubanjiang, garlic, and ginger. Stir-fry 1 minute until the oil turns red and smells fragrant.
steps.textZh: 加入豆瓣酱、蒜片和姜片，翻炒 1 分钟至油变红、香气扑鼻。

stateNote.visual: Oil turns deep red-orange and the paste clings to the meat
stateNote.visualZh: 油变成深橙红色，酱料裹在肉片上
stateNote.signal: Sharp, rich aroma — before the paste darkens or burns
stateNote.signalZh: 香气浓郁锐利——别等酱色发黑

steps.text: Add carrot and wood ear, stir 1 minute. Return tofu, add soy sauce and 1 cup water (250 ml). Bring to a simmer and cook 5 minutes.
steps.textZh: 加入胡萝卜和木耳翻炒 1 分钟。放回豆腐，加生抽和 1 杯水（250 毫升）。煮开后小火煨 5 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Sauce bubbles gently around the tofu; tofu edges darken as they soak up color
stateNote.visualZh: 汤汁在豆腐周围微微冒泡，豆腐边缘因吸色变深
stateNote.signal: Sauce has reduced by about a third
stateNote.signalZh: 汤汁收掉约三分之一

steps.text: Add green pepper and half the cornstarch slurry. Push the sauce gently (don't stir the tofu) until it turns glossy. Add the rest if you want a thicker coat.
steps.textZh: 加入青椒和一半水淀粉，轻轻推汁（不要翻动豆腐）至汤汁油亮。想要更浓稠再加剩下的水淀粉。

stateNote.visual: Sauce turns glossy and clings to the back of a spoon
stateNote.visualZh: 汤汁变得油亮，能挂在勺背
stateNote.signal: Spoon leaves a clear trail through the sauce
stateNote.signalZh: 勺子划过留下清晰痕迹

steps.text: Off heat, fold in scallions. Serve immediately with steamed rice.
steps.textZh: 关火，拌入葱花。趁热配米饭吃。

stateNote.visual: Glossy red sauce, golden tofu, bright green pepper — classic home-style look
stateNote.visualZh: 红亮的酱汁、金黄的豆腐、翠绿的青椒——经典家常卖相
stateNote.signal: Serve hot over rice
stateNote.signalZh: 趁热浇在米饭上

tips: Patting the tofu dry is the single most important step — wet tofu never crisps.
Doubanjiang is salty; taste before adding any extra salt.
Frying in a single layer matters: overcrowding steams the tofu instead of searing it.
This is a 'clean-out-the-fridge' dish: mushrooms, zucchini, or cabbage all work.
tipsZh: 吸干豆腐水分是最关键的一步——湿豆腐永远煎不出脆壳。
豆瓣酱本身很咸——加盐前先尝味。
一定要单层煎：挤在一起会变成蒸豆腐而不是煎豆腐。
这是道“清冰箱”菜：香菇、西葫芦、白菜都能加。

versionNote: Hongshao (red-braising) is China's answer to pot roast: sear, then simmer in soy, sugar, and aromatics until lacquered. The family version uses chicken legs for guaranteed juicy meat and a short cook time.
versionNoteZh: 红烧是中式的炖肉手法：先煎后焖，用酱油、糖和香料收成酱色。家常版用鸡腿保证肉质多汁，烹饪时间也短。
story: Hongshao chicken legs are the weekday version of red-braised pork — all the deep, glossy, soy-caramel flavor of the classic, but on the table in forty minutes. Every region seasons it a little differently: Shanghainese cooks add more sugar, northern cooks more ginger and star anise. The formula never changes: brown the skin, simmer low, reduce to a lacquer.
storyZh: 红烧鸡腿是工作日版的红烧肉——经典的红亮酱色和酱油焦糖香全都有，但四十分钟就能上桌。各地调味略有不同：上海偏甜，北方多姜和八角。公式不变：煎上色、小火焖、收成糖色。

ingredients.note: Pat dry and score the skin once or twice so the braise penetrates.
ingredients.noteZh: 擦干后在皮上划一两刀，方便入味。

ingredients.note: Rock sugar gives a more refined gloss. White sugar works fine.
ingredients.noteZh: 冰糖上色更亮。白糖也完全可以。

steps.text: Pat the chicken dry. Score the skin. Have the braising liquid ready: soy sauces, Shaoxing, sugar, and 1 cup of warm water mixed together.
steps.textZh: 鸡腿擦干、划刀。提前调好炖汁：生抽、老抽、料酒、糖和 1 杯温水拌匀。

stateNote.visual: Liquid is a uniform dark brown, sugar mostly dissolved
stateNote.visualZh: 液体呈均匀深棕色，糖基本融化
stateNote.signal: No lumps of undissolved soy or sugar
stateNote.signalZh: 没有未融化的酱或糖块

steps.text: Heat oil in a wide pot over medium-high. Sear the legs skin-side down until deeply golden, about 3-4 minutes per side. Work in batches if needed.
steps.textZh: 宽锅放油，中大火加热。鸡腿皮朝下煎到深金黄，每面约 3-4 分钟。挤就分批煎。

stateNote.visual: Skin is deep golden-brown and crisp; meat releases from pan easily
stateNote.visualZh: 鸡皮深金黄微脆；肉能轻松脱离锅底
stateNote.signal: Skin has a lacquered look — not pale or raw
stateNote.signalZh: 皮呈漆亮感——不是发白或生的

steps.text: Push the legs to one side. Add ginger, scallion, star anise, and cinnamon. Stir 30 seconds until fragrant.
steps.textZh: 把鸡腿推到一边。下姜片、葱段、八角和桂皮，翻炒 30 秒出香。

stateNote.visual: Aromatics sizzle and perfume the oil
stateNote.visualZh: 香料在油里滋滋作响，香气散开
stateNote.signal: Star anise and cinnamon smell warm and sweet
stateNote.signalZh: 八角桂皮散发出温暖香甜的气息

steps.text: Pour in the braising liquid. It should come about 3/4 up the legs. Bring to a boil, skim any foam, then cover and reduce to low. Simmer 20 minutes.
steps.textZh: 倒入炖汁，大约到鸡腿 3/4 高度。大火烧开，撇去浮沫，盖盖转小火焖 20 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Liquid bubbles gently; foam rises, then you skim it off
stateNote.visualZh: 汤汁轻轻冒泡；浮沫浮起后撇掉
stateNote.signal: Liquid is at a lazy simmer, not a rolling boil
stateNote.signalZh: 汤汁是小火慢滚，不是大滚

steps.text: Uncover, turn the legs, and raise heat to medium. Simmer uncovered 10 minutes, spooning sauce over the legs, until the sauce has reduced and thickened.
steps.textZh: 开盖翻面，转中火。不盖盖再煮 10 分钟，不断把汁淋到鸡腿上，直到汤汁收浓。

stateNote.visual: Sauce darkens to deep mahogany and clings to the skin
stateNote.visualZh: 酱汁变成深红棕色，挂在鸡皮上
stateNote.signal: A spatula trail in the sauce holds for 2-3 seconds
stateNote.signalZh: 锅铲划过酱汁，划痕保持 2-3 秒

steps.text: Optional final glaze: raise heat to high and toss the legs in the syrup for 1 minute. Plate with the sauce spooned over. Serve with rice.
steps.textZh: 可选最后一步：转大火，让鸡腿在糖浆里裹 1 分钟。装盘淋上酱汁，配米饭。

stateNote.visual: Legs are glossy, deep red-brown, lacquered like barbecue
stateNote.visualZh: 鸡腿油亮，深红棕色，像刷了亮漆的烧烤
stateNote.signal: Sauce barely clings — stop before it burns
stateNote.signalZh: 酱汁刚好挂住——再收就糊，立即停

tips: Browning the skin well is non-negotiable — pale skin means pale flavor.
Skim the foam after boiling; it's the difference between a clear glaze and a murky one.
Don't rush the reduction. The sauce only turns lacquered in the last few minutes.
Leftovers taste even better next day — the legs keep braising in their own sauce.
tipsZh: 鸡皮必须煎透——皮白味淡。
烧开后撇浮沫——这是汤汁清亮和浑浊的区别。
收汁别急。酱汁只有最后几分钟才会变成漆亮质感。
剩的第二天更好吃——鸡腿在酱汁里继续入味。

versionNote: Two regional schools: Shanghainese hongshao rou is sweeter with more dark soy; Hunan style adds dried chilies and less sugar. This is the balanced family version — glossy, tender, with a sauce that turns jelly overnight.
versionNoteZh: 两大流派：上海派偏甜、老抽多；湖南派加干辣椒、糖少。这份是均衡家常版——油亮软糯，汤汁隔夜会凝成冻。
story: Every Chinese family has a hongshao rou recipe, and every family argues theirs is the only correct one. The dish is pure alchemy: cubes of pork belly, caramelized in sugar, simmered low and slow in soy until the fat turns to silk and the skin to jelly. It's the taste of weddings, New Year's dinners, and the moment a child comes home from college.
storyZh: 每个中国家庭都有一份红烧肉配方，且每家都认为只有自己家的才对。这道菜是纯粹的炼金术：五花肉块用糖炒出焦糖色，加酱油小火慢炖，直到肥肉化成丝绸、皮变成啫喱。它是婚宴、年夜饭、孩子放假回家的味道。

ingredients.note: Ask for 3-4 cm thick slab. The skin is non-negotiable — it becomes the jelly.
ingredients.noteZh: 要 3-4 厘米厚的整块。皮不能去掉——那层胶质全靠它。

ingredients.note: Rock sugar gives the famous red lacquer. White sugar works in a pinch.
ingredients.noteZh: 冰糖才能炒出标志性的红亮糖色。没有时白糖也能凑合。

steps.text: Cut the belly into 3 cm cubes. Bring a pot of water to a boil, add the pork, and blanch 3 minutes. Rinse and pat dry — this removes scum and tightens the skin.
steps.textZh: 五花肉切成 3 厘米方块。水烧开下锅焯 3 分钟，捞出冲洗并擦干——去浮沫的同时让皮收紧。

stateNote.visual: Foam and gray scum rise to the surface; meat firms up
stateNote.visualZh: 浮沫和灰色杂质浮起；肉块变紧实
stateNote.signal: No raw-pink patches remain on the surface
stateNote.signalZh: 表面没有生肉粉色

steps.text: Heat oil and rock sugar in the wok over low heat. Stir constantly until the sugar melts, foams, and turns deep amber — about 2-3 minutes. Do not walk away.
steps.textZh: 锅里放油和冰糖，小火不停搅拌。糖融化、起泡、变成深琥珀色——约 2-3 分钟。千万别走开。

stateNote.visual: Sugar melts into amber liquid with fine golden bubbles
stateNote.visualZh: 糖融化成琥珀色液体，冒着细密金色小泡
stateNote.signal: Color is mahogany-amber — one second past this and it burns bitter
stateNote.signalZh: 颜色是深琥珀——再过一秒就发苦，立即下一步

steps.text: Immediately add the pork cubes. Stir to coat every piece in the caramel. Add ginger, scallion, and star anise. Fry 2 minutes until the caramel clings and darkens slightly.
steps.textZh: 立刻下五花肉块，翻炒让每块都裹上糖色。加姜片、小葱和八角，炒 2 分钟让糖色挂住并略深。

stateNote.visual: Each cube is coated in a red-brown glaze, edges glistening
stateNote.visualZh: 每块肉裹上红棕色糖衣，边缘油亮
stateNote.signal: Caramel coats the meat — no sugar stuck to the wok bottom
stateNote.signalZh: 糖色均匀裹在肉上——锅底没有结糖

steps.text: Add Shaoxing wine (it will sizzle), then light and dark soy. Stir 1 minute. Add enough warm water to just cover the pork. Bring to a boil.
steps.textZh: 烹入料酒（会滋啦响），加生抽老抽，翻炒 1 分钟。加入没过肉块的热水。大火烧开。

stateNote.visual: Liquid is a deep red-brown; foam rises briefly
stateNote.visualZh: 汤汁呈深红棕色；短暂浮起泡沫
stateNote.signal: Wine sizzles away its alcohol — the raw smell disappears
stateNote.signalZh: 料酒滋啦挥发出酒精——生味消失

steps.text: Cover, reduce to the lowest simmer, and cook 60-75 minutes without stirring — check once at 30 minutes that the liquid hasn't dried out.
steps.textZh: 盖盖转最小火，焖 60-75 分钟，期间不要翻动——30 分钟时检查一次汤汁别烧干。

stateNote.visual: Liquid barely shimmers; fat renders into clear pools on top
stateNote.visualZh: 汤汁微微颤动；表面浮出清澈的油层
stateNote.signal: A chopstick pierces the skin and fat with almost no resistance
stateNote.signalZh: 筷子能轻松穿透皮和肥肉，几乎没有阻力

steps.text: Uncover and raise heat to medium. Simmer uncovered 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce reduces to a glossy glaze that coats the meat. Serve over rice.
steps.textZh: 开盖转中火，再煮 10-15 分钟，不时翻动，直到汤汁收成挂在肉上的亮泽酱汁。配米饭上桌。

stateNote.visual: Sauce is thick, glossy, and clings to each cube; fat has mostly emulsified
stateNote.visualZh: 酱汁浓稠油亮，挂在每块肉上；油层基本乳化
stateNote.signal: A spatula trail in the sauce holds for 3 seconds
stateNote.signalZh: 锅铲划过酱汁，划痕保持 3 秒

tips: The caramel step is where people burn it. Low heat, constant stirring, pull it one shade lighter than you think.
Blanch first — it tightens the skin so the cubes keep their shape through the long braise.
Never add cold water after the caramel step; it seizes the sugar and turns the meat tough.
The sauce is the treasure: spoon it over rice, or refrigerate overnight — it turns into pure umami jelly.
tipsZh: 炒糖色是翻车重灾区。小火、不停搅、比你想的颜色浅一档就下肉。
先焯水——皮收紧，肉块久炖不散形。
炒糖后绝不能加冷水——糖会凝固，肉会变柴。
汤汁是宝贝：浇在米饭上，或者冷藏一夜——会凝成纯正的鲜味肉冻。

titleEn: Huangmen Chicken with Rice (黄焖鸡米饭)
versionNote: The 'yellow-braised' method means chicken braised in soy and caramel color until the sauce turns golden-brown and rich. The famous chain version adds mushrooms and green peppers on top of rice — the home version does the same, one pot, no fuss.
versionNoteZh: “黄焖”是指鸡块用酱油和糖色焖到汤汁金黄浓郁。连锁店的招牌是配香菇青椒盖在米饭上——家常版一样做，一锅搞定。
story: Huangmen chicken rice went from a Shandong home dish to one of China's biggest fast-food chains — the story goes that a small stall in Jinan started serving chicken braised in a soy-mushroom sauce over rice, and the line never ended. The home version is the same soul: chicken legs, shiitake, a savory golden sauce, ladled over rice until the grains turn amber.
storyZh: 黄焖鸡米饭从一道山东家常菜变成中国最大的快餐连锁之一——据说济南一家小店开始卖香菇酱油焖鸡盖饭，从此队伍没断过。家常版是同一个灵魂：鸡腿、香菇、咸香金黄酱汁，浇在米饭上直到米粒染成琥珀色。

ingredients.nameEn: chicken thighs (bone-in or boneless), 3 cm chunks
ingredients.note: Bone-in adds flavor; boneless is easier to eat. Mix is fine.
ingredients.noteZh: 带骨更香；无骨更好夹。混着用也行。

ingredients.note: Soak in warm water 30 minutes. Save the soaking water — it's the flavor base.
ingredients.noteZh: 温水泡 30 分钟。泡香菇的水是汤底精华，别倒。

ingredients.nameEn: green bell pepper, cut into chunks

steps.text: Soak the shiitake in warm water 30 minutes. Squeeze dry, slice thickly, and reserve the soaking liquid.
steps.textZh: 干香菇温水泡 30 分钟。挤干切厚片，泡香菇的水留用。

stateNote.visual: Mushrooms are plump and fully rehydrated, no hard core
stateNote.visualZh: 香菇饱满完全泡发，没有硬芯
stateNote.signal: Mushroom caps feel spongy and springy
stateNote.signalZh: 香菇伞手感松软有弹性

steps.text: Pat chicken dry. Heat oil in a pot over medium-high. Sear the chicken in one layer until golden on all sides, about 5 minutes total.
steps.textZh: 鸡腿肉擦干。锅放油中大火加热，鸡块单层煎到四面金黄，共约 5 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Chicken is golden-brown on the outside, juices sealed in
stateNote.visualZh: 鸡块表面金黄，肉汁封在内部
stateNote.signal: Chicken releases from the pan — it has a crust
stateNote.signalZh: 鸡块轻松脱离锅底——已经起壳

steps.text: Add ginger, garlic, and mushrooms. Stir-fry 1 minute until the mushrooms smell toasty.
steps.textZh: 下姜片、蒜瓣和香菇，翻炒 1 分钟直到香菇飘出干香。

stateNote.visual: Mushroom edges turn golden; aroma turns deep and woodsy
stateNote.visualZh: 香菇边缘金黄；香气变得深沉带菌菇味
stateNote.signal: The mushroom smell is strong and savory
stateNote.signalZh: 香菇味浓郁咸鲜

steps.text: Add soy sauces, oyster sauce, and sugar. Stir 1 minute to coat. Pour in the reserved mushroom water plus enough water to barely cover the chicken. Boil, then cover and simmer 15 minutes.
steps.textZh: 加生抽、老抽、蚝油和糖，翻炒 1 分钟裹匀。倒入泡香菇的水，再补清水至刚没过鸡块。烧开后盖盖焖 15 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Liquid is golden-brown; chicken and mushrooms simmer gently
stateNote.visualZh: 汤汁金黄；鸡块和香菇小火慢滚
stateNote.signal: A chopstick pierces the chicken easily — nearly tender
stateNote.signalZh: 筷子能轻松扎透鸡块——基本熟透

steps.text: Add potatoes (if using) and simmer 8 more minutes, then add the bell pepper. Simmer 3 minutes until the pepper is bright but still crisp.
steps.textZh: 下土豆（如果用），再焖 8 分钟，然后下青椒块，煮 3 分钟到青椒鲜亮仍脆。

stateNote.visual: Potatoes are fork-tender; peppers are bright green and glossy
stateNote.visualZh: 土豆用叉子能戳透；青椒鲜绿油亮
stateNote.signal: Pepper chunks bend but still snap
stateNote.signalZh: 青椒块能弯但掰起来还是脆的

steps.text: Taste and adjust salt. Turn up the heat and reduce the sauce 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened. Ladle generously over steamed rice.
steps.textZh: 尝味补盐。转大火收汁 2-3 分钟到略微浓稠。连汁带肉浇在热米饭上。

stateNote.visual: Sauce thickens just enough to cling to the chicken
stateNote.visualZh: 汤汁浓稠到刚好挂在鸡块上
stateNote.signal: Sauce coats a spoon — not watery, not syrupy
stateNote.signalZh: 酱汁能挂勺——不稀也不黏成糖浆

tips: The mushroom soaking water is 80% of this dish's flavor. Never discard it.
Bone-in thighs make a richer sauce; boneless is easier for kids.
The sauce should be slightly loose at first — it thickens as it sits on hot rice.
Make double and freeze half. It reheats beautifully.
tipsZh: 泡香菇的水是这道菜 80% 的风味。千万别倒。
带骨鸡腿酱汁更浓；无骨更好夹，适合孩子。
汤汁一开始可以略稀——浇在热饭上会继续变稠。
一次做双份，一半冷冻。复热后一样好吃。

versionNote: The classic is shredded pork velveted and stir-fried with sweet bean sauce (tianmianjiang), served with scallion slivers wrapped in thin pancakes. The family version skips the deep-fry and uses a quick velvet — same glossy, sweet-savory result.
versionNoteZh: 经典做法：肉丝上浆滑炒，配甜面酱，卷葱丝和薄饼。家常版跳过滑油，用快手上浆——同样的油亮咸甜。
story: Jing jiang rou si is Beijing's answer to Peking duck — for everyday people. It's the dish you order at a neighborhood restaurant when you want something satisfying: silky pork shreds in a glossy sweet bean sauce, wrapped with crisp scallions in a paper-thin pancake. The sauce, tianmianjiang, is the soul: fermented wheat paste, sweet, savory, and impossibly moreish.
storyZh: 京酱肉丝是北京人自己的“烤鸭”——给普通人吃的。它是街坊餐馆里点来满足食欲的菜：滑嫩的肉丝裹着油亮的甜面酱，配脆葱丝卷进薄饼。灵魂是甜面酱：发酵的麦酱，甜咸交织，越吃越上瘾。

ingredients.nameEn: pork loin or tenderloin, cut into matchstick shreds
ingredients.note: Partially frozen pork slices into perfect shreds. Cut with the grain for strength.
ingredients.noteZh: 微冻的肉更好切丝。顺纹切不容易断。

ingredients.note: The signature flavor. Hoisin is a decent western substitute but sweeter.
ingredients.noteZh: 这道菜的标志性风味。海鲜酱是可行的西式替代，但更甜。

ingredients.nameEn: scallions, white part, cut into 5 cm slivers

ingredients.note: Frozen mandarin pancakes steam beautifully. Tortillas work in a pinch.
ingredients.noteZh: 冷冻荷叶饼蒸一下就行。卷饼也能凑合。

steps.text: Velvet the pork: combine shreds with egg white, 1/2 tbsp Shaoxing, 1/2 tbsp cornstarch, and a pinch of salt. Mix with your hands until the liquid is absorbed. Rest 10 minutes.
steps.textZh: 上浆：肉丝加蛋清、半汤匙料酒、半汤匙淀粉和一小撮盐，用手抓匀到液体被吸收。静置 10 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Pork shreds are coated in a thin, tacky film — no standing liquid
stateNote.visualZh: 肉丝裹上薄而黏的浆膜——没有积液
stateNote.signal: Shreds feel slippery but separate easily
stateNote.signalZh: 肉丝滑手但一抓就散

steps.text: Make the sauce: mix tianmianjiang with 2 tbsp water, sugar, and remaining cornstarch.
steps.textZh: 调酱：甜面酱加 2 汤匙水、糖和剩余淀粉拌匀。

stateNote.visual: Sauce is smooth and glossy, no lumps
stateNote.visualZh: 酱汁顺滑油亮，没有结块
stateNote.signal: Starch fully dissolved
stateNote.signalZh: 淀粉完全化开

steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok over medium-high. Add the pork and spread into one layer. Let it set 20 seconds, then stir-fry until the shreds turn white and separate — about 2 minutes. Remove.
steps.textZh: 锅中放 2 汤匙油，中大火加热。下肉丝摊成一层，静置 20 秒再翻动，炒到肉丝变白散开——约 2 分钟。盛出。

stateNote.visual: Pork shreds are white and separate, barely golden at edges
stateNote.visualZh: 肉丝变白、根根分明，边缘微金
stateNote.signal: No pink remains; shreds are silky, not dry
stateNote.signalZh: 没有粉色残留；肉丝滑嫩不干

steps.text: Add the remaining 1 tbsp oil and ginger to the wok. Fry 10 seconds, then pour in the sauce. Stir until it bubbles and thickens, about 30 seconds.
steps.textZh: 锅中加剩余 1 汤匙油和姜末，炒 10 秒，倒入酱汁。搅拌到起泡变稠，约 30 秒。

stateNote.visual: Sauce bubbles, darkens, and turns glossy
stateNote.visualZh: 酱汁起泡、颜色变深、油亮
stateNote.signal: Sauce coats the back of a spoon — ready for the meat
stateNote.signalZh: 酱汁能挂勺背——可以下肉了

steps.text: Return the pork to the wok. Toss over high heat 30 seconds until every shred is coated in glossy sauce.
steps.textZh: 肉丝倒回锅里，大火翻炒 30 秒，让每根肉丝都裹满油亮的酱汁。

stateNote.visual: Shreds are uniformly coated in deep-brown glossy sauce
stateNote.visualZh: 肉丝均匀裹上深棕色油亮酱汁
stateNote.signal: No bare white shreds visible
stateNote.signalZh: 看不到没裹酱的白色肉丝

steps.text: Serve immediately with scallion slivers and steamed pancakes: spoon pork onto a pancake, top with scallions, roll and eat.
steps.textZh: 趁热配葱丝和蒸好的薄饼上桌：饼上放肉丝，加葱丝，卷起来吃。

stateNote.visual: Steam rises from the glossy pork; pancakes are soft and warm
stateNote.visualZh: 油亮的肉丝冒着热气；薄饼松软温热
stateNote.signal: Everything is hot — the sauce hasn't cooled to a paste
stateNote.signalZh: 全部趁热——酱汁还没凉成膏状

tips: Velveting makes the pork silky — don't skip the egg white and rest.
Tianmianjiang needs water and heat to bloom. Cook the sauce before adding meat.
Cut scallions into fine slivers — the crunch against the soft pork is the whole point.
Leftovers are great cold in a wrap the next day.
tipsZh: 上浆是肉丝滑嫩的关键——蛋清和静置都不能省。
甜面酱要兑水炒香——先炒酱再下肉。
葱丝切细——脆葱配软肉才是这道菜的精髓。
剩的第二天卷饼冷吃一样香。

versionNote: Family version: poach a whole chicken leg or boneless thighs in aromatic broth, shock in ice water, then drench in a fiery Sichuan chili-sesame sauce. Restaurant version may brine the chicken overnight and use free-range Sichuan white chickens for firmer meat.
versionNoteZh: 家庭版：用香料卤水煮整只鸡腿或去骨鸡腿，冰水激冷后淋麻辣红油酱汁。餐厅版会隔夜卤水，用四川土白鸡，肉质更紧实。
story: Kou Shui Chicken (口水鸡) is named for the effect it has on diners — the sight and aroma are so irresistible that saliva flows involuntarily ('kou shui' literally means 'mouth water'). Originating from Chengdu street food stalls in the 1930s, it is now a staple of Sichuan cold dish menus. The technique is elegant: a gentle poach preserves the chicken's juiciness, an ice bath locks in firm texture, and the sauce — a balance of chili oil heat, Sichuan peppercorn numbness, soy saltiness, and sesame aroma — is where the magic lives. Serve at a restaurant, and it arrives glistening in its own red oil, studded with crushed peanuts and fresh scallion.
storyZh: 口水鸡因其让人垂涎欲滴的效果而得名——看一眼、闻一闻，口水就不受控制地流（口水鸡字面即「口水」）。起源于 1930 年代成都街头小吃摊，如今已是川菜凉菜菜单上的标配。技法优雅：温柔卤煮锁住鸡肉汁水，冰水激冷定格紧实口感，而 sauce——辣椒油的辣、花椒的麻、生抽的咸、香油的香——是灵魂的所在。餐厅端上桌时，鸡块在红油中泛着光泽，撒满碎花生和葱花。

ingredients.note: Bone-in, skin-on thighs stay juicier than breast. If using breasts, reduce poaching time to 12 minutes.
ingredients.noteZh: 带骨带皮鸡腿更嫩多汁。用鸡胸肉则卤煮时间缩短至 12 分钟。

ingredients.note: Garnish — adds crunch and richness.
ingredients.noteZh: 装饰用——增加酥脆口感和油脂香。

steps.text: Prepare the poaching liquid. Fill a pot large enough to hold the chicken in a single layer with about 1.5 L water. Add ginger slices, knotted scallions, Shaoxing wine, and 1 tbsp salt. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a gentle simmer.
steps.textZh: 准备卤煮液。取一足够大的锅，加入约 1.5 升水。放入姜片、葱结、料酒和 1 汤匙盐。大火烧开，转中小火保持微沸。

stateNote.visual: Small bubbles break the surface intermittently; the liquid is lightly aromatic with ginger and scallion
stateNote.visualZh: 汤面间歇冒小泡，液体带着姜葱的香气
stateNote.signal: Surface is gently agitated, not a rolling boil
stateNote.signalZh: 汤面微滚，非大沸

steps.text: Lower the chicken legs into the simmering liquid. Cover and poach for 12–15 minutes (for bone-in thighs) or 10–12 minutes (for boneless). Do not boil aggressively — a vigorous boil will tighten the meat and make it dry.
steps.textZh: 将鸡腿放入微沸卤水中。盖上锅盖，卤 12–15 分钟（带骨鸡腿）或 10–12 分钟（去骨鸡腿）。不要大火沸腾——剧烈沸腾会让肉质收紧变干。

stateNote.visual: Chicken skin turns opaque white-gold; juices run clear when the thickest part is pierced with a skewer
stateNote.visualZh: 鸡皮呈不透明的白金色；最厚处用签子穿刺，流出清澈汁水
stateNote.signal: Internal temperature reaches 74°C / 165°F; juices run clear, not pink
stateNote.signalZh: 内部温度达 74°C；汁水清澈不泛粉

steps.text: Immediately transfer the cooked chicken to a bowl of ice water. Submerge completely and leave for at least 10 minutes — this shocks the skin into contracting, creating the signature gelatinous, bouncy texture. Leave until completely cool.
steps.textZh: 立即将熟鸡腿转入冰水碗中。完全浸没，冰镇至少 10 分钟——让鸡皮急速收缩，形成标志性的胶质弹牙口感。完全冷却后再取出。

stateNote.visual: Chicken skin appears plump, smooth, and slightly gelatinous — a visible shrink-wrap effect from the thermal shock
stateNote.visualZh: 鸡皮饱满光滑，略带胶质光泽——热冲击后的收缩效果
stateNote.signal: Chicken is cold to the core; skin has tightened noticeably
stateNote.signalZh: 鸡肉中心已冷，鸡皮明显收紧

steps.text: Make the sauce. In a medium bowl, whisk together chili oil (with sediment), toasted ground Sichuan peppercorn, sesame oil, light soy sauce, Chinkiang vinegar, minced garlic, and sugar until the sugar dissolves. The sauce should be a deep red-orange, glossy, with a visible layer of chili oil on top.
steps.textZh: 调 sauce。碗中混合辣椒油（含辣椒碎）、焙香花椒粉、香油、生抽、香醋、蒜末和糖，搅拌至糖融化。sauce 应呈深红橙色、油亮，表面浮着一层红油。

stateNote.visual: Deep red-orange liquid with a glossy sheen; tiny chili flakes and garlic bits suspended throughout
stateNote.visualZh: 深红橙色液体，油亮光泽，悬浮辣椒碎和蒜末
stateNote.signal: Sugar is fully dissolved; the mixture is homogeneous with no grainy patches
stateNote.signalZh: 糖完全溶解，质地均匀无颗粒

steps.text: Remove chicken from ice water and pat dry with paper towels. Cut into bite-sized pieces (about 2-inch chunks) on a cutting board — the bone can stay in for easier handling. Arrange on a serving platter and generously ladle the chili-sesame sauce over the top, ensuring every piece is coated. Sprinkle with crushed peanuts and sliced scallions. Serve immediately or chill for up to 2 hours for deeper flavor.
steps.textZh: 鸡腿捞出沥干，切一口大小块（约 5 厘米，带骨更好切）。摆盘， generously 淋上红油酱汁，每块都要裹上。撒碎花生和葱花。立即上桌或冷藏 2 小时让味道更深入。

stateNote.visual: Platter is glistening with red oil; peanuts and green scallion provide color contrast against the deep red chicken
stateNote.visualZh: 盘中鸡块红油泛光，花生和葱花点缀出红绿对比
stateNote.signal: Each piece has a visible coating of chili oil; the sauce pools slightly at the base of the platter
stateNote.signalZh: 每块鸡都裹上红油，盘底有少量酱汁汇集

tips: The ice bath is non-negotiable. Skipping it means the skin stays soft and the texture is disappointing. Ten minutes in ice water makes the difference between 'meh' and 'wow'.
Use good-quality chili oil with visible sediment (辣椒碎). The sediment is where the flavor lives — oil alone is just heat without complexity.

Toasted Sichuan peppercorn (花椒) is essential for the 'má' (numbing) sensation. Dry-toast whole peppercorns in a pan until fragrant (1 minute), then grind coarsely. Pre-ground loses potency within weeks.
