Kou Shui Chicken tastes even better the next day — the sauce has penetrated deeper into the meat. Make it ahead for maximum impact.
tipsZh: 冰水激冷这步不能省。跳过就是软皮鸡，口感大打折扣。冰水 10 分钟，决定是「还行」还是「惊艳」。
用带辣椒碎的辣椒油—— sediment 是风味的核心，光油只有辣没有层次。
花椒必须焙香——干锅焙 1 分钟至出香，粗磨。预磨花椒粉几周就失效。
口水鸡隔夜更入味——酱汁渗入肉里更深。提前做效果最佳。

versionNote: Authentic home version uses dried chilies + Sichuan pepper (not the sweet American take). We keep the numbing-spicy-sour balance that made it famous.
versionNoteZh: 正宗家常版用干辣椒+花椒（不是美式的甜口）。我们保留了让它闻名天下的麻辣酸香平衡。
story: Named after Ding Baozhen, a Qing-dynasty governor (宫保 = his title). The real dish is not sweet-glazed — it's a salty-sour-spicy-numbing stir-fry with a vinegar-forward sauce. This home version stays true to that.
storyZh: 得名于清代官员丁宝桢（宫保是他的官衔）。真正的宫保鸡丁不是甜口的——它是一道咸酸麻辣的炒菜，酱汁以醋香为主。这份家常版忠于原味。

ingredients.nameEn: boneless chicken thigh (or breast), diced 2 cm
ingredients.note: Thigh stays juicier; breast works if velvetted well.
ingredients.noteZh: 鸡腿肉更嫩；鸡胸上浆到位也可以。

ingredients.note: Remove seeds for milder heat.
ingredients.noteZh: 去籽可减辣。

ingredients.note: Add at the end for crunch — a classic.
ingredients.noteZh: 最后放入保持酥脆——经典做法。

ingredients.nameEn: cornstarch slurry (1 tsp starch + 1 tbsp water)

steps.text: Marinate chicken: mix with soy, Shaoxing wine, and cornstarch. Rest 10 minutes (velveting — keeps it silky).
steps.textZh: 腌制鸡肉：与生抽、料酒、淀粉混合。静置 10 分钟（上浆——保持滑嫩）。

stateNote.visual: Chicken pieces are evenly coated in a thin starchy glaze
stateNote.visualZh: 鸡块均匀裹上一层薄薄的淀粉浆
stateNote.signal: Glaze looks wet but not dripping
stateNote.signalZh: 表面湿润但不滴落

steps.tip: The cornstarch layer is what keeps the chicken juicy at high heat.
steps.tipZh: 淀粉层是鸡肉高温下保持多汁的关键。

steps.text: Mix the sauce in a small bowl: vinegar, sugar, soy, and cornstarch slurry. Set aside.
steps.textZh: 小碗中调好碗汁：香醋、糖、生抽、水淀粉。备用。

stateNote.visual: Sugar and starch fully dissolved, no lumps
stateNote.visualZh: 糖和淀粉完全溶解，无结块
stateNote.signal: Sauce is uniform, slightly cloudy
stateNote.signalZh: 碗汁均匀，微带乳白色

steps.text: Heat oil in a wok over medium. Add Sichuan peppercorns and dried chilies; fry 30 seconds until fragrant but NOT burned.
steps.textZh: 锅中放油，中火加热。下花椒和干辣椒，炸 30 秒至出香，注意别炸糊。

stateNote.visual: Oil lightly ripples; chilies turn deep red and glossy
stateNote.visualZh: 油面轻泛涟漪；辣椒变深红有光泽
stateNote.signal: Fragrant (prickly + spicy) — pull them before they go black
stateNote.signalZh: 香气扑鼻（麻+辣）——变黑前捞出

steps.text: Turn heat to high. Add chicken in a single layer and sear 1 minute without stirring, then stir-fry until mostly cooked.
steps.textZh: 转大火。鸡块平铺入锅，先静置 1 分钟不翻动，再翻炒至基本熟透。

stateNote.visual: Chicken edges sear golden, pieces separate easily
stateNote.visualZh: 鸡块边缘煎至金黄，彼此轻松分开
stateNote.signal: No raw pink on most surfaces; still slightly pink in thickest pieces
stateNote.signalZh: 大部分表面无生粉红色；最厚处仍微带粉红

steps.text: Add garlic, ginger, and scallion sections. Stir-fry 30 seconds until fragrant.
steps.textZh: 下蒜片、姜片和大葱段。爆炒 30 秒至出香。

stateNote.visual: Aromatics glisten and release scent
stateNote.visualZh: 葱姜蒜油光发亮，香气四溢
stateNote.signal: Garlic edges just start to color
stateNote.signalZh: 蒜片边缘刚开始变色

steps.text: Pour in the sauce. Stir rapidly 20-30 seconds until it thickens and coats everything.
steps.textZh: 倒入碗汁。快速翻炒 20-30 秒，直到汤汁变稠裹住所有食材。

stateNote.visual: Sauce turns glossy and clings to chicken
stateNote.visualZh: 碗汁变得有光泽并挂在鸡块上
stateNote.signal: Clear trail left when spatula swipes the pan
stateNote.signalZh: 锅铲划过锅底留下清晰痕迹

steps.text: Off heat: fold in the peanuts. Serve immediately.
steps.textZh: 关火：拌入花生米。立即上桌。

stateNote.visual: Peanuts coated in glossy sauce, still whole
stateNote.visualZh: 花生裹着光泽的酱汁，依然完整
stateNote.signal: Peanuts still crunchy
stateNote.signalZh: 花生依然酥脆

tips: The vinegar-forward sauce is what separates authentic kung pao from the sweet American version.
Don't skip the Sichuan peppercorn — the numbing (má) contrast with the chili heat is the dish.
Too spicy? Remove chili seeds and use 6 chilies instead of 10.
Cashews make a luxurious swap for peanuts.
tipsZh: 以醋为主的碗汁，是正宗宫保鸡丁与美式甜口的根本区别。
花椒不能省——麻感与辣椒的辣形成对比，这才是这道菜。
太辣？去籽，并用 6 个干辣椒代替 10 个。
用腰果代替花生，口感更高级。

versionNote: Restaurant version uses a wide-oil velveted beef + Sichuan peppercorn oil finish. Family version is leaner but keeps the má là (numbing-spicy) soul.
versionNoteZh: 餐厅版用宽油滑牛肉+花椒油收尾。家常版更清爽，但保留了麻与辣的川味灵魂。
story: Named after 'Pockmarked Grandma Chen' of Chengdu in the 1800s. The home version is a weeknight staple across China — silken tofu in a spicy, numbing, bean-paste sauce that exists to be poured over rice.
storyZh: 得名于 19 世纪成都的“陈麻婆”。家常版是全国家常餐桌上的工作日经典——嫩豆腐浸在麻辣的豆瓣酱汁里，这道菜的存在就是为了浇在米饭上。

ingredients.note: Medium-firm works too — handle gently.
ingredients.noteZh: 老豆腐也可以，但要轻拿轻放。

ingredients.note: Skip for vegetarian version.
ingredients.noteZh: 素食版不放。

ingredients.nameEn: scallions, white part + green part separated
chicken stock (or water + 1/2 tsp mushroom powder)
cornstarch slurry (1 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water)

steps.text: Cut tofu into 2 cm cubes. Blanch in gently simmering salted water for 2 minutes, then drain (keeps it from breaking and warms it up).
steps.textZh: 豆腐切成 2 厘米见方的小块，放入微沸的淡盐水里焯 2 分钟，捞出沥干（这样豆腐不易碎，也提前温热）。

stateNote.visual: Water barely simmering, tofu cubes floating without sticking together
stateNote.visualZh: 水微微冒泡，豆腐块浮起且不粘连
stateNote.signal: Tofu looks slightly puffy and is hot through
stateNote.signalZh: 豆腐微微膨胀，内部已热透

steps.tip: Skip blanching if using medium-firm tofu and you're in a rush — just be extra gentle later.
steps.tipZh: 用老豆腐又赶时间时可以跳过焯水——后面操作更轻一点就行。

steps.text: Heat oil in a wok over medium. Add ground pork and fry until it changes color and starts to render.
steps.textZh: 锅中放油，中火加热。下猪肉末炒至变色出油。

stateNote.visual: Pork turns from pink to pale brown, releasing fat
stateNote.visualZh: 肉末从粉色变成浅棕色并开始出油
stateNote.signal: No pink remains; edges begin to crisp slightly
stateNote.signalZh: 看不到粉色，边缘开始微微焦脆

steps.text: Push pork aside. Add doubanjiang and fry 1 minute until the oil turns red. Add douchi, garlic, ginger, and chili flakes; stir 30 seconds until fragrant.
steps.textZh: 把肉末拨到一边。下豆瓣酱炒 1 分钟至油变红。加入豆豉、蒜末、姜末和辣椒面，翻炒 30 秒炒出香味。

stateNote.visual: Oil turns deep red-orange (the classic 红油 moment)
stateNote.visualZh: 油变成深橙红色（经典的红油时刻）
stateNote.signal: Fragrant and sharp — don't let it burn dark
stateNote.signalZh: 香气锐利扑鼻——别炒到发黑

steps.text: Add soy sauce, then pour in the stock. Bring to a simmer.
steps.textZh: 加入生抽，再倒入高汤。煮至微沸。

stateNote.visual: Sauce is bubbling gently, deep red
stateNote.visualZh: 汤汁微微冒泡，呈深红色
stateNote.signal: Steady small bubbles, not a rolling boil
stateNote.signalZh: 持续小气泡，而不是翻滚大沸

steps.text: Gently slide in the tofu. Shake the pan (don't stir — it breaks) and simmer 5 minutes so it absorbs the sauce.
steps.textZh: 轻轻滑入豆腐。晃动锅身（不要翻炒——会碎），小火煨 5 分钟让豆腐入味。

stateNote.visual: Tofu bathed in sauce, edges slightly darkened from soaking
stateNote.visualZh: 豆腐浸在汤汁中，边缘因吸汁微微变深
stateNote.signal: Sauce has reduced by about a third
stateNote.signalZh: 汤汁收掉了约三分之一

steps.text: Add half the cornstarch slurry, stir gently by pushing the sauce, and watch it thicken. Repeat with the rest if you want a thicker coat.
steps.textZh: 倒入一半水淀粉，用推汁的方式轻轻搅动，观察汤汁变稠。想要更浓稠就再倒入剩下的。

stateNote.visual: Sauce turns glossy and clings to the back of a spoon
stateNote.visualZh: 汤汁变得有光泽，能挂在勺背
stateNote.signal: Spoon leaves a clear trail through the sauce
stateNote.signalZh: 勺子划过汤汁留下清晰痕迹

steps.text: Off heat: stir in the white scallion parts. Plate, dust generously with ground Sichuan pepper, and top with green scallions.
steps.textZh: 关火：拌入葱白部分。装盘，慷慨地撒上花椒粉，再放上葱花。

stateNote.visual: Steam carries the Sichuan pepper aroma — that's the má là signature
stateNote.visualZh: 热气带着花椒香——这就是麻辣的招牌
stateNote.signal: Serve immediately over rice
stateNote.signalZh: 趁热浇在米饭上立刻吃

tips: Never stir the tofu with a spatula — push the pan or stir the sauce around it.
The ground Sichuan peppercorn at the end is non-negotiable: it's what makes it má pó.
Vegetarian version: skip pork, add 1 tsp more doubanjiang + a few dried shiitake, rehydrated and sliced.
Doubanjiang is salty — taste before adding extra salt.
tipsZh: 绝不用锅铲翻豆腐——晃动锅身，或只搅动周围的汤汁。
最后的花椒粉不能省：它才是“麻婆”的灵魂。
素食版：不放猪肉，多加 1 茶匙豆瓣酱 + 几朵泡发切片的干香菇。
豆瓣酱本身很咸——加盐前先尝味。

versionNote: The Chinese original is a quick stir-fry of pork, egg, wood ear, and cucumber — the 'mu xu' (moo shu) name comes from the scrambled egg resembling osmanthus flowers. The American-Chinese version wraps it in pancakes; the home version is simply served over rice.
versionNoteZh: 中式原版是猪肉、鸡蛋、木耳和黄瓜的快炒——“木须”名字来自炒散的鸡蛋形似桂花。美式中餐版配薄饼卷着吃；家常版直接盖饭。
story: Moo shu pork has two lives. In China it's a humble northern stir-fry — pork, eggs, black wood ear, cucumber — where the 'mu xu' comes from eggs scrambled to look like osmanthus blossoms. In America it became a pancake-wrapped classic with hoisin. This recipe honors the Chinese original: quick, colorful, and done in one wok.
storyZh: 木须肉有两段人生。在中国它是朴素的北方小炒——猪肉、鸡蛋、黑木耳、黄瓜——“木须”得名于炒蛋形似桂花。在美国它变成了卷饼蘸海鲜酱的经典。这份菜谱致敬中式原版：快手、缤纷、一锅到底。

ingredients.nameEn: pork loin or belly, thinly sliced
ingredients.note: Thin slices, not shreds — they should be bite-size pieces.
ingredients.noteZh: 切薄片而非细丝——一口大小。

ingredients.note: Soak 20 minutes until soft, then tear into bite pieces. They should crunch.
ingredients.noteZh: 泡 20 分钟至软，撕成小朵。木耳要保留脆感。

steps.text: Prep everything before you start: soaked and torn wood ear, sliced pork, cucumber, carrot, beaten eggs, and sauce (soy + oyster + 2 tbsp water) mixed.
steps.textZh: 开火前全部备好：泡发撕好的木耳、肉片、黄瓜、胡萝卜、蛋液，以及调好的碗汁（生抽+蚝油+2 汤匙水）。

stateNote.visual: Every ingredient is cut, separated, and within reach
stateNote.visualZh: 所有食材切好分装，触手可及
stateNote.signal: The sauce bowl has no lumps
stateNote.signalZh: 碗汁没有结块

steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok over medium-high. Pour in the eggs and scramble until just set. Remove to a plate.
steps.textZh: 锅中放 2 汤匙油，中大火加热。倒入蛋液炒到刚刚凝固，盛出。

stateNote.visual: Eggs are soft, glossy curds — not browned
stateNote.visualZh: 鸡蛋是柔软油亮的蛋块——没有炒黄
stateNote.signal: No raw liquid, curds still moist
stateNote.signalZh: 没有生蛋液，蛋块依然湿润

steps.text: Add remaining 1 tbsp oil. Add pork and stir-fry until it turns opaque and lightly golden, about 2 minutes.
steps.textZh: 加剩余 1 汤匙油，下肉片炒到变色微金黄，约 2 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Pork turns from pink to pale golden at the edges
stateNote.visualZh: 肉片从粉色变浅金，边缘上色
stateNote.signal: No pink remains
stateNote.signalZh: 没有粉色残留

steps.text: Add ginger and scallion whites. Stir 20 seconds, then add wood ear, carrot, and cucumber. Stir-fry 1 minute until the vegetables are glossy and bright.
steps.textZh: 下姜末和葱白，炒 20 秒，加入木耳、胡萝卜和黄瓜，翻炒 1 分钟到蔬菜油亮鲜亮。

stateNote.visual: Vegetables are glossy; cucumber still crisp, carrot bright orange
stateNote.visualZh: 蔬菜油亮；黄瓜依然脆，胡萝卜橙亮
stateNote.signal: Wood ear 'pops' when bitten — still crunchy
stateNote.signalZh: 木耳咬下去会“啵”一声——依然脆

steps.text: Return the eggs. Pour in the sauce and toss everything over high heat 30 seconds until coated and glossy.
steps.textZh: 蛋倒回锅里，淋入碗汁，大火翻炒 30 秒裹匀油亮。

stateNote.visual: Everything is coated in a thin glossy sauce
stateNote.visualZh: 所有食材裹上一层薄亮酱汁
stateNote.signal: Sauce clings, no pooling
stateNote.signalZh: 酱汁挂在食材上，没有积汁

steps.text: Off heat, drizzle sesame oil and toss once. Serve over steamed rice.
steps.textZh: 关火，淋香油翻一下。盖在热米饭上。

stateNote.visual: Dish is glossy with a subtle sesame sheen
stateNote.visualZh: 菜色油亮，带一层隐约的香油光泽
stateNote.signal: Sesame aroma, not overpowering
stateNote.signalZh: 有香油香但不冲

tips: Mise en place is non-negotiable — this dish cooks in under 4 minutes once the wok is hot.
Don't overcook the cucumber; it should keep its crunch.
Wood ear must be soaked until fully soft, then it's the best texture in the dish.
Serve over rice, or get fancy and wrap it in pancakes like American-Chinese restaurants.
tipsZh: 备料是硬要求——锅热后整道菜不到 4 分钟就炒完。
黄瓜别炒过头，要保持脆感。
木耳要泡到完全软透，它是这道菜口感最好的部分。
盖饭最实在；想讲究就学美式中餐卷薄饼。

versionNote: Family version is a one-pan 20-minute dinner: velveted beef, sweet caramelized onion, savory glaze. Restaurant version adds a slow-oil beef fry and a splash of dark soy for deeper color.
versionNoteZh: 家常版是 20 分钟一锅出：上浆牛肉、甜软洋葱、咸香酱汁。餐厅版会滑油并加一点老抽提色。
story: Onion beef is the fastest bridge between a busy weekday and a proper Chinese dinner: two ingredients, one pan, twenty minutes. In northern Chinese kitchens it's the dish a child learns first — because the onion sweetens on its own, the sauce forgives mistakes, and it pairs with rice, noodles, or bread equally well. My grandmother called it 'the beginner's beef' for a reason.
storyZh: 洋葱炒牛肉是忙碌工作日和一顿正经中餐之间最快的桥：两种食材、一口锅、二十分钟。北方厨房里这是孩子学的第一道牛肉菜——因为洋葱自己会变甜，酱汁容错率高，配饭、配面、配馒头都行。我奶奶管它叫“入门牛肉”，不是没道理。

ingredients.nameEn: beef sirloin or flank, thinly sliced against the grain
ingredients.note: Flank or sirloin both work; slice thin, against the grain.
ingredients.noteZh: 牛腩排或牛里脊都行；切薄、逆纹。

ingredients.note: Yellow or red onion; thick strips so they don't vanish.
ingredients.noteZh: 黄皮或红皮洋葱；切粗条才不会炒没影。

ingredients.note: Echoes the onion's natural sweetness.
ingredients.noteZh: 呼应洋葱本身的甜味。

steps.text: Slice beef thinly against the grain. Velvet: mix with 1 tbsp soy, Shaoxing, and 1 tbsp cornstarch. Rest 10 minutes.
steps.textZh: 牛肉逆纹切薄片。上浆：与 1 汤匙生抽、料酒、1 汤匙淀粉拌匀，静置 10 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Beef thinly coated, tacky to the touch
stateNote.visualZh: 牛肉裹料薄而均匀，摸起来微黏
stateNote.signal: No free liquid in the bowl
stateNote.signalZh: 碗底没有游离汁水

steps.text: In a small bowl mix: remaining 1/2 tbsp soy, dark soy, oyster sauce, sugar, 1/3 cup water (80 ml), 1 tbsp cornstarch.
steps.textZh: 调碗汁：剩余半汤匙生抽、老抽、蚝油、糖、三分之一杯水（80 毫升）、1 汤匙淀粉，搅匀。

stateNote.visual: Deep brown sauce, sugar dissolved
stateNote.visualZh: 深棕色酱汁，糖已融化
stateNote.signal: Taste: savory-sweet balance
stateNote.signalZh: 尝一口：咸甜平衡

steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil over high until shimmering. Add beef in one layer, sear 30 seconds without moving, then stir-fry 1 minute until mostly browned. Remove.
steps.textZh: 锅放 2 汤匙油，大火烧至泛光。牛肉单层下锅，静置 30 秒再翻动，翻炒 1 分钟至大部分变色。盛出。

stateNote.visual: Beef browns fast; faint pink remains in the center
stateNote.visualZh: 牛肉快速上色，中心还剩一点粉色
stateNote.timeRefZh: 静置 30 秒后再炒 1 分钟
stateNote.signal: Beef releases easily from the pan
stateNote.signalZh: 牛肉能轻松离锅

steps.text: Add remaining 1 tbsp oil, then onion and garlic. Stir-fry 2-3 minutes until onion turns translucent and sweet.
steps.textZh: 加剩余 1 汤匙油，下洋葱和蒜片，翻炒 2-3 分钟至洋葱变半透明、变甜。

stateNote.visual: Onion turns from white to translucent gold with caramelized edges
stateNote.visualZh: 洋葱从白色变成半透明金色，边缘微微焦糖化
stateNote.signal: Onion smells sweet — the raw pungency is gone
stateNote.signalZh: 洋葱散发出甜香——生辣味已消失

steps.tip: This is where the dish gets its sweetness. Don't rush the onion.
steps.tipZh: 这道菜的甜味就来自这里。别催洋葱。

steps.text: Return the beef, give the sauce a stir, pour it in. Toss 30 seconds until glossy and everything is coated.
steps.textZh: 放回牛肉，搅一下碗汁倒入，翻炒 30 秒至油亮裹匀。

stateNote.visual: Sauce turns glossy and clings; beef and onion glisten together
stateNote.visualZh: 酱汁油亮挂壁，牛肉与洋葱一起泛着光
stateNote.signal: Sauce thickens to a glaze — done
stateNote.signalZh: 酱汁变稠成釉——完成

steps.text: Serve immediately over rice or noodles. The onion keeps sweetening as it sits — leftovers are great cold in a sandwich.
steps.textZh: 立刻配米饭或面条上桌。洋葱放置后会越来越甜——剩下的夹三明治也很好吃。

stateNote.visual: Glossy beef and golden onion in a shiny sauce
stateNote.visualZh: 油亮牛肉与金色洋葱裹着闪亮酱汁
stateNote.signal: Serve hot
stateNote.signalZh: 趁热上桌

tips: The 30-second untouched sear is non-negotiable for tender beef.
Onion + high heat = sweet; onion + low heat = mushy. Keep it medium-high.
Swap oyster sauce for mushroom stir-fry sauce to make it vegetarian-friendly (serve with tofu).
Leftover onion beef makes a brilliant sandwich filling the next day.
tipsZh: 前 30 秒静置不翻是牛肉嫩的关键，别省。
洋葱+大火=甜；洋葱+小火=烂糊。保持中大火。
蚝油换成菌菇炒酱、配豆腐，就变成素食友好版。
剩的洋葱炒牛肉第二天夹三明治，绝了。

versionNote: Restaurant version blanches whole heads then plates with sauce; home version uses romaine hearts for easier handling and faster cooking.
versionNoteZh: 餐厅版整棵白灼后淋汁；家常版用罗马生菜心，更易操作、更快熟。
story: A Cantonese bistro staple that appears on nearly every dim sum and family dinner table. The key is blanching the lettuce just long enough to stay crisp-tender, then drowning it in a glossy oyster-sauce glaze. It's the fastest way to get a restaurant-quality green vegetable on the table.
storyZh: 粤式茶餐厅和家庭餐桌的常客。秘诀是白灼时间刚好保持脆嫩，然后淋上光泽感十足的蚝油汁。这是最快做出餐厅级青菜的方式。

ingredients.note: Romaine is sturdier than butter lettuce. If unavailable, use bok choy or choy sum.
ingredients.noteZh: 罗马生菜比黄油生菜更耐煮。买不到可用小白菜或菜心代替。

steps.text: Trim the tough outer base of each lettuce heart, then cut lengthwise into 4 wedges. Wash thoroughly — sand hides in the tight folds.
steps.textZh: 削去生菜底部硬蒂，纵向切成 4 瓣。彻底清洗——泥沙藏在紧密的叶褶里。

stateNote.visual: Each wedge should be pale green at the base, dark green at the tips, with no brown or wilted outer leaves
stateNote.visualZh: 每瓣底部淡绿、尖端深绿，外层无褐变或萎蔫叶片
stateNote.signal: Leaves are crisp and taut when you bend them
stateNote.signalZh: 叶片脆挺、弯曲时不软塌

steps.tip: If using baby bok choy instead, halve lengthwise — no trimming needed.
steps.tipZh: 如果用小白菜代替，对半切即可——无需修边。

steps.text: Make the sauce: whisk together oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, and water in a small bowl until the sugar dissolves.
steps.textZh: 调酱汁：将蚝油、生抽、糖、香油和水在小碗中搅匀，至糖融化。

steps.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil. Add lettuce, submerge fully, and blanch for exactly 30 seconds.
steps.textZh: 大锅盐水烧至滚沸。放入生菜，完全浸没，白灼恰好 30 秒。

stateNote.visual: Leaves turn a vivid, glossy bright green and begin to wilt slightly at the edges
stateNote.visualZh: 叶片变成鲜艳有光泽的亮绿色，边缘开始微塌
stateNote.signal: Color is electric green — if it turns olive, you've overcooked it
stateNote.signalZh: 颜色是电光绿——如果变橄榄绿就说明煮过头了

steps.text: Remove lettuce with tongs and arrange on a serving plate. Do not drain — the water dripping off is fine.
steps.textZh: 用夹子取出生菜，摆盘。不用沥干——滴落的水没关系。

steps.text: In the same pot (or a small pan), heat neutral oil over medium. Add minced garlic and fry for 10 seconds until fragrant but not browned.
steps.textZh: 原锅（或小平底锅）中火加热食用油。下蒜末爆香 10 秒，不要煎黄。

stateNote.visual: Garlic sizzles and releases a sharp, toasted aroma
stateNote.visualZh: 蒜末滋滋作响，释放辛辣焦香
stateNote.signal: Aroma is sharp and fragrant — if it starts smoking, it's too hot
stateNote.signalZh: 香气尖锐芬芳——如果开始冒烟说明火太大了

steps.tip: Don't skip this step — raw garlic in the sauce tastes bitter.
steps.tipZh: 这步不能省——生蒜在酱汁里会发苦。

steps.text: Pour in the oyster sauce mixture. Let it bubble for 15 seconds until slightly thickened and glossy.
steps.textZh: 倒入蚝油汁。煮沸 15 秒，至略微浓稠、有光泽。

stateNote.visual: Sauce bubbles and coats the back of a spoon with a glossy sheen
stateNote.visualZh: 酱汁冒泡，勺背挂上光泽的薄层
stateNote.signal: Sauce has thickened just enough to cling, not run thin like water
stateNote.signalZh: 酱汁刚好能挂住，不会像水一样稀

steps.text: Pour the hot sauce evenly over the lettuce. Serve immediately.
steps.textZh: 将热酱汁均匀淋在生菜上。立即上桌。

tips: 30 seconds is the sweet spot — any longer and the lettuce turns mushy and loses its signature crunch.
Never salt the blanching water heavily — the oyster sauce is already salty enough.
For a restaurant finish, add a tiny drizzle of sesame oil right before pouring over the lettuce.
This dish is naturally gluten-free if you use a GF oyster sauce (most contain wheat).
tipsZh: 30 秒是最佳时长——再长就会软烂，失去脆爽口感。
焯水时盐不要放多——蚝油本身已经够咸了。
餐厅做法：淋汁前再滴几滴香油，风味更突出。
如果用无麸质蚝油，这道菜本身就是无麸质的。

versionNote: The family version marinates, then pan-fries with a simple flour crust. Restaurant versions deep-fry with a panko crust (Japanese-style tonkatsu, very popular in China). Both are served with rice and a squeeze of lemon or a drizzle of soy.
versionNoteZh: 家常版腌制后裹薄面粉煎制。餐厅版是日式炸猪排式的面包糠深炸（在中国很流行）。两者都配米饭，挤柠檬或淋生抽吃。
story: Pan-fried chicken cutlet is the Chinese home cook's answer to the fried chicken craving — without the deep fryer. A butterflied chicken breast, pounded thin, marinated in ginger and soy, then pan-fried until the crust is golden and the inside stays juicy. Kids love it, adults need it on a weeknight, and it goes with everything from rice to noodles.
storyZh: 香煎鸡排是中国家庭对炸鸡渴望的回答——而且不用油炸锅。鸡胸剖开拍薄，用姜和生抽腌制，煎到外壳金黄、内部多汁。孩子爱吃，大人工作日需要它，配米饭配面条都行。

ingredients.note: Butterfly and pound to even 1 cm thickness for even cooking.
ingredients.noteZh: 剖开拍平到 1 厘米厚，才能熟得均匀。

steps.text: Butterfly each breast: slice almost through the middle, open like a book, and pound to an even 1 cm thickness.
steps.textZh: 鸡胸剖开：从中间切到几乎贯穿，像翻书一样打开，拍平成均匀的 1 厘米厚。

stateNote.visual: Cutlets are even thickness, no thick bumps in the middle
stateNote.visualZh: 鸡排厚度均匀，中间没有厚鼓包
stateNote.signal: They lie flat on the cutting board
stateNote.signalZh: 鸡排在案板上能平铺

steps.text: Marinate: mix soy, Shaoxing, ginger, garlic, sugar, and white pepper. Coat the chicken and marinate 15 minutes (or up to overnight in the fridge).
steps.textZh: 腌料：生抽、料酒、姜蒜、糖和白胡椒调匀，裹上鸡排腌 15 分钟（冰箱里过夜也行）。

stateNote.visual: Chicken is fully coated in marinade, no dry spots
stateNote.visualZh: 鸡排完全裹上腌料，没有干的地方
stateNote.signal: Marinade has been absorbed — surface looks moist but not dripping
stateNote.signalZh: 腌料被吸收——表面湿润但不滴水

steps.text: Dust each cutlet lightly with flour, shaking off the excess. The flour should be a thin, dry film.
steps.textZh: 鸡排两面轻轻拍粉，抖掉多余的。面粉应该是薄薄一层干膜。

stateNote.visual: Thin, even flour coat — no thick clumps
stateNote.visualZh: 薄而均匀的面粉层——没有厚结块
stateNote.signal: Flour feels dry to the touch
stateNote.signalZh: 摸起来是干燥的

steps.text: Heat oil in a heavy pan over medium-high. Place the cutlets in — you should hear a steady sizzle. Cook 3-4 minutes without moving.
steps.textZh: 厚底锅放油，中大火加热。放入鸡排——应该听到平稳的滋啦声。不要翻动，煎 3-4 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Crust turns golden around the edges; steady sizzle
stateNote.visualZh: 边缘的脆壳变金黄；滋滋声平稳
stateNote.signal: Cutlet releases easily — peek: golden, not pale
stateNote.signalZh: 鸡排能轻松脱离——看一眼：金黄而不是发白

steps.text: Flip and cook 3 minutes on the second side. If the crust browns too fast, lower the heat — the inside needs time to cook through.
steps.textZh: 翻面再煎 3 分钟。如果脆壳上色太快，调小火——里面需要时间熟透。

stateNote.visual: Both sides golden-brown; no burnt spots
stateNote.visualZh: 两面金黄；没有焦斑
stateNote.signal: Press the thickest part — it springs back with a slight give
stateNote.signalZh: 按压最厚处——有弹性且微微回弹

steps.text: Rest 3 minutes on a plate (juices redistribute), then slice against the grain. Serve with rice and a lemon wedge or a drizzle of soy.
steps.textZh: 装盘静置 3 分钟（肉汁回流），再逆纹切片。配米饭，挤柠檬或淋少许生抽。

stateNote.visual: Juices pool slightly on the plate; meat is white and moist inside
stateNote.visualZh: 盘底渗出少量肉汁；内部白色多汁
stateNote.signal: No pink at the thickest point
stateNote.signalZh: 最厚处没有粉色

tips: Pounding to even thickness is the difference between juicy and dry — take the time.
Don't move the chicken in the first 3 minutes; the crust needs to form and release.
Resting is not optional. Slice too early and the juices run out onto the board.
For a crispy-ier crust, substitute panko for flour and shallow-fry.
tipsZh: 拍成均匀厚度是多汁和干柴的分界线——别省这一步。
前 3 分钟不要翻动——脆壳需要时间成形并脱离锅底。
静置不能省。切太早，肉汁全流到砧板上。
想要更脆，把面粉换成面包糠，用半煎半炸。

versionNote: 家庭快手版——肉丝滑嫩，青椒爽脆，十分钟上桌。
versionNoteZh: 家庭快手版——肉丝滑嫩，青椒爽脆，十分钟上桌。
story: Pepper shredded pork is the ultimate weeknight comfort food in Chinese homes. Thin strips of pork are velveted for silkiness, then stir-fried with crisp green pepper. My mother made this after work on busy Tuesdays — it took 15 minutes from fridge to table and never failed to make my father smile.
storyZh: 青椒肉丝是中国家庭周末下班后的终极安慰菜。肉丝经过上浆处理变得丝滑嫩口，再与爽脆的青椒快炒。我妈妈在忙碌的周二手工做饭——从冰箱到餐桌只要 15 分钟，却总能让我爸爸露出微笑。

steps.text: Cut pork loin into thin strips about 5 cm long and 3 mm thick. Place in a bowl with shaoxing wine, 1/2 tbsp light soy sauce, and cornstarch. Mix well and marinate for 10 minutes.
steps.textZh: 将猪里脊切成约 5 厘米长、3 毫米厚的细丝。放入碗中，加入绍兴酒、1/2 汤匙生抽和玉米淀粉，拌匀腌制 10 分钟。

stateNote.visual: meat coated in glossy slurry
stateNote.signal: liquid absorbed

steps.text: Remove seeds from the green pepper and cut into matching thin strips. Mince the garlic.
steps.textZh: 青椒去籽后切成与肉丝相近的细丝。大蒜切末。

stateNote.visual: uniform strip shapes
stateNote.signal: prep complete

steps.text: Heat oil in a wok over high heat until shimmering. Add the marinated pork and spread in a single layer. Let it sear for 20 seconds without stirring, then stir-fry until the pork turns white.
steps.textZh: 热锅旺火下油，烧至微冒烟。加入腌好的肉丝，平铺锅底煎 20 秒不要翻动，然后快速翻炒至肉丝变白。

stateNote.visual: pork turning opaque white
stateNote.signal: sizzling

steps.text: Add garlic and green pepper strips. Stir-fry for 1 minute until the pepper softens slightly but remains crisp.
steps.textZh: 加入蒜末和青椒丝，翻炒 1 分钟，青椒略微变软但仍保持脆感。

stateNote.visual: pepper glossy bright green
stateNote.signal: fragrant

steps.text: Add remaining light soy sauce and sugar. Toss for 15 seconds. Drizzle sesame oil and serve immediately over steamed rice.
steps.textZh: 加入剩余生抽和白糖，翻炒 15 秒。淋上香油即可出锅，配白米饭食用。

stateNote.visual: sauce glossy coating meat
stateNote.signal: ready

tips: Velveting (上浆) is the secret to tender pork — the cornstarch creates a protective coating that locks in moisture.
High heat is essential. If your wok isn't hot enough, the pork will stew instead of stir-fry.
Green bell pepper works best — sweet and crisp. Don't use hot peppers for this dish.
tipsZh: 上浆是肉丝嫩滑的秘诀——玉米淀粉形成保护层锁住水分。
猛火是关键。如果锅不够热，肉会变成煮而不是炒。
甜椒最合适——清甜爽脆。不要用辣椒做这道菜。

titleEn: Thai-Style Pineapple Fried Rice Recipe | 20-Min Chinese Street Food
versionNote: Thai-style pineapple fried rice is a street-food classic: sweet pineapple, curry spice, cashews, raisins. Home version simplifies the curry paste to powder.
versionNoteZh: 泰式菠萝炒饭是街头经典：甜菠萝、咖喱香、腰果、葡萄干。家常版用咖喱粉简化。
story: Born from Thai-Chinese street food in southern China, pineapple fried rice is the ultimate sweet-savory comfort bowl. The curry powder gives it golden color and warmth; pineapple adds bright acidity that cuts through the richness. Kids and adults both love it.
storyZh: 源于中国南方的泰式中餐街头小吃，菠萝炒饭是甜咸交织的终极 comfort food。咖喱粉赋予金黄色泽与暖意；菠萝提供清爽酸度，化解油腻。大人小孩都爱。

ingredients.note: Jasmine rice preferred for its floral aroma.

ingredients.nameEn: fresh pineapple, cut into 1 cm chunks (or canned, well drained)
ingredients.nameZh: 新鲜菠萝，切 1 厘米块（或用罐头菠萝，充分沥干）

ingredients.note: Toast in dry pan first for extra crunch.

steps.text: Dry-toast the cashews in a dry pan over medium heat, shaking occasionally, until golden and fragrant — about 3 minutes. Remove and set aside. This step is non-negotiable for crunch.
steps.textZh: 干锅中小火炒香腰果，期间不断摇晃，至金黄微香——约 3 分钟。盛出备用。这步是酥脆口感的关键。

stateNote.visual: Cashews turn light golden and release a nutty aroma
stateNote.visualZh: 腰果变浅金色，散发坚果香气
stateNote.signal: Golden color and nutty smell; no smoke
stateNote.signalZh: 呈金黄色，散发坚果香；无烟

steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil over medium-high. Add beaten eggs, scramble until just set (soft curds), about 30 seconds. Remove to plate.
steps.textZh: 热锅中放 1 汤匙油，倒入蛋液，炒至刚刚凝固（柔软蛋花），约 30 秒。盛出。

stateNote.visual: Eggs are soft curds, still glossy
stateNote.visualZh: 鸡蛋柔软有光泽
stateNote.signal: No runny liquid; curds still moist
stateNote.signalZh: 无流动蛋液；蛋块湿润

steps.text: Add remaining 1 tbsp oil. Toss in onion and garlic. Stir-fry 30 seconds until onion softens and becomes fragrant.
steps.textZh: 加剩余 1 汤匙油。下洋葱和大蒜。翻炒 30 秒，洋葱变软出香。

stateNote.visual: Onion turns translucent at edges; garlic sizzles
stateNote.visualZh: 洋葱边缘变透明；大蒜滋啦作响
stateNote.signal: Aromatic, no browning
stateNote.signalZh: 香气四溢，未上色

steps.text: Add curry powder to the empty side of the wok, let it sizzle 10 seconds to bloom the spices, then fold into the onion. (Blooming releases the essential oils in the curry.)
steps.textZh: 把咖喱粉撒到锅空的一侧，让它滋啦 10 秒激发香气，再翻拌进洋葱。（加热能释放咖喱中的精油。）

stateNote.visual: Curry powder darkens slightly and releases intense golden aroma
stateNote.visualZh: 咖喱粉颜色变深，散发浓郁金黄色香气
stateNote.signal: Aroma is warm and nutty, not raw-powdery
stateNote.signalZh: 香气温暖坚果感，不是生粉味

steps.text: Add cold rice, breaking up clumps. Press and toss until rice is evenly golden from the curry — about 2 minutes.
steps.textZh: 下隔夜冷饭，搓散结块。按压翻拌至米饭均匀裹上咖喱金色——约 2 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Rice transforms from white to a uniform golden-yellow
stateNote.visualZh: 米饭从白色变成均匀的金黄色
stateNote.signal: Every grain coated; no white patches
stateNote.signalZh: 每粒米都裹上颜色；没有白色斑块

steps.text: Add fish sauce, soy sauce, and sugar. Toss to combine. Add the pineapple chunks and raisins — toss gently so pineapple doesn't break apart.
steps.textZh: 下鱼露、生抽和糖。翻匀。下菠萝块和葡萄干——轻轻翻，别让菠萝散碎。

stateNote.visual: Sauce coats rice glossy; pineapple warm but holding shape
stateNote.visualZh: 酱汁裹上米饭呈光泽；菠萝温热但保持块状
stateNote.signal: Pineapple just warmed through, still firm
stateNote.signalZh: 菠萝刚热透，依然紧实

steps.text: Fold in the scrambled eggs and half the cashews. Toss once more. Serve topped with remaining cashews and a pineapple wedge if you have one.
steps.textZh: 把炒蛋和一半腰果折入。再翻一次。装盘，余下腰果撒在上面，有菠萝的话放一片装饰。

stateNote.visual: Rice golden, pineapple bright, cashews scattered on top
stateNote.visualZh: 米饭金黄，菠萝鲜亮，腰果点缀其上
stateNote.signal: Each spoonful has rice, pineapple, cashew, and protein
stateNote.signalZh: 每勺都有米饭、菠萝、腰果和蛋白

tips: Canned pineapple works but must be thoroughly drained — excess water makes rice soggy.
Fish sauce is non-negotiable for authentic flavor; for vegetarian version use soy sauce + 1/2 tsp miso.
The curry powder must be bloomed in oil first — raw curry powder tastes bitter.
tipsZh: 罐头菠萝可用，但必须充分沥干——多余水分会让米饭变糊。
鱼露是正宗风味的关键；素食版用酱油+1/2 茶匙味噌替代。
咖喱粉必须先煸香——生咖喱粉有苦味。

titleEn: Pork and Cabbage Dumplings (白菜猪肉饺)
versionNote: The classic New Year's Eve dumpling. The family version mixes ground pork with finely chopped, salted napa cabbage for a juicy filling. Restaurant versions add minced ginger-scallion water (a 'jiaozi water' that keeps the filling moist).
versionNoteZh: 除夕夜的经典饺子。家常版把猪肉馅和盐腌过的白菜碎拌匀，鲜嫩多汁。餐厅版会加姜葱水打馅，让馅料更润。
story: Making pork and cabbage dumplings together is a Chinese family ritual — on New Year's Eve, three generations gather around a flour-dusted table, rolling wrappers and pinching pleats while the pot boils. The cabbage is salted and squeezed so the filling stays juicy but never soggy. Some families hide a coin in one dumpling for luck; whoever finds it has a lucky year.
storyZh: 一起包白菜猪肉饺是中国家庭的仪式——除夕夜，三代人围坐在撒满面粉的桌边擀皮捏褶，锅里的水咕嘟咕嘟。白菜要盐腌挤水，馅料才多汁而不湿塌。有的家庭会在一个饺子里藏枚硬币讨彩头，吃到的人一整年好运。

ingredients.note: Some fat is essential for a juicy filling. Lean-only turns dry.
ingredients.noteZh: 带点肥肉是馅料多汁的关键。全瘦肉会发柴。

ingredients.note: Salt, squeeze dry, and chop fine. The squeeze step is the whole trick.
ingredients.noteZh: 盐腌、挤干、切碎。挤水这步是全部秘诀。

steps.text: Make the dough: mix flour with about 200 ml cold water, knead 5 minutes into a smooth ball, cover and rest 30 minutes.
steps.textZh: 和面：面粉加约 200 毫升冷水，揉 5 分钟成光滑面团，盖住醒 30 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Dough is smooth and elastic; it springs back when pressed
stateNote.visualZh: 面团光滑有弹性；按压回弹
stateNote.signal: Surface is smooth, no cracks
stateNote.signalZh: 表面光滑无裂纹

steps.text: Salt the cabbage: chop fine, toss with 1 tsp salt, rest 15 minutes. Then squeeze firmly in handfuls until nearly dry.
steps.textZh: 白菜切碎，加 1 茶匙盐拌匀，静置 15 分钟。然后一把把用力挤到几乎不出水。

stateNote.visual: A pool of pale green water collects; cabbage reduces in volume
stateNote.visualZh: 渗出淡绿色的水；白菜体积明显缩小
stateNote.signal: Squeezed handfuls release almost no liquid
stateNote.signalZh: 用力挤一把，几乎不出水

steps.text: Make the filling: combine pork, cabbage, ginger, scallions, soy, Shaoxing, white pepper, and sesame oil. Stir in one direction until the filling feels tacky and holds together — about 2 minutes.
steps.textZh: 调馅：猪肉、白菜、姜末、葱花、生抽、料酒、白胡椒和香油拌匀，朝一个方向搅拌到馅料发黏抱团——约 2 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Filling is uniform and slightly sticky; no separated liquid
stateNote.visualZh: 馅料均匀微黏；没有分离的汁水
stateNote.signal: A spoonful holds its shape when scooped
stateNote.signalZh: 舀一勺能保持形状不散

steps.text: Roll the dough into a log, cut into 12 g pieces, flatten, and roll into thin round wrappers (about 8 cm).
steps.textZh: 面团搓条，切 12 克小剂子，压扁擀成约 8 厘米的薄圆皮。

stateNote.visual: Wrappers are even, edges thinner than the center
stateNote.visualZh: 饺子皮均匀，边缘比中心薄
stateNote.signal: You can see your hand faintly through the edge
stateNote.signalZh: 透过边缘能隐约看到手

steps.text: Fill and pleat: place a heaping teaspoon of filling in the center, fold into a half-moon, and pleat the edge closed. Press out air pockets.
steps.textZh: 包馅捏褶：中间放一满勺馅，对折成半月形，捏出褶子封口。挤出空气。

stateNote.visual: Dumplings are plump, tightly sealed, standing upright
stateNote.visualZh: 饺子饱满、封口严实、能立住
stateNote.signal: Seam holds firm when squeezed
stateNote.signalZh: 轻捏封口不松开

steps.text: Boil: bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Add dumplings in batches, stir gently once. When they float, add 1/2 cup cold water; boil again; repeat once more. Drain.
steps.textZh: 煮：大锅水烧开，分批下饺子，轻轻推一下。饺子浮起后点入半杯凉水；再烧开；再点一次。捞出。

stateNote.visual: Dumplings float and look slightly translucent, skin puffed
stateNote.visualZh: 饺子浮起，皮半透明微微鼓起
stateNote.signal: Press one — it springs back fully
stateNote.signalZh: 按压一个——完全回弹

steps.text: Serve immediately with black vinegar (and chili oil, if you like). The filling should be juicy — 'soup' inside is the sign of a good dumpling.
steps.textZh: 趁热配香醋（喜欢可加辣椒油）。馅心要带汁——咬开有“汤”才是好饺子。

stateNote.visual: Bitten dumpling releases a small burst of juice
stateNote.visualZh: 咬开的饺子涌出一小口汤汁
stateNote.signal: Juice is hot and savory, not greasy
stateNote.signalZh: 汤汁滚烫咸鲜，不油腻

tips: The cabbage squeeze determines everything — too wet, and the dumplings burst; too dry, and they're tough.
Stir the filling in ONE direction. It makes the texture bouncier ('q' in Chinese).
Freeze uncooked dumplings on a floured tray; boil straight from frozen (+2 minutes).
The classic dip: black vinegar + a drop of sesame oil, or chili oil for heat.
tipsZh: 挤白菜的水分决定成败——太湿饺子爆口，太干馅发柴。
馅料必须朝一个方向搅——口感更弹（中国话叫“Q”）。“Q”是弹牙的口感。
生饺子撒粉冷冻，冻硬装袋——冷冻直接下锅，多煮 2 分钟。
经典蘸料：香醋+一滴香油，或加辣椒油。

versionNote: The home version is a one-pot braise: beef seared, then simmered with potatoes, carrots, and a soy-spice broth until everything is fork-tender. Restaurant versions add more aromatics and reduce the sauce to a glaze; the family version keeps the broth loose for soaking into rice.
versionNoteZh: 家常版一锅炖：牛肉煎香，加土豆、胡萝卜和酱油香料汤慢炖到筷子一戳就透。餐厅版香料更多、汤汁收得更浓；家常版保留汤汁，方便浇饭。
story: Potato beef stew is the Chinese family's comfort food for cold days — a big pot of beef, potato, and carrot in a savory soy broth, simmered until the potatoes go soft at the edges and the beef falls apart. Every household has a slightly different version: some add tomatoes for tang, some add star anise for depth. The potato is the real star — it soaks up all the beefy broth.
storyZh: 土豆炖牛肉是中国家庭冬日里的暖心菜——大锅牛肉、土豆、胡萝卜，泡在咸香的酱油汤里，炖到土豆边缘化开、牛肉一抿就散。每家做法略有不同：有的加番茄提酸，有的加八角增香。真正的明星是土豆——它吸饱了牛肉汤汁。

ingredients.nameEn: beef chuck or brisket, 3 cm chunks
ingredients.note: Chuck and brisket have enough fat and collagen to stay tender after braising.
ingredients.noteZh: 牛腩和牛腱的脂肪和胶质足够，久炖依然软嫩。

ingredients.note: Waxy potatoes hold their shape; starchy ones dissolve into the broth (also delicious).
ingredients.noteZh: 面土豆保持形状；淀粉多的会化进汤里（也好吃）。

steps.text: Blanch the beef: bring a pot of water to boil, add beef, cook 3 minutes, skim the foam, rinse and drain.
steps.textZh: 牛肉焯水：水开下牛肉煮 3 分钟，撇去浮沫，捞出冲洗沥干。

stateNote.visual: Gray foam rises; beef firms and darkens slightly
stateNote.visualZh: 灰色浮沫浮起；牛肉变紧实、颜色略深
stateNote.signal: No more foam rising — beef is clean
stateNote.signalZh: 不再冒沫——牛肉干净了

steps.text: Heat oil in a heavy pot over medium-high. Sear the beef in one layer until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Don't rush this — browning = flavor.
steps.textZh: 厚底锅放油，中大火加热。牛肉单层煎到四面焦黄，约 5 分钟。别急——焦香=风味。

stateNote.visual: Beef is deep brown on the outside, not gray
stateNote.visualZh: 牛肉表面深棕色，不是灰白色
stateNote.signal: Browned bits stick to the pan — that's the fond, leave it
stateNote.signalZh: 锅底粘着焦色锅巴——那是精华，别刮掉

steps.text: Add ginger, scallions, star anise, cinnamon, and Shaoxing. Stir 1 minute until aromatic.
steps.textZh: 下姜片、葱段、八角、桂皮和料酒，翻炒 1 分钟出香。

stateNote.visual: Aromatics sizzle; wine evaporates in steam
stateNote.visualZh: 香料滋滋作响；料酒化成蒸汽
stateNote.signal: Spice aroma fills the kitchen
stateNote.signalZh: 满屋香料香

steps.text: Add soy sauces and sugar, stir 1 minute. Add enough boiling water to cover the beef by 2 cm. Bring to a boil, skim, cover, and simmer 45 minutes.
steps.textZh: 加生抽老抽和糖，翻炒 1 分钟。加入没过牛肉 2 厘米的开水。烧开撇沫，盖盖小火焖 45 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Liquid is deep brown; beef simmers gently
stateNote.visualZh: 汤汁深棕；牛肉小火慢滚
stateNote.signal: A chopstick pierces the beef with some resistance — halfway tender
stateNote.signalZh: 筷子扎牛肉有轻微阻力——半熟状态

steps.text: Add potatoes and carrots. Stir to submerge. Cover and simmer 20 more minutes, until the potatoes are fork-tender.
steps.textZh: 下土豆和胡萝卜，搅拌没入汤中。盖盖再焖 20 分钟，到土豆用叉子一戳就透。

stateNote.visual: Potatoes are soft at the edges, broth slightly thickened by starch
stateNote.visualZh: 土豆边缘化开，汤汁被淀粉微微增稠
stateNote.signal: A fork slides into a potato cube with no resistance
stateNote.signalZh: 叉子毫无阻力地滑入土豆块

steps.text: Taste and adjust salt (soy brands vary). For a thicker sauce, simmer uncovered 5-10 minutes. Garnish with scallions and serve over rice.
steps.textZh: 尝味补盐（不同生抽咸度不同）。想要浓汁就开盖再煮 5-10 分钟。撒葱花，浇在米饭上。

stateNote.visual: Broth is rich and glossy; beef shreds at a touch
stateNote.visualZh: 汤汁浓郁油亮；牛肉轻轻一拨就散
stateNote.signal: The broth coats a spoon
stateNote.signalZh: 汤汁能挂勺

tips: Browning the beef deeply is where the flavor lives — pale beef makes pale stew.
Always add boiling water, never cold — cold water seizes the meat and toughens it.
Add potatoes late so they keep their shape instead of melting into the broth.
This stew is even better the next day; make it ahead for a stress-free dinner.
tipsZh: 牛肉要煎透——色浅则汤寡。
必须加热水，不能加冷水——冷水会让肉收紧变柴。
土豆晚下锅，保持形状而不是化进汤里。
这道炖菜隔夜更好吃；提前做好，晚餐零压力。

versionNote: Shanghai street food classic — simple noodles tossed in deeply caramelized scallion oil.
versionNoteZh: 上海街头经典——简单面条拌上香浓葱油。
story: Scallion oil noodles (葱油拌面) are a Shanghai street food icon — humble wheat noodles tossed in deeply caramelized scallion-infused oil with a touch of soy and sugar. The magic is in the scallion oil: slow-frying scallions until they are dark brown and crispy, infusing the oil with sweet allium flavor. This dish proves that Chinese comfort food doesn't need to be complicated to be deeply satisfying.
storyZh: 葱油拌面是上海街头小吃的代表——简单的小麦面条拌上深 caramelized 的葱油，加一点生抽和糖。秘诀在于葱油：慢火炸葱至深褐色酥脆，让油充分吸收葱的甜味。这道菜证明中式 comfort food 不需要复杂也能深深满足。

ingredients.nameZh: 食用油（菜籽油或花生油）

steps.text: Cook noodles in salted boiling water according to package directions. Drain and rinse briefly under cold water to stop cooking. Set aside.
steps.textZh: 面条沸水加盐煮熟，按包装说明时间。捞出过冷水沥干备用。

stateNote.visual: Noodles are tender but still firm (al dente)
stateNote.visualZh: 面条软但仍有弹性
stateNote.signal: No hard center when bitten
stateNote.signalZh: 咬开无硬芯

steps.text: Heat neutral oil in a small saucepan over medium-low heat. Add scallion sections in a single layer.
steps.textZh: 小锅中放油，中小火加热。葱段平铺入锅。

stateNote.visual: Oil shimmers, scallions begin to sizzle gently
stateNote.visualZh: 油微微晃动，葱段开始轻嘶
stateNote.signal: Oil is at 150°C — scallions sizzle without smoking
stateNote.signalZh: 油温约150度，葱嘶响但不冒烟

steps.text: Slow-fry scallions, turning occasionally, for 8-10 minutes until deeply browned and crispy. The oil will turn amber-colored.
steps.textZh: 慢炸葱段，偶尔翻动，8-10 分钟至深褐色酥脆。油会变成琥珀色。

stateNote.visual: Scallions turn from bright green to dark brown, oil turns amber
stateNote.visualZh: 葱从翠绿变深褐，油变琥珀色
stateNote.signal: Scallions are dark brown and crisp, not burnt
stateNote.signalZh: 葱深褐酥脆，不焦

steps.text: Remove scallions with a slotted spoon. Add soy sauce and sugar to the hot oil, stir 10 seconds until sugar dissolves.
steps.textZh: 捞出葱段。热油中加生抽、糖，搅 10 秒至糖融化。

stateNote.visual: Sauce bubbles vigorously and mixes with oil into a glossy brown liquid
stateNote.visualZh: 酱汁冒泡与油融合成光泽棕液
stateNote.signal: Sugar fully dissolved, sauce glossy
stateNote.signalZh: 糖完全融化，酱汁光亮

steps.text: Add cooked noodles to the sauce. Toss vigorously with chopsticks or tongs to coat every strand evenly.
steps.textZh: 下面条入酱汁，用筷子或夹子快速翻炒均匀。

stateNote.visual: Noodles are evenly coated in dark glossy sauce, no dry patches
stateNote.visualZh: 面条均匀裹上深褐色光泽酱汁，无干燥斑块
stateNote.signal: Every strand is coated, sauce clings to noodles
stateNote.signalZh: 每根面条都裹上酱，酱汁挂面

steps.text: Top with fried scallions. Serve immediately while hot.
steps.textZh: 撒上炸葱，立即上桌趁热吃。

stateNote.visual: Glossy dark noodles topped with dark crispy scallions
stateNote.visualZh: 光泽黑亮面条配深褐酥脆葱段
stateNote.signal: Steam rising, best eaten now
stateNote.signalZh: 热气升腾，现在吃最佳

tips: The scallion oil is the star — do not rush the frying. Low and slow brings out the sweet allium flavor.
Use the darkest scallion sections (the white ends) for the best color and flavor.
This dish is naturally vegan and gluten-free if you use tamari instead of soy sauce.
The fried scallions can be made ahead and stored in the fridge for up to a week.
tipsZh: 葱油是灵魂——不要急火。小火慢炸才能激发葱的甜味。
用葱白部分（最白的末端）颜色最深、风味最好。
这道菜天生纯素，用味醂代替生抽就是无麸质。
炸葱可以提前做多批，冷藏保存一周。

regionZh: 中国北方 / 街头小吃
versionNote: Street version is laminated with lots of oil; home version uses a thinner oil paste — same flaky layers, less mess.
versionNoteZh: 街边版用大量油起酥；家常版用更薄的油酥——同样的层次分明，却更干净省油。
story: A northern-China street food: unleavened dough rolled thin with scallions and oil, coiled and flattened so it flakes into crispy layers. Perfect weekend project — and the first 'wow' recipe for new cooks.
storyZh: 北方街头小吃：不发面的面团擀薄，卷入葱和油，盘成螺旋再压扁，烙出层层酥脆。是完美的周末项目，也是新手厨师的第一个“哇”时刻。

ingredients.nameEn: scallions, finely chopped (dry them on a towel)

steps.text: Mix flour and salt. Slowly pour in hot water, stirring with chopsticks, until it forms shaggy clumps. Knead into a smooth ball. Cover, rest 20 minutes.
steps.textZh: 混合面粉和盐。用筷子边搅边缓缓倒入热水，直到成絮状。揉成光滑的面团，盖上醒 20 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Dough comes together into a smooth, elastic ball
stateNote.visualZh: 面团揉成光滑有弹性的圆球
stateNote.signal: Dough springs back when poked
stateNote.signalZh: 手指轻按能回弹

steps.text: Meanwhile make the oil paste: whisk oil + flour until smooth. Dry the chopped scallions on a paper towel (wet scallions make soggy layers).
steps.textZh: 同时制作油酥：油+面粉搅拌至顺滑。把葱花放在纸巾上吸干水分（湿葱花会让层次发黏）。

stateNote.visual: Paste is smooth, pale, and spreadable
stateNote.visualZh: 油酥顺滑、色泽浅、易涂抹
stateNote.signal: No flour lumps
stateNote.signalZh: 没有面粉结块

steps.text: Divide dough into 4 balls. Roll each into a thin rectangle (about 2-3 mm).
steps.textZh: 面团分成 4 份。每份擀成薄薄的长方形（约 2-3 毫米厚）。

stateNote.visual: Rectangle is thin enough to be slightly translucent
stateNote.visualZh: 面片薄到微微透光
stateNote.signal: Can see your hand faintly through it
stateNote.signalZh: 透过面片能隐约看到手

steps.text: Spread oil paste thinly over the dough, sprinkle with scallions. Roll it up tightly into a long log, then coil the log into a spiral. Rest 5 minutes.
steps.textZh: 面片薄薄抹上油酥，撒上葱花。紧紧卷成长条，再把长条盘成螺旋。静置 5 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Coil holds its shape; layers are visible at the cut edge
stateNote.visualZh: 螺旋保持形状；切面可见层次
stateNote.signal: Coil doesn't unroll on its own
stateNote.signalZh: 螺旋不会自己散开

steps.text: Roll each coil gently into a flat pancake, about 5-6 mm thick. Don't press hard — you want to preserve the layers.
steps.textZh: 把每个螺旋轻轻擀成约 5-6 毫米厚的饼。不要用力压——要保留层次。

stateNote.visual: Pancake is even thickness, spiral pattern visible
stateNote.visualZh: 饼厚度均匀，螺旋纹路清晰可见
stateNote.signal: Layers still distinct at the edge
stateNote.signalZh: 边缘层次依然分明

steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium. Fry the pancake 2-3 minutes per side until golden and crisp.
steps.textZh: 平底锅放 1 汤匙油，中火加热。每面煎 2-3 分钟，直到金黄酥脆。

stateNote.visual: Golden-brown patches; pancake puffs slightly and layers separate
stateNote.visualZh: 出现金棕色斑点；饼微微鼓起，层次分离
stateNote.signal: Edges look flaky and sound crisp when tapped
stateNote.signalZh: 边缘呈层状，轻敲有脆响

steps.text: Move to a cutting board, rest 1 minute (traps steam = flaky). Cut into wedges. Repeat for remaining pancakes.
steps.textZh: 移到砧板上静置 1 分钟（锁住蒸汽=酥脆）。切块。其余饼重复操作。

stateNote.visual: Pancake steams slightly as it rests; layers lift when cut
stateNote.visualZh: 饼静置时微微冒热气；切开时层次挑起
stateNote.signal: Layers visibly peel apart when cut
stateNote.signalZh: 切开时能明显看到层次剥开

tips: Hot water (not boiling) is key — it cooks the gluten slightly, making the dough tender and rollable.
Drying the scallions is the #1 secret to crispy layers.
Freeze rolled, uncooked pancakes between parchment; fry straight from frozen, add 1 min per side.
tipsZh: 热水（非沸水）是关键——略微烫熟面筋，让面团柔软易擀。
吸干葱花水分，是酥脆层次的第一秘诀。
擀好的生饼用烘焙纸隔开冷冻；直接冷冻下锅煎，每面多加 1 分钟。

versionNote: Family version: rustic, quick, punchy — the 'smash' cracks the skin so the dressing penetrates deeply. Restaurant version uses a rolling pin and adds a touch of sugar for balance.
versionNoteZh: 家庭版：粗犷快手、味道浓烈——「拍」破表皮质地，让汁水渗入。餐厅版会用擀面杖更均匀地拍碎，并加少许糖提鲜。
story: Smashed cucumber is the quintessential Chinese summer cold dish — crunchy, garlicky, and tangy. The key technique is 'smashing' rather than slicing: crack the cucumber with the flat side of a chef's knife so the surface area is rough and uneven. This allows the dressing (chinkiang vinegar, sesame oil, soy, garlic) to cling to every nook. Served at room temperature or slightly chilled, it cuts through greasy meals like a palate reset button.
storyZh: 拍黄瓜是夏日中式凉菜的典范——脆、蒜香、酸爽。关键技法是「拍」而非「切」：用刀背拍裂黄瓜，让表面粗糙不平，这样酱汁（镇江香醋、香油、生抽、蒜）才能附着每一处缝隙。室温或微凉上桌，是解腻提神的最佳开胃菜。

ingredients.nameEn: english cucumbers (or persian), about 6 inches each
ingredients.note: English or persian cucumbers are best — thin-skinned, fewer seeds. If using regular slicing cucumbers, peel in stripes for texture.
ingredients.noteZh: 长条黄瓜最佳，皮薄籽少。普通黄瓜可留条纹状表皮增加口感。

ingredients.nameEn: scallions, sliced thin on the bias

ingredients.note: Balances the sharp vinegar and salt — the defining touch of a good smashed cucumber.
ingredients.noteZh: 中和醋的酸和盐的咸——好拍黄瓜的点睛之笔。

steps.text: Wash cucumbers. Trim both ends. Place on a cutting board and press down firmly with the flat side of a chef's knife — you should hear a crack. Press along the length 3–4 times, turning the cucumber slightly each time until it is loosely broken apart.
steps.textZh: 黄瓜洗净，切去两端。放在砧板上，用刀背（平底）用力拍下去——听到 cracking 声即可。沿长度方向拍 3–4 次，每次轻微转动黄瓜，让整体裂开但不散碎。

stateNote.visual: Cucumber is split into irregular chunks with cracked skin; some seeds are exposed
stateNote.visualZh: 黄瓜裂成不规则块状，表皮开裂，部分籽露出
stateNote.signal: Each piece is about 2–3 inches long; skin is fissured but not pulverized
stateNote.signalZh: 每块约 5–7 厘米，表皮有裂纹但不过碎

steps.text: Transfer the smashed cucumber to a bowl. Sprinkle with 1/4 tsp salt and toss gently. Let sit for 5 minutes — the salt draws out moisture and slightly wilts the flesh, concentrating flavor.
steps.textZh: 将拍好的黄瓜放入碗中，撒 1/4 茶匙盐，轻拌。静置 5 分钟——盐会逼出水分，让黄瓜微微塌软，味道更浓缩。

stateNote.visual: Pools of watery liquid appear at the bottom of the bowl; cucumber surface looks glossy
stateNote.visualZh: 碗底渗出清水，黄瓜表面油亮
stateNote.signal: Liquid has collected; cucumber feels slightly softer to touch
stateNote.signalZh: 有汁水渗出，黄瓜手感略软

steps.text: Discard the released water. Add minced garlic, sliced scallions, Chinkiang vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, remaining 1/4 tsp salt, and sugar. Toss gently until every piece is coated.
steps.textZh: 倒掉渗出的水。加入蒜末、葱花、香醋、生抽、香油、剩余盐和糖，轻拌均匀，让每块黄瓜都裹上酱汁。

stateNote.visual: Each cucumber chunk is glossy and darkened by the soy and vinegar; garlic and scallion bits cling to the surface
stateNote.visualZh: 每块黄瓜被酱油和醋染成深色、油亮，蒜末和葱花附着其上
stateNote.signal: No dry patches — every crevice has dressing
stateNote.signalZh: 没有干的地方，每处缝隙都有汁

steps.text: Let the dressed cucumber rest for another 5–10 minutes at room temperature. This allows the flavors to meld and the cucumber to absorb the dressing.
steps.textZh: 拌好的黄瓜在室温下再静置 5–10 分钟，让味道融合并渗入黄瓜内部。

stateNote.visual: The bowl contains a light pooling of dressing; cucumber pieces have taken on a translucent, glossy appearance
stateNote.visualZh: 碗底有少量酱汁，黄瓜块呈半透明油亮状
stateNote.signal: Aroma of garlic and sesame is noticeable
stateNote.signalZh: 蒜香和香油香气明显

steps.text: Taste and adjust — need more salt? A pinch. More tang? A splash of Chinkiang vinegar. Transfer to a serving dish, garnish with extra scallion slices and a few toasted sesame seeds if desired. Serve immediately at room temperature.
steps.textZh: 尝味调整——咸了加点糖，淡了加点盐，酸了滴几滴醋。装盘，可额外撒葱花和熟白芝麻。室温立即上桌。

stateNote.visual: Plated cucumbers glisten; dressing has pooled lightly at the base; scallion greens provide color contrast
stateNote.visualZh: 黄瓜油亮，盘底有薄薄一层酱汁，葱花绿色提亮
stateNote.signal: The balance is sour-salty-savory with a garlic kick and sesame finish — no single note dominates
stateNote.signalZh: 酸、咸、鲜、蒜香、芝麻尾韵平衡，没有单一味道抢戏

tips: Never slice smashed cucumber — the cracks and fissures are what make it superior to a clean cut. A food processor will turn it to mush.
Use the best Chinkiang vinegar you can find. Good quality has a rounded, malty sourness; cheap versions are harsh and one-note.
This dish improves as it sits — make it 30 minutes before serving for maximum flavor penetration. Do not refrigerate; serve at cool room temperature.
Add a few drops of chili oil for heat, or a pinch of Sichuan peppercorn powder for the signature 'má' (numbing) sensation.
tipsZh: 千万别切——裂纹和裂缝才是拍黄瓜的灵魂，切出来的口感完全不同。料理机只会把它打成泥。
用最好的镇江香醋。好醋酸味圆润有麦芽香；廉价醋尖锐单一。
这道菜放久更入味——提前 30 分钟拌好风味最佳。不要冷藏，室温食用。
加几滴辣椒油提辣，或撒少许花椒粉，体验正宗「麻」感。

versionNote: The Xi'an way: boiled dumplings served in a tart, spicy broth instead of soy-vinegar dip. The family version uses store-bought dumplings and a quick broth — restaurant versions simmer the broth with dried shrimp and wood ear for hours.
versionNoteZh: 西安吃法：煮好的饺子泡在酸辣汤里，而不是蘸酱油醋。家常版用速冻饺子加快手汤底——餐厅版会用虾皮和木耳炖几小时。
story: In Xi'an, dumplings are eaten two ways: boiled with a dip, or 'sour soup' — swimming in a tart, spicy, garlicky broth that cuts through the rich pork filling. The soup is the whole point: black vinegar, chili oil, garlic, and cilantro bloomed in hot water, then the dumplings dive in. It's the perfect cold-weather bowl, and the ultimate use for frozen dumplings.
storyZh: 在西安，饺子有两种吃法：蘸料干吃，或者“酸汤”——泡在酸辣鲜香的汤里，正好解猪肉馅的油腻。汤才是主角：香醋、辣椒油、蒜和香菜用热水冲开，再把饺子放进去。这是完美的冬日一碗，也是速冻饺子的终极归宿。

ingredients.note: Pork-and-chive or pork-and-cabbage work best — the sour soup balances rich fillings.
ingredients.noteZh: 猪肉韭菜或猪肉白菜馅最搭——酸汤正好解腻。

steps.text: Make the soup base: in each serving bowl, combine vinegar, chili oil, garlic, soy, white pepper, and a pinch of salt. Set aside.
steps.textZh: 调汤底：每个碗里放香醋、辣椒油、蒜末、生抽、白胡椒和一小撮盐。备用。

stateNote.visual: Bowl bottom is layered with dark vinegar and red chili oil
stateNote.visualZh: 碗底是深色醋和红辣椒油的分层
stateNote.signal: Chili oil sediment is included — that's the flavor
stateNote.signalZh: 辣椒油带底料——那才是风味

steps.text: Boil a large pot of water. Add the dumplings in a single layer, stir gently once to prevent sticking.
steps.textZh: 大锅水烧开，饺子单层下锅，轻轻推一下防粘。

stateNote.visual: Dumplings sink, then bob to the surface as they cook
stateNote.visualZh: 饺子先沉底，煮熟后浮起
stateNote.signal: All dumplings float — nearly done
stateNote.signalZh: 饺子全部浮起——快熟了

steps.text: When the dumplings float, add 1/2 cup cold water and wait for the second boil. Add cold water again once more (the 'three boils' method).
steps.textZh: 饺子浮起后点入半杯凉水，等再次烧开。再点一次（“三开三点”法）。

stateNote.visual: Water settles briefly, then re-boils vigorously
stateNote.visualZh: 水短暂平静，随后再次剧烈沸腾
stateNote.signal: Press a dumpling — it springs back (fully cooked)
stateNote.signalZh: 按压饺子——回弹说明熟透

steps.text: Ladle 1 cup of the hot dumpling water into each bowl and stir — the chili oil blooms and the garlic perfumes the broth.
steps.textZh: 每碗舀入 1 杯煮饺子的热汤，搅匀——辣椒油化开，蒜香被激发。

stateNote.visual: Soup turns cloudy red-orange, glossy with oil droplets
stateNote.visualZh: 汤色变成浑浊的橘红，浮着油亮的油滴
stateNote.signal: The broth smells sharply sour and garlicky
stateNote.signalZh: 汤闻起来酸香扑鼻带蒜香

steps.text: Transfer the dumplings into the soup. Top with cilantro and scallions, drizzle sesame oil, and serve piping hot.
steps.textZh: 把饺子捞进汤里。撒香菜和葱花，淋香油，趁热上桌。

stateNote.visual: Dumplings half-submerged in red broth, greens on top
stateNote.visualZh: 饺子半浸在红汤里，上面点缀绿色香菜葱花
stateNote.signal: Soup is still steaming — serve now
stateNote.signalZh: 汤还冒着热气——立刻上桌

tips: The dumpling water is the secret broth — don't use plain water, it carries starch and seasoning.
Use vinegar with real sourness; rice vinegar is too mild for this soup.
The 'three boils' method guarantees fully cooked, never-burst dumplings.
Double the soup base if you like it tart and punchy, Xi'an street-food style.
tipsZh: 煮饺子的水就是秘密汤底——别用清水，它带着淀粉和鲜味。
要用有酸度的香醋；米醋太淡，撑不起这碗汤。
“三开三点”保证饺子熟透且不破皮。
喜欢浓烈酸辣就翻倍汤底，西安街头风味。

versionNote: The soy-braise method (jiangyou jian): wings simmered in a soy, sugar, and ginger broth until the sauce turns dark and lacquered. The family version is one pot, no marinating. Cantonese restaurants add star anise and a piece of dried tangerine peel for extra depth.
versionNoteZh: 酱油煎法：鸡翅在酱油、糖和姜的汤汁里焖到酱色深亮。家常版一锅搞定，不用腌。粤式餐厅会加八角和一块陈皮增香。
story: Soy-braised chicken wings are the dish that taught a generation of Chinese kids that soy sauce is a superpower. Four ingredients — wings, soy, sugar, ginger — and thirty minutes later you have glossy, dark, finger-licking wings that taste like they came from a restaurant. It's the older, less famous sibling of coke chicken wings, and many would argue it's better.
storyZh: 酱油鸡翅是让一代中国小孩见识到“生抽是超能力”的菜。四种原料——鸡翅、酱油、糖、姜——三十分钟后就是油亮深棕、舔手指的鸡翅，味道像从餐厅端出来的。它是可乐鸡翅年长且低调的兄弟，很多人认为它更好吃。

ingredients.note: Pat dry. Score each wing once on both sides so the soy penetrates.
ingredients.noteZh: 擦干。两面各划一刀，方便入味。

steps.text: Pat wings dry and score. Have the sauce ready: soy, dark soy, sugar, Shaoxing, and 1 cup warm water mixed.
steps.textZh: 鸡翅擦干划刀。调好酱汁：生抽、老抽、糖、料酒和 1 杯温水拌匀。

stateNote.visual: Sauce is a uniform deep brown; sugar dissolved
stateNote.visualZh: 酱汁呈均匀深棕色；糖已融化
stateNote.signal: No sugar grains at the bottom
stateNote.signalZh: 杯底没有糖粒

steps.text: Heat a wide pan over medium-high. Sear the wings skin-side down in one layer until golden, about 3 minutes per side. Don't crowd.
steps.textZh: 宽锅中大火加热。鸡翅皮朝下单层煎至金黄，每面约 3 分钟。不要挤在一起。

stateNote.visual: Skin is golden with brown edges; renders some fat
stateNote.visualZh: 鸡皮金黄、边缘微棕；逼出部分油脂
stateNote.signal: Wings release easily from the pan
stateNote.signalZh: 鸡翅轻松脱离锅底

steps.text: Add ginger, scallions, and star anise (if using). Stir 30 seconds until fragrant.
steps.textZh: 下姜片、葱段和八角（如果用），翻炒 30 秒出香。

stateNote.visual: Aromatics sizzle and perfume the oil
stateNote.visualZh: 香料滋滋作响，油里渗入香气
stateNote.signal: Ginger smells warm and pungent
stateNote.signalZh: 姜香温暖辛辣

steps.text: Pour in the sauce. It should come about halfway up the wings. Boil, then reduce to medium-low, cover, and simmer 12 minutes.
steps.textZh: 倒入酱汁，大约到鸡翅一半高度。烧开转中小火，盖盖焖 12 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Liquid bubbles gently; wings absorb the color
stateNote.visualZh: 汤汁轻轻冒泡；鸡翅开始上色
stateNote.signal: The sauce has reduced visibly; wings look bronzed
stateNote.signalZh: 汤汁明显变少；鸡翅呈古铜色

steps.text: Uncover, turn the wings, and simmer uncovered 8 minutes, spooning sauce over them, until the sauce is glossy and clings.
steps.textZh: 开盖翻面，不盖盖再煮 8 分钟，不断把汁淋到鸡翅上，直到酱汁油亮挂翅。

stateNote.visual: Sauce is thick, dark, and lacquered on the wings
stateNote.visualZh: 酱汁浓稠深色，像漆一样挂在鸡翅上
stateNote.signal: A spatula trail in the sauce holds for 2 seconds
stateNote.signalZh: 锅铲划过酱汁，划痕保持 2 秒

steps.text: Off heat, drizzle sesame oil and toss once. Serve hot with rice — spoon the remaining sauce over.
steps.textZh: 关火，淋香油翻一下。配米饭上桌，把剩余酱汁浇在饭上。

stateNote.visual: Wings are deep mahogany, glossy, sticky-sweet looking
stateNote.visualZh: 鸡翅深红棕、油亮，看起来甜糯
stateNote.signal: Sauce coats the wings and the rice beautifully
stateNote.signalZh: 酱汁挂在鸡翅上，浇在饭上很好看

tips: Dry wings + hot pan = golden skin. Wet wings steam instead.
Dark soy is for color, light soy for flavor — don't swap them.
The sauce reduces fast at the end; stay near the pan.
Double the wings and sauce — leftovers make the best cold snack.
tipsZh: 鸡翅擦干+热锅=金黄鸡皮。带水只会蒸。
老抽上色、生抽调味——别互换。
最后收汁很快，别离开锅边。
翻倍做——剩的凉着吃是最好吃的零食。

titleEn: Spicy Sour Potato Shreds (酸辣土豆丝)
versionNote: The restaurant trick is rinsing and soaking the shredded potatoes so the starch washes away — this is what makes them stay crisp instead of turning to mush. The family version does the same rinse in a bowl; restaurant woks do it with a faster, hotter toss.
versionNoteZh: 餐厅的秘诀是土豆丝切后反复冲洗泡水，洗掉淀粉——这是它保持脆爽不黏糊的关键。家常版同样泡水；餐厅版靠更旺的火和更快的翻炒。
story: Spicy sour potato shreds is the cheapest dish in every Sichuan restaurant and often the most ordered — a plate of thin, crisp potato threads tossed with dried chilies and black vinegar until they're spicy, sour, and impossibly crunchy. The whole dish is a technique test: can you cut thin enough, rinse enough, and wok-hot enough to keep the potatoes crisp? At home, it's the ten-minute dinner.
storyZh: 酸辣土豆丝是每家川菜馆最便宜的菜，也往往是最多人点的——一盘细脆的土豆丝，配干辣椒和香醋炒到酸辣、爽脆得不可思议。整道菜是技术测验：切得够不够细、洗得够不够净、锅够不够热，决定土豆丝脆不脆。在家，它是十分钟晚餐。

ingredients.note: Starchy potatoes shred cleaner. The peeling is optional — skin adds texture.
ingredients.noteZh: 面土豆切丝更利落。皮可削可不削，带皮口感更丰富。

ingredients.nameEn: dried red chilies, cut into 1 cm pieces

steps.text: Peel (optional) and cut the potatoes into thin matchsticks — about 3 mm. Work quickly; the potatoes brown fast.
steps.textZh: 土豆削皮（可选）切成约 3 毫米的细丝。动作要快，土豆很快会氧化变黄。

stateNote.visual: Shreds are even, matchstick-thin, and similar in size
stateNote.visualZh: 土豆丝粗细均匀，火柴棍般粗细
stateNote.signal: The thickest shred is about 3 mm — not chunky
stateNote.signalZh: 最粗的丝约 3 毫米——没有粗块

steps.text: Rinse the shreds in cold water 3 times, then soak in fresh cold water 5 minutes. Drain and pat dry — the water should run clear.
steps.textZh: 土豆丝冷水冲洗 3 遍，再换清水泡 5 分钟。沥干拍干——水要洗到变清。

stateNote.visual: Water goes from cloudy white to clear; shreds turn crisp
stateNote.visualZh: 水从乳白变清澈；土豆丝变得挺脆
stateNote.timeRefZh: 冲洗 3 遍 + 泡 5 分钟
stateNote.signal: The last rinse water is almost clear — starch is gone
stateNote.signalZh: 最后一遍水几乎清澈——淀粉洗掉了

steps.text: Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Add Sichuan peppercorns and fry 15 seconds until fragrant — then remove them (optional, or leave for extra numbing).
steps.textZh: 锅放油大火加热。下花椒炸 15 秒出香——然后捞出（可选，想更麻就留着）。

stateNote.visual: Peppercorns sizzle and the oil turns fragrant
stateNote.visualZh: 花椒滋滋作响，油变香
stateNote.signal: Sharp peppery aroma — before they blacken
stateNote.signalZh: 尖锐的麻香——在花椒变黑之前

steps.text: Add chilies and garlic. Stir 10 seconds until the chilies are fragrant and glossy (don't burn them).
steps.textZh: 下干辣椒段和蒜片，炒 10 秒到辣椒出香油亮（别炒糊）。

stateNote.visual: Chilies turn glossy dark red; oil takes on red tint
stateNote.visualZh: 辣椒变油亮深红；油色泛红
stateNote.signal: Spicy aroma hits — before smoke
stateNote.signalZh: 香辣扑鼻——在冒烟之前

steps.text: Add the potato shreds. Stir-fry over high heat 2 minutes — keep them moving so they cook evenly without sticking.
steps.textZh: 下土豆丝，大火翻炒 2 分钟——不停翻动，让它们均匀受热不粘锅。

stateNote.visual: Shreds turn slightly translucent and glossy
stateNote.visualZh: 土豆丝变得微微半透明、油亮
stateNote.signal: Shreds bend without breaking — tender-crisp
stateNote.signalZh: 土豆丝能弯不断——脆嫩

steps.text: Pour the vinegar along the wok wall — it will sizzle. Add salt and scallion greens. Toss 30 seconds and serve immediately while still crisp.
steps.textZh: 沿锅边烹入香醋——会滋啦响。加盐和葱花，翻炒 30 秒，趁脆立刻上桌。

stateNote.visual: Shreds are glossy, evenly coated, with chili flecks
stateNote.visualZh: 土豆丝油亮均匀，点缀辣椒碎
stateNote.signal: They still snap when bitten — stop cooking now
stateNote.signalZh: 咬下去还是脆的——立即出锅

tips: The rinse is non-negotiable — starch is what turns potatoes to glue.
Vinegar on the hot wok wall, not on the potatoes: it caramelizes and wakes up.
High heat, short time. Crisp shreds are a speed contest.
For extra numbing, crush 1/2 tsp Sichuan peppercorns and add with the salt.
tipsZh: 冲洗不能省——淀粉就是土豆变黏的元凶。
醋要沿锅边烹——在热锅壁上焦化激活，而不是直接倒菜上。
大火短时。脆土豆丝是一场速度赛。
想更麻：压碎半茶匙花椒和盐一起下。

versionNote: Simple stir-fry with just garlic and salt — let the bok choy's natural sweetness shine. No sauces, no cornstarch, no fuss.
versionNoteZh: 只用蒜和盐简单快炒——突出小白菜本身的清甜。不加酱、不勾芡、不折腾。
story: Bok choy is the workhorse of Chinese home cooking — mild, sweet, and forgiving. This simplest version, stir-fried with just garlic and a pinch of salt, is what millions of Chinese families make on weeknights when they want something healthy in under 10 minutes. The key is high heat and not overcooking.
storyZh: 小白菜是中国家常菜里的劳模——温和、清甜、不挑剔。最简单的蒜蓉清炒版，是无数中国家庭工作日里的必选项：10 分钟内搞定一盘健康青菜。关键是大火、不炒过头。

ingredients.note: Baby bok choy is best — small, tender heads. If using mature bok choy, cut each head in half lengthwise.
ingredients.noteZh: 幼小白菜最佳——小巧嫩甜。如果用大棵白菜，纵向对半切。

steps.text: Cut each bok choy lengthwise in half (or quarters if large). Separate the white stems from the green leaves if possible — they cook at different rates. Soak in cold water for 2 minutes to remove any sand, then drain well.
steps.textZh: 每棵小白菜纵向对半切（大的切四半）。白茎和绿叶尽量分开——熟成时间不同。冷水浸泡 2 分钟去沙，然后沥干。

stateNote.visual: Cut surfaces are clean white (stems) and deep green (leaves), no brown or slimy spots
stateNote.visualZh: 切面洁白（菜帮）和深绿（叶片），无褐变或黏滑处
stateNote.signal: Water should run clear after soaking — no grit at the bottom
stateNote.signalZh: 浸泡后水要清澈——杯底无沙

steps.tip: If you're in a rush, skip the soak and just rinse thoroughly under running water while separating the halves.
steps.tipZh: 赶时间可以跳过浸泡，直接流水冲洗同时掰开。

steps.text: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until shimmering. Add minced garlic and stir for 5 seconds until fragrant.
steps.textZh: 大火热锅至油微微冒烟。下蒜末快速翻炒 5 秒至出香。

stateNote.visual: Garlic sizzles and aroma fills the kitchen in seconds
stateNote.visualZh: 蒜末滋滋作响，几秒内厨房充满蒜香
stateNote.signal: Golden around the edges but NOT brown — burned garlic is bitter
stateNote.signalZh: 边缘微金但**绝不发黑**——焦蒜是苦的

steps.text: Add the bok choy stems first (they take longer). Stir-fry for 1 minute, then add the leaves. Toss constantly for another 60-90 seconds.
steps.textZh: 先下菜帮部分（更耐煮）。快炒 1 分钟，再下菜叶。继续颠炒 60-90 秒。

stateNote.visual: Stems turn translucent at the edges, leaves begin to wilt and darken
stateNote.visualZh: 菜帮边缘变半透明，叶片开始塌软、颜色变深
stateNote.signal: Stems are tender-crisp (bite through with no resistance but still snap) — this is the target texture
stateNote.signalZh: 菜帮断生但有脆感——咬下去不费力但仍有断裂声——这就是目标口感

steps.text: Sprinkle salt evenly over the greens. Toss for 20 seconds to distribute. If using white pepper, add it now.
steps.textZh: 均匀撒盐。颠炒 20 秒让盐分布均匀。如果用白胡椒粉，此时加入。

steps.text: If using sesame oil, drizzle it around the edge of the wok (not directly on the vegetables) and toss once more for 10 seconds.
steps.textZh: 如果用香油，沿锅边淋入——不要直接浇在菜上——再颠炒 10 秒。

stateNote.visual: Leaves are glossy and vibrant green, stems still hold their shape
stateNote.visualZh: 叶片油亮翠绿，菜帮仍保持形状
stateNote.signal: Vegetables look alive — if they're dark and slimy, you've过火了
stateNote.signalZh: 青菜看着有生命力——如果发暗发黏就是炒过头了

steps.text: Serve immediately. The residual heat in the wok will continue cooking, so don't let it sit.
steps.textZh: 立刻上桌。锅的余温会继续烹饪，不要让菜在锅里久放。

tips: The golden rule: high heat, short time. Bok choy releases water quickly — if you cook it slowly, it steams in its own liquid and becomes soggy.
Salt at the very end, not the beginning. Early salting draws out moisture and makes the dish watery.
This dish is naturally vegan and gluten-free. Skip the optional sesame oil if you're strict about it.
Pair with any rice dish — the clean, crisp green cuts through richer mains beautifully.
tipsZh: 黄金法则：大火、短时间。小白菜出水很快——慢慢炒就是在自己出的水里蒸，会变软塌。
盐最后放，不要一开始就放。早放盐会出水，菜汤水汪汪的。
这道菜天然纯素无麸质。严格控制的话跳过香油。
配任何米饭都很棒——清脆的青菜能解腻。

titleEn: Sweet and Sour Pork (糖醋里脊)
versionNote: 家庭快手版，糖醋汁一次调好，裹粉快炸。餐厅版会先复炸一次让外壳更脆。
versionNoteZh: 家庭快手版，糖醋汁一次调好，裹粉快炸。餐厅版会先复炸一次让外壳更脆。
story: Sweet and sour pork is the dish that introduced Chinese food to the West. The real Chinese version is not the thick orange glaze of American takeout — it is a bright, tangy-sweet balance with a thin crispy crust. This home version uses a quick cornstarch coating and a pan-made sauce that comes together in minutes.
storyZh: 糖醋里脊是向西方介绍中餐的代表菜。正宗中式做法不是美式外卖那种浓稠的橙色酱汁——它是明亮酸甜、外壳薄脆的平衡风味。这份家常快手版用玉米淀粉薄裹，酱汁现调现烹。

ingredients.nameEn: pork tenderloin or loin, cut into 2 cm strips
ingredients.nameZh: 猪里脊或梅花肉，切 2cm 长条

steps.text: Cut pork into 2 cm strips. Pat dry with paper towels — surface moisture is the enemy of crispy coating.
steps.textZh: 猪里脊切 2cm 长条，用厨房纸吸干表面水分——水分是脆壳的大敌。

stateNote.visual: Surface looks matte, not wet or glossy
stateNote.visualZh: 表面呈哑光，不反光
stateNote.signal: No liquid beads on meat
stateNote.signalZh: 肉表面无水珠

steps.text: Marinate pork: toss with soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, and white pepper. Rest 10 minutes.
steps.textZh: 腌制：加生抽、料酒、白胡椒抓匀。静置 10 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Meat glistens, liquid absorbed
stateNote.visualZh: 肉表面挂汁，液体已被吸收
stateNote.signal: No free liquid in the bowl
stateNote.signalZh: 碗底无游离液体

steps.text: Make the coating: mix cornstarch and flour in a shallow bowl. Dredge each strip, shaking off excess.
steps.textZh: 裹粉：将玉米淀粉和中筋面粉混合铺平。逐条裹粉，抖掉多余粉。

stateNote.visual: Each strip has a thin powdery white coat, no clumps
stateNote.visualZh: 每根条均匀裹上薄薄白粉，无结块
stateNote.signal: Coating looks dry, not pasty
stateNote.signalZh: 粉层干燥，不呈糊状

steps.text: Mix the sweet and sour sauce in a small bowl: vinegar, sugar, ketchup, and 2 tbsp water. Stir until sugar dissolves.
steps.textZh: 调糖醋汁：香醋、糖、番茄酱、2 汤匙清水搅匀至糖融化。

stateNote.visual: Sauce is pink-orange, uniform, no sugar granules visible
stateNote.visualZh: 汁呈粉橙色均匀，无糖粒
stateNote.signal: Spoon leaves a clean trail
stateNote.signalZh: 勺背划过碗底无糖粒残留

steps.text: Heat oil to 170°C — a wooden chopstick inserted should bubble steadily around it. Fry pork in batches 2-3 minutes until golden. Remove and drain.
steps.textZh: 油烧至 170 度，筷子插入冒细密气泡。分批炸 2-3 分钟至金黄，捞出沥油。

stateNote.visual: Coating turns golden, bubbles slow down
stateNote.visualZh: 外壳金黄，气泡变缓
stateNote.signal: Floats to surface, crust set
stateNote.signalZh: 浮起，外壳定型

steps.text: In a wok, pour in the sauce. Bring to a simmer over medium heat. When it thickens (about 30 seconds), add the fried pork. Toss quickly 10 seconds to coat — do NOT over-stir or the crust will soften.
steps.textZh: 锅中倒入糖醋汁，中火煮至微稠（约 30 秒）。下炸好的肉条，快速翻 10 秒裹匀——不要久翻，否则脆壳变软。

stateNote.visual: Sauce becomes glossy and clings to pork, no pooling
stateNote.visualZh: 汁变亮且挂在肉上，锅底无积液
stateNote.signal: Sauce coats a spoon cleanly, trail holds
stateNote.signalZh: 勺背挂汁清晰，划痕不立即消失

steps.text: Serve immediately on a warm plate. The crust stays crispy for about 2 minutes after saucing.
steps.textZh: 趁热上桌。裹汁后脆壳保持约 2 分钟最佳口感。

stateNote.visual: Steam rises, glaze has a satin sheen
stateNote.visualZh: 热气升腾，釉面有缎光
stateNote.signal: Eaten within 2 minutes for best crunch
stateNote.signalZh: 2 分钟内吃完口感最佳

tips: The key to crispy sweet and sour pork is double-frying: first fry at 160°C to cook through, then fry again at 180°C right before saucing for maximum crunch.
Do not skip the paper-towel step — wet meat equals soggy coating.
Chinese black vinegar (Chinkiang) gives the characteristic tang. Rice vinegar is a decent substitute if unavailable.
This dish pairs perfectly with egg fried rice and a simple stir-fried green vegetable.
tipsZh: 脆的关键是复炸：160 度初炸熟透，再 180 度复炸上色，最后裹汁。
肉条一定要吸干水分，否则裹粉会脱落、口感发软。
镇江香醋是灵魂，没有可用米醋替代，风味略逊。
搭配蛋炒饭和清炒时蔬，经典一餐。

versionNote: Northern Chinese comfort food — sweet-tart tomato broth with silky egg ribbons over wheat noodles. The tomato must be peeled and broken down into a sauce.
versionNoteZh: 北方家常 comfort food——酸甜番茄汤底配嫩滑蛋花，浇在小麦面上。番茄必须去皮并炒成酱。
story: Tomato egg noodles (番茄鸡蛋面) are the ultimate Northern Chinese comfort food — a simple one-bowl meal that tastes like home. The secret is breaking down the tomatoes into a rich, slightly sweet sauce that clings to the noodles, then swirling in silky egg ribbons. It is the dish every Chinese child learns to make.
storyZh: 番茄鸡蛋面是北方家常 comfort food 的终极代表——一碗暖心的家常味道。秘诀是把番茄炒化成浓稠微甜的酱汁裹住面条，再淋入嫩滑的蛋花。这是每个中国孩子学会做的第一道菜。

steps.text: Score an X on the bottom of each tomato and blanch in boiling water for 30 seconds. Transfer to ice water, then peel off the skin. Dice the tomatoes.
steps.textZh: 番茄底部划十字，沸水焯30秒后过冰水，去皮切丁。

stateNote.visual: Skin curls up at the corners and slips off easily
stateNote.visualZh: 皮边缘卷起，轻松剥落
stateNote.signal: Skin separates from flesh cleanly
stateNote.signalZh: 皮肉分离清晰

steps.text: Cook noodles in salted boiling water according to package directions. Reserve 1/2 cup noodle water, then drain.
steps.textZh: 面条沸水加盐煮熟，保留半杯面汤，沥干。

stateNote.visual: Noodles are tender but still firm (al dente)
stateNote.visualZh: 面条软但仍有弹性
stateNote.signal: No hard center when bitten
stateNote.signalZh: 咬开无硬芯

steps.text: Heat oil in a wok over medium-high. Pour in beaten eggs and scramble until just set but still soft. Remove and set aside.
steps.textZh: 锅中放油中大火加热。倒入蛋液，滑炒至刚凝固但仍嫩滑，盛出备用。

stateNote.visual: Eggs puff up and set in soft curds
stateNote.visualZh: 蛋液膨胀成软嫩块状
stateNote.signal: Eggs are 90% set but still glossy
stateNote.signalZh: 蛋九分熟，表面仍光亮

steps.text: In the same wok, add diced tomatoes. Cook 3-4 minutes, pressing against the wok to break them down into a sauce.
steps.textZh: 同锅下番茄丁，中火炒3-4分钟，用锅铲压碎成酱。

stateNote.visual: Tomatoes break down into a thick, saucy consistency
stateNote.visualZh: 番茄炒化成浓稠酱汁
stateNote.signal: Oils separate and surface glistens
stateNote.signalZh: 番茄油析出，表面泛油光

steps.text: Add noodle water, soy sauce, and sugar. Bring to a boil, then add noodles and scrambled eggs. Toss to coat.
steps.textZh: 加入面汤、生抽、糖，烧开。下面条和炒蛋，翻匀。

stateNote.visual: Sauce thickens and coats noodles evenly
stateNote.visualZh: 酱汁变浓裹住面条
stateNote.signal: Sauce clings to noodles, no pooling
stateNote.signalZh: 酱汁挂面，锅底无积液

steps.text: Garnish with scallions. Serve immediately in deep bowls.
steps.textZh: 撒葱花，深碗上桌。

stateNote.visual: Steam rises, sauce glossy, eggs golden
stateNote.visualZh: 热气升腾，酱汁光亮，蛋金黄
stateNote.signal: Eat immediately for best texture
stateNote.signalZh: 立即食用口感最佳

tips: Use very ripe tomatoes — they are sweeter and break down easier.
Reserve the noodle water — the starch helps thicken the sauce naturally.
Do not overcook the eggs — they finish cooking in the sauce.
This dish is naturally gluten-free if you use GF noodles.
tipsZh: 用熟透的番茄——更甜更易化开。
保留面汤——淀粉帮助自然浓稠酱汁。
不要炒老蛋——它们在酱汁里还会继续熟。
如果用无麸质面条，这道菜天生无麸质。

versionNote: Family version: soft, saucy, slightly sweet — the way it's made at home. Restaurant version adds a wok-seared egg texture.
versionNoteZh: 家庭版：鸡蛋软嫩、汤汁浓郁、微甜——家里最常做的做法。餐厅版会多一道过油炒蛋的焦香口感。
story: The first dish most Chinese kids learn. Every family has its own ratio of eggs to tomato, its own pinch of sugar. This is the home-style version from a Cantonese household — lots of sauce, soft eggs, ladled over rice.
storyZh: 大多数中国孩子学会的第一道菜。每个家庭都有自己的蛋液番茄比例，都有自己的那撮糖。这是一份来自广东家庭的快手做法——汤汁多、鸡蛋嫩，浇在米饭上就是一顿。

ingredients.note: Balances tomato acidity — this is the 'secret' home touch.
ingredients.noteZh: 中和番茄的酸味——这是家常版的“秘诀”。

steps.text: Beat the eggs with 1/4 tsp salt until the yolks are fully broken. Cut tomatoes into bite-size wedges.
steps.textZh: 鸡蛋加 1/4 茶匙盐打散，直到蛋黄完全打匀。番茄切成一口大小的块。

stateNote.visual: Egg liquid is uniform pale yellow with no visible yolk streaks
stateNote.visualZh: 蛋液呈均匀的淡黄色，无明显蛋黄纹路
stateNote.signal: Fork leaves a smooth ribbon when lifted
stateNote.signalZh: 提起叉子时蛋液呈顺滑带状流下

steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high until shimmering. Pour in the eggs.
steps.textZh: 锅中放 2 汤匙油，中大火加热至油面微微波动。倒入蛋液。

stateNote.visual: Oil shimmers; eggs puff and set at the edges within seconds
stateNote.visualZh: 油面泛光；蛋液边缘几秒内鼓起凝固
stateNote.signal: Edges turn light golden and release easily from the pan
stateNote.signalZh: 边缘变浅金色，且能轻松从锅底脱离

steps.text: Scramble the eggs just until softly set (still a little glossy), then scoop them out onto a plate. Don't overcook — they finish in the sauce.
steps.textZh: 把鸡蛋炒到刚刚凝固（还带一点光泽）就盛出装盘。不要炒过头——之后还要回锅裹汁。

stateNote.visual: Curds are soft and glossy, not dry or browned
stateNote.visualZh: 蛋块软嫩有光泽，不干不焦
stateNote.signal: No raw liquid left, but curds still look moist
stateNote.signalZh: 没有生蛋液残留，但蛋块依然湿润

steps.text: Add the remaining 1 tbsp oil and the tomatoes with 1/4 tsp salt. Sauté over medium-high.
steps.textZh: 加入剩余 1 汤匙油和番茄，放 1/4 茶匙盐，中大火翻炒。

stateNote.visual: Tomatoes release juice and start to soften
stateNote.visualZh: 番茄出汁并开始变软
stateNote.signal: Edges go translucent and the pan fills with pink juice
stateNote.signalZh: 边缘变半透明，锅里出现粉红色汤汁

steps.text: Press a few wedges with your spatula to release more juice. Add the sugar (and soy, if using).
steps.textZh: 用锅铲按压几块番茄挤出更多汤汁。加入白糖（以及生抽，如果用的话）。

stateNote.visual: Sauce turns glossy deep-orange
stateNote.visualZh: 汤汁变成有光泽的深橙色
stateNote.signal: Juice is actively bubbling, not evaporating to dryness
stateNote.signalZh: 汤汁在冒泡，而不是被烧干

steps.text: Return the eggs to the pan and toss gently for 20 seconds so they soak up the sauce. Finish with scallions.
steps.textZh: 把鸡蛋倒回锅中，轻轻翻炒 20 秒让蛋块裹上汤汁。最后撒上葱花。

stateNote.visual: Eggs are coated in glossy orange sauce
stateNote.visualZh: 蛋块裹满光泽的橙色汤汁
stateNote.signal: Sauce clings to the egg curds
stateNote.signalZh: 汤汁挂在蛋块上

tips: Serve immediately over steamed rice — the sauce is the point.
Ripe, soft tomatoes make the best sauce. If tomatoes are hard, add 2 tbsp water while cooking.
The sugar is not optional in the home version: it's what makes it taste like 家常, not sour.
tipsZh: 趁热浇在白米饭上——汤汁才是灵魂。
熟透的软番茄才能炒出好汤汁。番茄偏硬时，烹制中加 2 汤匙水。
家常版里糖不能省：正是它让这道菜尝起来是“家常味”而不是酸味。

versionNote: 家庭快手版——用现成卤肉快速回锅，周末家常味。
versionNoteZh: 家庭快手版——用现成卤肉快速回锅，周末家常味。
story: Twice-cooked pork is a Sichuan home-cooking legend. Thinly sliced pre-boiled pork belly is pan-fried until the edges curl and caramelize, then tossed with garlic sprouts and doubanjiang. My grandmother made this every Sunday — the house would fill with that smoky, spicy aroma that made everyone rush to the table.
storyZh: 回锅肉是川菜家常菜的传奇。薄切的卤五花肉在锅里煎到边缘卷曲焦糖化，再加入蒜苗和豆瓣酱快炒。我阿嬷每个星期天都会做这道菜——整栋房子都会充满那种烟熏辣香，让人忍不住冲向饭桌。

ingredients.nameZh: 五花肉（预先卤过或叉烧）

steps.text: Slice the pre-boiled pork belly into thin strips about 5 cm long and 2 mm thick. Slice the garlic sprouts on the diagonal into 3 cm pieces, separating the white and green parts.
steps.textZh: 将预先卤好的五花肉切成约 5 厘米长、2 毫米薄的片。蒜苗斜切成 3 厘米段，白色和绿色部分分开。

stateNote.visual: pork slices translucent at edges
stateNote.signal: ready to fry

steps.text: Heat the wok over medium-high heat with cooking oil. Add the pork slices in a single layer and fry without stirring for 1 minute until the bottom is golden and slightly crispy.
steps.textZh: 热锅下油，中大火将五花肉片平铺入锅，不要翻动，煎 1 分钟至底部金黄微脆。

stateNote.visual: golden edges curling up
stateNote.signal: sizzling sound

steps.text: Stir the pork, push to one side. Add doubanjiang to the empty side and fry for 10 seconds until the oil turns red. Add ginger, garlic, and the white parts of garlic sprouts.
steps.textZh: 翻炒猪肉，推到一边。在空出的位置加入豆瓣酱炒 10 秒至红油析出。加入姜、蒜和蒜苗白色部分。

stateNote.visual: oil turning deep red
stateNote.signal: aromatic

steps.text: Pour in shaoxing wine, light soy sauce, and dark soy sauce. Toss everything together for 30 seconds.
steps.textZh: 倒入绍兴酒、生抽和老抽，翻炒 30 秒让酱料均匀裹上肉片。

stateNote.visual: sauce coating evenly
stateNote.signal: bubbling

steps.text: Add the green parts of garlic sprouts and sugar. Stir-fry for another 30 seconds until the greens are wilted but still crisp. Serve immediately.
steps.textZh: 加入蒜苗绿色部分和白糖，再翻炒 30 秒，绿色部分软化但仍保持脆感即可出锅。

stateNote.visual: greens glossy and wilted
stateNote.signal: ready

tips: Use pre-boiled pork belly (卤五花肉) from the Asian supermarket — saves 40 minutes vs. boiling from raw.
The key is high heat and quick cooking — this dish should take no more than 5 minutes of actual wok time after prep.
Garlic sprouts (蒜苗) are different from scallions — they have a thicker white stem and flat green leaves. If unavailable, use thick-stemmed scallions.
tipsZh: 使用亚超卖的预先卤好的五花肉——比从零卤节省 40 分钟。
秘诀是猛火快炒——实际锅上时间不超过 5 分钟。
蒜苗和小葱不同——蒜苗有更粗的白色茎和扁平的绿色叶子。买不到可用粗杆小葱代替。

titleEn: Vinegar Cabbage (醋溜白菜) — Northeastern Sweet-Sour Stir-Fry
versionNote: Home-style: thick cabbage leaves torn by hand, stir-fried fast with a sweet-sour glaze. Restaurant version sometimes uses cornstarch slurry for a glossy finish.
versionNoteZh: 家常版：手撕厚叶白菜，快炒酸甜汁。餐馆版有时勾薄芡增加光泽。
story: 醋溜白菜 is a Northern Chinese comfort food that turns humble napa cabbage into something bright, tangy, and deeply satisfying. The key is tearing the cabbage by hand (never cutting — torn edges caramelize better) and fighting the vinegar's acidity with a touch of sugar. It is the dish your Northeastern grandmother makes when she wants to turn winter stash into a summer-tasting plate.
storyZh: 醋溜白菜是北方家常菜的代表——用便宜的白菜做出明亮酸甜的口感。关键用手撕（不用刀切——撕的边更入味），再用少许糖中和醋的尖锐酸。这是东北奶奶用白菜囤货变出夏日口感的拿手菜。

ingredients.note: Use the thick white stems and tender green leaves. Tear into 5-cm pieces by hand — do not cut with a knife.
ingredients.noteZh: 选用厚帮和嫩叶，用手撕成 5 厘米块——不要用刀切，手撕的毛边更易入味。

ingredients.note: The backbone of this dish. Do not substitute with rice vinegar — the malty depth of Chinkiang is essential.
ingredients.noteZh: 这道菜的灵魂。不可用米醋替代——镇江醋的醇厚是关键。

ingredients.note: Balances the vinegar's sharpness. Adjust to taste — Northern style leans sweet.
ingredients.noteZh: 中和醋的尖锐酸。北方偏甜口，可依口味调整。

ingredients.note: Adds savory depth without overwhelming the sour-sweet balance.
ingredients.noteZh: 提鲜增味，不破坏酸甜平衡。

ingredients.note: Thin slices, not minced — slices release flavor more gently.
ingredients.noteZh: 切薄片而非蒜末——薄片味道释放更温和。

ingredients.note: Finish with a drizzle for fragrance.
ingredients.noteZh: 出锅前淋入增香。

steps.text: Prepare cabbage. Tear napa cabbage into 5-cm pieces by hand, separating thick white stems from green leaves. Set aside separately — stems cook slower than leaves.
steps.textZh: 处理白菜。手撕成 5 厘米块，将厚白帮和嫩绿叶分开——帮子比叶子难熟，需分先后下锅。

stateNote.visual: 白菜帮呈半透明乳白，叶片翠绿带自然褶皱
stateNote.visualZh: 白菜帮呈半透明乳白，叶片翠绿带自然褶皱
stateNote.signal: 手撕的边缘比刀切的更粗糙，更易吸附酱汁
stateNote.signalZh: 手撕边缘比刀切更粗糙，更易吸附酱汁

steps.text: Heat wok on high. Add oil and swirl. Add garlic slices; stir 5 seconds until fragrant.
steps.textZh: 大火烧热锅，倒入食用油滑锅，下蒜片快速翻炒 5 秒至出香。

stateNote.visual: 蒜片边缘微微金黄，满屋蒜香
stateNote.visualZh: 蒜片边缘微微金黄，满屋蒜香
stateNote.signal: 蒜片变金黄立即下白菜帮，不可等蒜变焦苦
stateNote.signalZh: 蒜片变金黄立即下白菜帮，不可等蒜变焦苦

steps.text: Add cabbage stems first. Stir-fry 1 minute on high heat until edges begin to soften but still crisp.
steps.textZh: 先下白菜帮，大火翻炒 1 分钟——边缘开始变软但仍有脆度。

stateNote.visual: 白菜帮边缘开始半透明，叶片仍保持翠绿
stateNote.visualZh: 白菜帮边缘开始半透明，叶片仍保持翠绿
stateNote.signal: 帮子变软但未塌——此时下叶片
stateNote.signalZh: 帮子变软但未塌——此时下叶片

steps.text: Add cabbage leaves. Pour vinegar and soy sauce along the wok wall. Toss vigorously for 30 seconds — the leaves should wilt but not turn to mush.
steps.textZh: 下白菜叶，沿锅边淋入醋和生抽，大火快速翻炒 30 秒——叶子要软但不塌烂。

stateNote.visual: 叶片塌软但仍保持完整形态，呈半透明翠绿色
stateNote.visualZh: 叶片塌软但仍保持完整形态，呈半透明翠绿色
stateNote.signal: 叶片变软但仍有光泽——此时撒糖
stateNote.signalZh: 叶片变软但仍有光泽——此时撒糖

steps.text: Sprinkle sugar, toss 15 seconds to dissolve and coat. Drizzle sesame oil, give one final toss, and plate immediately.
steps.textZh: 撒白糖，翻炒 15 秒让糖融化裹匀。淋香油，最后翻一次立即出锅。

stateNote.visual: 糖融化后酱汁变稠亮，包裹每片白菜
stateNote.visualZh: 糖融化后酱汁变稠亮，包裹每片白菜
stateNote.signal: 糖完全融化、酱汁微微冒泡即可出锅
stateNote.signalZh: 糖完全融化、酱汁微微冒泡即可出锅

steps.tip: Do not overcook — napa cabbage releases water and turns soupy if cooked too long.
steps.tipZh: 不可久炒——白菜出水会变汤汤水水，失去口感。

tips: Tear, do not cut — torn edges absorb the sweet-sour glaze better.
Stems first, leaves second. This ensures even cooking.
Vinegar on the wok wall, not on the cabbage — this creates the caramelized sour note.
Serve immediately. Cabbage continues releasing water after plating.
tipsZh: 手撕而非刀切——撕的毛边更吸汁。
先下帮后下叶——确保均匀受热。
醋沿锅边淋——产生焦糖化的酸香。
立即上桌——白菜出锅后还会继续出水。

versionNote: The simplest Chinese noodle soup — clear broth, no garnish beyond scallion. The depth comes from the broth and the quality of the noodles. A winter comfort that feels like spring.
versionNoteZh: 最简约的中式汤面——清汤底，仅葱点缀。深度来自汤底和面条品质。冬日 comfort，却有春日暖意。
story: 阳春面 is the noodle equivalent of a blank canvas — deceptively simple, impossible to perfect, and deeply comforting.
