The name means "spring face" and refers to the clear, pale broth that looks like the first warm days of spring. Nanjing and Shanghai variants exist, but the principle is universal: great broth, good noodles, a pinch of scallion.
storyZh: 阳春面相当于面条界的留白——看似简单，极难做好，但温暖治愈。"阳春"指清澈的淡色汤底，如同春日初暖。南京和上海各有版本，但原则一致：好汤、好面、一撮葱。

ingredients.note: Thin egg noodles or ramen-style wheat noodles work. Avoid thick udon or chewy somen.
ingredients.noteZh: 细鸡蛋面或拉面风格小麦面均可。避开粗乌冬或韧性素面。

ingredients.note: Homemade is best; instant chicken stock cube dissolved in water works in a pinch.
ingredients.noteZh: 自制最佳；临时用速溶鸡高汤块兑水也可。

steps.text: In individual serving bowls, combine light soy sauce, sesame oil, white pepper, and salt.
steps.textZh: 在 individual 碗中混合生抽、香油、白胡椒和盐。

stateNote.visual: Dry seasonings sit at bottom of bowl before broth is added
stateNote.visualZh: 干燥调味料在碗底，等待高汤冲入
stateNote.signal: Soy sauce, sesame oil, and salt are visible as separate layers before stirring

steps.text: Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil for the noodles.
steps.textZh: 大锅烧水至滚沸，准备下面条。

steps.text: Pour 300 ml boiling chicken stock into each bowl and stir to dissolve the seasonings. The broth should be clear and pale golden.
steps.textZh: 每碗倒入300毫升沸高汤，搅匀至调味料融化。汤底清澈微金。

stateNote.visual: Broth is clear, pale golden, with no cloudiness or oil separation
stateNote.visualZh: 汤清澈、淡金色，无浑浊或油花分离
stateNote.signal: Seasonings fully dissolved; a thin film of sesame oil on surface
stateNote.signalZh: 调味料完全融化；表面有薄薄香油膜

steps.text: Cook noodles in boiling water according to package timing. Drain well — excess water dilutes the broth.
steps.textZh: 面条沸水煮至包装时间。充分沥干——多余水分会稀释汤底。

steps.text: Transfer noodles to the broth bowls. Top with a generous mound of finely sliced scallions. Serve immediately.
steps.textZh: 面条倒入汤碗。顶部堆满细葱花。立即上桌。

stateNote.visual: Broth steams gently; scallions sit bright green on the surface
stateNote.visualZh: 汤底微冒热气；葱花鲜绿浮于表面
stateNote.signal: Clear, aromatic broth; no raw egg or wheat smell
stateNote.signalZh: 汤清香气扑鼻；无生蛋或生麦味

tips: The broth quality is everything — use the best stock you can find.
Don't overcook the noodles — they should be just al dente.
A soft-boiled egg (9 minutes) added on top elevates this to a full meal.
tipsZh: 汤底决定一切——用你能找到的最好高汤。
面条别煮过头——保持 al dente。
加一颗溏心蛋（水煮9分钟）就能升级为完整一餐。

versionNote: Restaurant versions load the wok with colorful bits — shrimp, char siu, ham, peas, egg ribbons. Home version trims to what's practical; same elegance, less work.
versionNoteZh: 餐厅版会堆满五颜六色的配料——虾仁、叉烧、火腿、豌豆、蛋丝。家常版按需精简，同样的精致，更少的麻烦。
story: Yangzhou fried rice is the gold standard of Chinese banquet fried rice. Every Chinese restaurant worldwide has a version; this is the home-cooked truth: generous protein, bright color from pea and carrot, and that signature grain-by-grain gloss.
storyZh: 扬州炒饭是中式宴席炒饭的标杆。全球每家中餐馆都有版本；这是家常的真实做法：配料丰富、豌豆胡萝卜点缀出鲜亮色彩、每粒米都油光锃亮。

ingredients.note: Cold rice = separate grains. Spread fresh rice on a tray and fridge 1 hour if needed.

ingredients.nameEn: raw shrimp, peeled & deveined, chopped coarse
ingredients.nameZh: 鲜虾仁，去壳去肠线，粗切

ingredients.nameEn: char siu (Chinese BBQ pork), diced 1 cm
ingredients.nameZh: 叉烧肉，切成 1 厘米丁

ingredients.note: Thaw under warm water before using.

steps.text: Prep everything first: dice char siu, chop shrimp coarse, dice carrot small, separate scallion whites from greens, beat eggs with salt, thaw peas under warm water. Mise en place is everything for fried rice.
steps.textZh: 先把所有配料备好：叉烧切丁，虾仁粗切，胡萝卜切小丁，小葱白绿分开，鸡蛋加盐打散，豌豆温水解冻。炒饭的精髓在准备阶段。
steps.zhHint: 备料：米、肉、蛋、菜分别备好

steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil over medium-high. Pour in beaten eggs, let them set 10 seconds at the bottom, then gently push with spatula so uncooked egg flows to the pan surface. Cook until just set in soft curds, about 30 seconds. Remove to a plate.
steps.textZh: 中大火热锅，放 1 汤匙油。倒入蛋液，等底部定型约 10 秒后用锅铲轻轻推动，让未凝固的蛋液流到锅面。炒至柔软凝固，约 30 秒，盛出备用。

stateNote.visual: Eggs are soft curds, still glossy and moist inside
stateNote.visualZh: 鸡蛋呈柔软蛋花，表面有光泽、内部湿润
stateNote.signal: No runny liquid; curds still wet and soft
stateNote.signalZh: 没有流动蛋液；蛋块依然湿润柔软

steps.text: Add remaining 1 tbsp oil. Toss in shrimp and char siu. Stir-fry 1 minute until shrimp turn opaque on the outside.
steps.textZh: 再加 1 汤匙油。下虾仁和叉烧。翻炒 1 分钟，虾的表面变不透明。

stateNote.visual: Shrimp edges turn pink; char siu edges slightly crisp
stateNote.visualZh: 虾仁边缘变粉红；叉烧边缘略焦脆
stateNote.signal: Shrimp no longer translucent at edges
stateNote.signalZh: 虾仁边缘不再透明

steps.text: Push protein to one side. Add carrot and peas to the empty side; stir-fry 30 seconds. Then fold everything together.
steps.textZh: 把蛋白推到一边。空处下胡萝卜和豌豆，翻炒 30 秒。再翻拌均匀。

stateNote.visual: Carrot brightens to orange; peas turn vibrant green
stateNote.visualZh: 胡萝卜变亮橙色；豌豆变鲜绿色
stateNote.signal: Carrot edges softened but still crisp
stateNote.signalZh: 胡萝卜边缘变软但仍保持脆度

steps.text: Add the cold rice. Break up any clumps with spatula. Press rice against the wok side for 10 seconds to toast, then toss. Repeat until every grain is separate and glossy — about 2 minutes.
steps.textZh: 下隔夜冷饭。用锅铲搓散结块。把米饭压到锅边烙 10 秒再翻动。重复直到每粒米都分开且油亮——约 2 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Rice goes from matte white to glossy and slightly golden at edges
stateNote.visualZh: 米饭从哑光白色变成油亮，边缘略金黄
stateNote.signal: Grains 'dance' and separate; no wet clumps
stateNote.signalZh: 米粒在锅里'跳舞'分离；没有湿团

steps.text: Return the scrambled eggs. Add soy sauce along the hot wok side (let it sizzle 5 seconds), then fold everything through. Add white scallion parts, toss 15 seconds.
steps.textZh: 把炒蛋倒回。生抽沿锅边淋入（让它滋啦 5 秒），再翻拌均匀。下葱白，翻炒 15 秒。

stateNote.visual: Soy sizzles and steams with a toasty aroma; rice takes a light golden tint
stateNote.visualZh: 酱油滋啦作响，散发焦香；米饭染上浅金色
stateNote.signal: Steam smells roasted not raw-soy
stateNote.signalZh: 蒸汽是焦香而不是生酱油味

steps.text: Remove from heat. Stir in sesame oil and green scallion parts. Taste and adjust salt or white pepper if needed. Serve immediately.
steps.textZh: 关火。拌入香油和葱花。尝味，按需补盐或白胡椒。立即出锅。

stateNote.visual: Green scallions just wilted; rice glossy, all ingredients evenly distributed
stateNote.visualZh: 葱花微微塌软；米饭油亮，所有配料分布均匀
stateNote.signal: Each grain separate, protein and veg in every spoonful
stateNote.signalZh: 粒粒分明，每勺都有蛋白和蔬菜

tips: Cold jasmine rice is ideal — short-grain is stickier and harder to keep separate.
Char siu can be swapped for any pre-cooked pork or ham; the sweetness balances the salt.
For the restaurant look: fry the eggs separately, pull them into ribbons, and fold in at the end.
tipsZh: 隔夜粳米最佳——短粒米更黏，不容易粒粒分明。
叉烧可用任何预熟猪肉或火腿代替；甜味能平衡咸味。
追求餐厅效果：鸡蛋单独炒成蛋丝，最后折入。

titleEn: Yu Xiang Shredded Pork (鱼香肉丝)
versionNote: 家庭版——无鱼却有着鱼香味道的传奇川菜，酸甜微辣是灵魂。
versionNoteZh: 家庭版——无鱼却有着鱼香味道的传奇川菜，酸甜微辣是灵魂。
story: Yu xiang (鱼香) literally means 'fish fragrance' — but there's no fish in this dish! The flavor profile was inspired by the way Cantonese fishermen season fish with garlic, ginger, scallion, and chili. Today it's one of the most ordered dishes in Chinese restaurants worldwide. My first time making this was a disaster — I used too much sugar and it was cloying. After three attempts I finally got the balance right: sweet, sour, salty, and spicy all in harmony.
storyZh: 鱼香 literally 意思是「鱼的香味」——但这道菜里没有鱼！这种风味源自广东渔民给鱼调味的方：蒜、姜、葱、辣椒。如今它已成为中餐厅全球点餐率最高的菜品之一。我第一次做惨不忍睹——糖放太多，甜到发腻。试了三次才终于找到平衡：甜、酸、咸、辣和谐共舞。

steps.text: Cut pork into thin strips 5 cm x 3 mm. Marinate with 1 tbsp shaoxing wine, 1/2 tbsp light soy sauce, and 1 tsp cornstarch for 10 minutes.
steps.textZh: 猪肉切 5 厘米长、3 毫米宽的细丝。加入 1 汤匙绍兴酒、1/2 汤匙生抽和 1 茶匙玉米淀粉，腌制 10 分钟。

stateNote.visual: meat glossy with starch coating
stateNote.signal: liquid absorbed

steps.text: Make the yu xiang sauce: mix chinkiang vinegar, remaining soy sauce, sugar, and 1 tsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water in a small bowl. Set aside.
steps.textZh: 调配鱼香汁：将镇江香醋、剩余生抽、白糖和 1 茶匙玉米淀粉与 2 汤匙水在小碗中搅匀备用。

stateNote.visual: sugar fully dissolved
stateNote.signal: sauce ready

steps.text: Drain bamboo shoots and cut into matchstick strips. Julienne the carrot. Mince garlic and ginger. Cut scallions into 3 cm lengths.
steps.textZh: 笋丝沥干切丝，胡萝卜切细丝。大蒜和生姜切末，小葱切 3 厘米段。

stateNote.visual: all vegetables cut into uniform strips
stateNote.signal: prep complete

steps.text: Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Add the pork and spread flat — sear 20 seconds without stirring, then stir-fry until color changes to white.
steps.textZh: 热锅旺火下油，加入肉丝摊平，煎 20 秒不要翻动，然后翻炒至肉丝变白。

stateNote.visual: pork turning opaque white
stateNote.signal: sizzling

steps.text: Push pork to one side. Add doubanjiang to the empty side and fry 10 seconds until red oil appears. Add garlic, ginger, and white parts of scallions. Stir for 15 seconds.
steps.textZh: 将肉丝推到一边，在空出的位置加入豆瓣酱炒 10 秒至红油析出。加入蒜末、姜末和葱白部分，翻炒 15 秒。

stateNote.visual: oil turning deep red
stateNote.signal: aromatic

steps.text: Add bamboo shoots and carrots. Stir-fry 30 seconds, then pour in the prepared sauce. Toss quickly until the sauce thickens and coats everything.
steps.textZh: 加入笋丝和胡萝卜丝，翻炒 30 秒，倒入调好的鱼香汁。快速翻炒至酱汁浓稠裹匀。

stateNote.visual: sauce glossy and thick
stateNote.signal: bubble rapidly

steps.text: Add green parts of scallions, toss 10 seconds, and serve immediately over steamed rice.
steps.textZh: 加入葱绿部分，翻炒 10 秒即可出锅，配白米饭食用。

stateNote.visual: scallion greens wilted but vibrant
stateNote.signal: ready

tips: The sauce balance is everything: 1.5 tbsp vinegar : 1.5 tbsp sugar : 1 tbsp soy is the golden ratio. Adjust to taste but keep the sweet-sour anchor.
Canned bamboo shoots are convenient and work perfectly — just rinse and squeeze dry to remove the metallic taste.
Yu xiang flavor is the 'four delights': sweet, sour, salty, spicy — all four must be perceptible but none overpowering.
tipsZh: 酱汁平衡是灵魂：1.5 汤匙醋 : 1.5 汤匙糖 : 1 汤匙生抽是黄金比例。可按口味调整，但酸甜基调不能丢。
罐头笋丝既方便又好用——只要冲洗并挤干水分去除金属味即可。
鱼香味的「四味和谐」：甜酸咸辣——四种味道都要感知得到，但不能有任何一种盖过其他。

titleEn: Sweet and Sour Pork Ribs (糖醋排骨)
versionNote: 家常红烧法，糖醋比例 2:1。上海本帮风格偏甜，江浙做法会加少许醋提亮。
versionNoteZh: 家常红烧法，糖醋比例 2:1。上海本帮风格偏甜，江浙做法会加少许醋提亮。
story: Sweet and sour ribs (糖醋排骨) are a cornerstone of Shanghai home cooking — glossy, sticky, and deeply savory-sweet. Unlike the crispy fried American version, this is a braise: ribs slow-cooked in a tangy-sweet sauce until the meat falls off the bone. It is the dish that appears at every family gathering along the Yangtze delta.
storyZh: 糖醋排骨是上海家常菜的灵魂——光泽诱人、黏糯入味、咸甜交织。不同于美式炸排骨，这是焖烧做法：排骨在酸甜汁中慢炖至骨肉分离。是长江三角洲家庭聚会的必备菜。

ingredients.nameEn: pork ribs (spare ribs or baby back), cut into 5 cm pieces

steps.text: Blanch ribs: put ribs in a pot with cold water, bring to a boil, skim scum, drain and rinse. This removes impurities and gamey odors.
steps.textZh: 排骨焯水：冷水下锅，烧开撇去浮沫，捞出冲洗。去除杂质和腥味。

stateNote.visual: Grey foam rises to the surface
stateNote.visualZh: 水面浮起灰色泡沫
stateNote.signal: Water runs clear after rinsing
stateNote.signalZh: 冲洗后水变清

steps.text: Caramelize sugar: heat oil in a wok over medium-low. Add rock sugar and stir constantly until it melts and turns amber (about 2 minutes). Do not walk away — it burns fast.
steps.textZh: 炒糖色：中小火加热油，下冰糖搅动至融化变琥珀色（约 2 分钟）。不要离开——极易焦糊。

stateNote.visual: Sugar melts, turns from white to pale gold to deep amber
stateNote.visualZh: 糖由白→浅金→深琥珀色
stateNote.signal: Amber color with small bubbles — pull off heat immediately
stateNote.signalZh: 琥珀色冒小泡——立即离火

steps.text: Add blanched ribs to the caramelized sugar. Toss quickly to coat every piece in the glaze.
steps.textZh: 下入焯好的排骨，快速翻炒让每块均匀裹上糖色。

stateNote.visual: Ribs turn glossy reddish-brown
stateNote.visualZh: 排骨变红亮褐色
stateNote.signal: Every piece evenly colored
stateNote.signalZh: 每块均匀上色

steps.text: Add Shaoxing wine, light soy, dark soy, ginger, and scallion. Stir 30 seconds to release aroma.
steps.textZh: 加料酒、生抽、老抽、姜片、葱段。炒 30 秒出香。

stateNote.visual: Sauce bubbles vigorously, aromatic steam rises
stateNote.visualZh: 酱汁冒泡，香气升腾
stateNote.signal: Wine smell dissipates, soy fragrance emerges
stateNote.signalZh: 酒气散尽，酱油香出来

steps.text: Pour in hot water until ribs are just submerged. Bring to a boil, then reduce to low heat. Cover and simmer 35 minutes.
steps.textZh: 加热水没过排骨，烧开转小火，盖盖焖 35 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Gentle bubbles break the surface occasionally
stateNote.visualZh: 酱汁微沸，偶有气泡破裂
stateNote.signal: Meat pulls back slightly from bone ends
stateNote.signalZh: 肉从骨端微微收缩

steps.text: Add vinegar and increase heat to medium-high. Uncover and reduce sauce until it coats the ribs in a thick glossy glaze (about 5-8 minutes).
steps.textZh: 加香醋，转中大火收汁，开盖收至浓稠裹汁（约 5-8 分钟）。

stateNote.visual: Sauce thickens to a syrupy consistency, coats the back of a spoon
stateNote.visualZh: 汁变浓稠如糖浆，勺背挂汁
stateNote.signal: Sauce leaves a clean trail when stirred
stateNote.signalZh: 铲划锅底痕迹清晰

steps.text: Garnish with sesame seeds. Serve immediately while the glaze is still glossy and warm.
steps.textZh: 撒白芝麻点缀，趁热上桌。

stateNote.visual: Glaze has a deep amber shine, steam rising
stateNote.visualZh: 釉面深琥珀色光泽，热气腾腾
stateNote.signal: Eat immediately — glaze sets as it cools
stateNote.signalZh: 趁热吃，凉了釉会凝固变硬

tips: Rock sugar gives a glossier, less cloying sweetness than white sugar. If unavailable, white sugar works but the glaze will not be as shiny.
The vinegar is added at the end — late vinegar preserves its bright tang. Early vinegar gets cooked away.
The ribs are done when the meat easily separates from the bone with gentle pressure.
Leftover ribs reheat beautifully in a steamer — the glaze re-glosses.
tipsZh: 冰糖比白糖光泽更好、甜而不腻。没有冰糖可用白糖替代，但釉面光泽略逊。
醋最后加——晚加醋保留明亮酸香，早加醋会被煮掉酸味。
排骨炖好的标志：轻压骨肉自然分离。
隔夜加热用蒸笼，釉面会重新恢复光泽。

versionNote: 家常整鱼版，鲁菜经典。餐厅版会做牡丹花刀让鱼形更夸张。
versionNoteZh: 家常整鱼版，鲁菜经典。餐厅版会做牡丹花刀让鱼形更夸张。
story: Sweet and sour fish (糖醋鱼) is a showpiece of Shandong (Lu) cuisine — a whole fish, scored and deep-fried until the flesh fans out like petals, then drenched in a vibrant sweet-sour glaze. It is a mandatory dish for Chinese New Year and weddings because the whole fish symbolizes abundance (年年有余). The trick is the scoring technique and the two-stage fry.
storyZh: 糖醋鱼是鲁菜的代表作——整鱼改刀炸制后鱼肉绽开花瓣状，淋上鲜亮的糖醋汁。是春节和婚宴的必备菜，寓意年年有余。关键在刀工和两次炸制。

ingredients.nameEn: whole fish (sea bass or tilapia), about 500 g

steps.text: Clean the fish: remove scales and gills. Make 3-4 deep diagonal cuts (about 2 cm deep) on each side, stopping at the backbone. Pat completely dry inside and out.
steps.textZh: 处理鱼：去鳞去鳃。每侧斜切 3-4 刀（深约 2cm，停于脊骨）。内外擦干。

stateNote.visual: Cuts go through the flesh to but not through the backbone
stateNote.visualZh: 刀工切透鱼肉但不切断脊骨
stateNote.signal: Fish can lay relatively flat when scored
stateNote.signalZh: 改刀后鱼身可相对平铺

steps.text: Marinate: rub salt and Shaoxing wine inside the cuts and on the surface. Rest 10 minutes. Pat dry again — surface moisture prevents crispy skin.
steps.textZh: 腌制：在切口和表面抹盐、料酒。静置 10 分钟。再次擦干——水分影响脆皮。

stateNote.visual: Fish flesh looks opaque where salt touched it
stateNote.visualZh: 盐接触处鱼肉变白
stateNote.signal: Surface dry to touch
stateNote.signalZh: 表面摸起来干燥

steps.text: Coat the fish: dust cornstarch generously inside and outside the cuts, pressing gently so it adheres. Shake off excess. The cornstarch creates the crispy crust and helps the cuts fan out.
steps.textZh: 裹粉：切口内外 generously 裹上玉米淀粉，轻压使其附着。抖掉多余粉。淀粉形成脆壳并帮助切口绽放。

stateNote.visual: Fish is uniformly white with a powdery coat
stateNote.visualZh: 鱼身均匀白色粉层
stateNote.signal: Coating looks dry and matte
stateNote.signalZh: 粉层干燥不湿粘

steps.text: Heat oil to 180°C. Hold the fish by the tail and lower it into the oil, curling slightly. Fry the first side 2 minutes until golden, then carefully flip and fry the other side 2 minutes. The cuts should open up like petals.
steps.textZh: 油烧 180 度，拎鱼尾入锅。先炸正面 2 分钟至金黄，再翻面炸反面 2 分钟。切口应绽开如花。

stateNote.visual: Oil bubbles vigorously around fish, cuts begin to separate
stateNote.visualZh: 油面剧烈冒泡，切口开始分开
stateNote.signal: Crust is golden and firm, fish floats
stateNote.signalZh: 外壳金黄坚硬，鱼浮起

steps.text: Drain on a wire rack. Increase oil heat to 190°C. Fry again for 30 seconds — this double-fry ensures maximum crunch.
steps.textZh: 捞出沥油。油温升至 190 度，复炸 30 秒——两次炸制确保极致酥脆。

stateNote.visual: Second fry deepens color to golden amber
stateNote.visualZh: 复炸后颜色加深为金琥珀色
stateNote.signal: Crust sounds hollow when tapped
stateNote.signalZh: 轻敲外壳发出空心声

steps.text: Make the sauce: in a clean wok, combine vinegar, sugar, ketchup, soy sauce, and 3 tbsp water. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Add garlic and ginger, stir 10 seconds.
steps.textZh: 调糖醋汁：锅中加香醋、糖、番茄酱、生抽、3 汤匙水。中火烧开。下蒜姜末，炒 10 秒。

stateNote.visual: Sauce bubbles vigorously, turns pink-orange
stateNote.visualZh: 汁冒大泡，呈粉橙色
stateNote.signal: Sugar fully dissolved, sauce is uniform
stateNote.signalZh: 糖完全融化，汁均匀

steps.text: When sauce thickens slightly (30 seconds), pour over the fried fish immediately. Garnish with scallion julienne and a sprinkle of sesame seeds. Serve at once.
steps.textZh: 汁微稠（30 秒）后立即淋在炸好的鱼上。撒葱丝和芝麻。立即上桌。

stateNote.visual: Sauce coats the fish with a bright gloss, steam rises
stateNote.visualZh: 汁均匀光亮地裹在鱼身，热气升腾
stateNote.signal: Eat immediately — crispy crust degrades within minutes
stateNote.signalZh: 立即吃，脆壳几分钟内就会变软

tips: Sea bass (鲈鱼) is ideal — firm flesh that holds its shape. Tilapia works too but is softer. Avoid flaky fish like cod.
The double-fry is non-negotiable: first fry cooks through, second fry creates the glass-like crunch.
Pour the sauce right at the table for maximum drama — or ladle it over just before serving.
Whole fish symbolizes abundance in Chinese culture — this dish is mandatory for celebrations.
tipsZh: 鲈鱼最佳——肉质紧实不易散。罗非鱼也可，肉质偏软。避免用鳕鱼等易散的鱼。
两次炸制不可省略：初炸熟透，复炸酥脆。
上桌时淋汁最有仪式感——或在餐桌上现场浇汁。
整鱼寓意年年有余，是节庆必备菜。

titleEn: Seaweed Egg Drop Soup (紫菜蛋花汤)
versionNote: Quick 15-minute soup — the backbone of any Chinese home kitchen. Seaweed rehydrates in the hot broth while eggs form silky ribbons.
versionNoteZh: 15 分钟快手汤——中式家常厨房的必备汤品。紫菜在热汤中泡发，蛋液形成丝滑蛋花。
story: Seaweed egg drop soup (紫菜蛋花汤) is the most common Chinese home soup — light, umami-rich, and ready in minutes. It is the soup every Chinese grandmother makes when someone is feeling under the weather. The trick is swirling the beaten egg into simmering broth to create delicate ribbons, not curds.
storyZh: 紫菜蛋花汤是最常见的中式家常汤——清淡鲜美，几分钟搞定。是每位中国奶奶在家人身体不适时必做的汤。秘诀是将打散的蛋液旋入微沸的高汤中，形成细腻的蛋花而非蛋块。

steps.text: Rehydrate the dried seaweed in a bowl of warm water for 2-3 minutes. Drain and tear into bite-sized pieces if needed.
steps.textZh: 干紫菜温水泡发 2-3 分钟，沥干，撕成适口大小。

stateNote.visual: Seaweed softens and expands, turning dark green
stateNote.visualZh: 紫菜变软膨胀，呈深绿色
stateNote.signal: Seaweed is pliable, not brittle
stateNote.signalZh: 紫菜柔韧不脆硬

steps.text: Bring water or broth to a rolling boil in a pot. Season with soy sauce, salt, and white pepper.
steps.textZh: 锅中加水或鸡汤烧开，加入生抽、盐、白胡椒粉调味。

stateNote.visual: Broth is at a vigorous boil with large bubbles breaking the surface
stateNote.visualZh: 高汤剧烈沸腾，大泡翻滚
stateNote.signal: Surface is agitated and steaming heavily
stateNote.signalZh: 汤面翻滚，蒸汽充足

steps.text: Add the drained seaweed to the boiling broth. Cook for 30 seconds — seaweed only needs to heat through.
steps.textZh: 加入沥干的紫菜，煮 30 秒——紫菜只需热透即可。

stateNote.visual: Seaweed floats and swirls in the broth, releasing ocean aroma
stateNote.visualZh: 紫菜在汤中漂浮翻卷，释放海味香气
stateNote.signal: Seaweed is warm and pliable
stateNote.signalZh: 紫菜温热柔软

steps.text: Reduce heat to medium-low so the broth is just simmering. Slowly drizzle the beaten eggs in a thin stream while gently stirring in one direction.
steps.textZh: 转中小火使汤保持微沸状态。沿锅边缓慢倒入蛋液，同时朝一个方向轻搅。

stateNote.visual: Eggs form long, delicate ribbons and clouds in the broth
stateNote.visualZh: 蛋液形成细长的丝状蛋花，如云朵般漂浮
stateNote.signal: Eggs are just set but still glossy and tender
stateNote.signalZh: 蛋花刚凝固，仍光亮嫩滑

steps.text: Immediately remove from heat. Drizzle with sesame oil, garnish with chopped scallions. Serve hot.
steps.textZh: 立即离火，淋香油，撒葱花。趁热上桌。

stateNote.visual: Sesame oil glistens on the surface, scallions bright green, egg ribbons floating
stateNote.visualZh: 香油浮面泛光，葱花翠绿，蛋花漂浮
stateNote.signal: Eat immediately — egg ribbons will overcook if left on heat
stateNote.signalZh: 立即食用——蛋花久煮会变老

tips: Do not boil after adding eggs — the residual heat will finish cooking them. Over-boiling makes eggs rubbery.
Use the hottest broth possible when adding eggs for the fluffiest ribbons.
Dried seaweed sheets (laver) are available in Asian supermarkets in the dried goods aisle. One sheet per person is plenty.
For a richer version, use homemade chicken stock instead of water.
tipsZh: 加蛋后不要继续沸腾——余温足以煮熟蛋花。久煮会让蛋变韧。
倒蛋液时汤越滚越好——蛋花最蓬松。
干紫菜片（海苔片）在亚超干货区有售，一人一片足够。
想用浓郁版？用自制鸡汤代替清水。

titleEn: Tomato Egg Drop Soup (番茄蛋花汤)
versionNote: A heartier cousin of plain seaweed egg drop soup — the tomatoes provide natural sweetness and body, eliminating the need for stock.
versionNoteZh: 紫菜蛋花汤的浓稠版——番茄提供天然甜味和汤体，无需额外高汤。
story: Tomato egg drop soup (番茄蛋花汤) combines the two most beloved Chinese home ingredients — tomatoes and eggs — into a soup that is simultaneously sour, sweet, and comforting. It is the soup Chinese people make when they want something warm and fast. The key is sautéing the tomatoes until they break down into a酱 before adding water, which creates a naturally thick and flavorful broth.
storyZh: 番茄蛋花汤把中式家常菜最经典的两样食材——番茄和鸡蛋——融于一锅，酸、甜、暖。是中式家庭不想做饭时的首选。秘诀是先把番茄炒化成酱再加水，这样汤底自然浓稠鲜香。

steps.text: Score an X on the bottom of each tomato and blanch in boiling water for 30 seconds. Transfer to ice water, then peel off the skin. Dice the tomatoes into 1 cm pieces.
steps.textZh: 番茄底部划十字，沸水焯 30 秒后过冰水，去皮切 1 cm 丁。

stateNote.visual: Skin curls at the corners and slips off cleanly
stateNote.visualZh: 皮边缘卷起，轻松剥落
stateNote.signal: Skin separates from flesh in one piece
stateNote.signalZh: 皮肉完整分离

steps.text: Heat oil in a wok or pot over medium-high. Add minced garlic and stir-fry for 10 seconds until fragrant.
steps.textZh: 锅中放油中大火加热，下蒜末爆香 10 秒。

stateNote.visual: Garlic sizzles and releases aromatic scent, edges just starting to golden
stateNote.visualZh: 蒜末滋滋作响，香气四溢，边缘微黄
stateNote.signal: Garlic is fragrant but not browned
stateNote.signalZh: 蒜香浓郁但未焦

steps.text: Add diced tomatoes and a pinch of salt. Cook 5-6 minutes, pressing against the wok to help them break down into a saucy consistency.
steps.textZh: 下番茄丁加一小撮盐，中火炒 5-6 分钟，用锅铲压番茄助其化开成酱。

stateNote.visual: Tomatoes collapse into a thick, rustic sauce with visible seeds and pulp
stateNote.visualZh: 番茄塌陷成浓稠酱状，可见籽和果肉
stateNote.signal: Oils and tomato juices separate, mixture coats the wok
stateNote.signalZh: 番茄油和汁水析出，锅底挂酱

steps.text: Pour in hot water. Add sugar and salt to taste. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a steady simmer.
steps.textZh: 倒入热水，加糖和盐调味，烧开转中小火保持微沸。

stateNote.visual: Broth is a vibrant orange-red, slightly cloudy from the tomato pulp
stateNote.visualZh: 汤色橙红鲜亮，略带番茄果肉浑浊感
stateNote.signal: Soup is bubbling gently across the surface
stateNote.signalZh: 汤面均匀小泡翻滚

steps.text: Slowly drizzle beaten eggs in a thin stream while stirring gently in one direction. Let sit for 10 seconds, then gently push the egg ribbons around.
steps.textZh: 沿锅边缓慢倒入蛋液，轻搅一圈。静置 10 秒让蛋花定型，再轻推散开。

stateNote.visual: Eggs bloom into large, soft flower-like shapes floating on the surface
stateNote.visualZh: 蛋液绽放成大片柔嫩的蛋花浮于汤面
stateNote.signal: Eggs are just set, still glossy and jiggly
stateNote.signalZh: 蛋花刚凝固，仍光亮颤动

steps.text: Drizzle with sesame oil, garnish with scallions. Serve immediately while hot.
steps.textZh: 淋香油，撒葱花，趁热上桌。

stateNote.visual: Sesame oil sheen, green scallion contrast, orange broth, white-gold egg ribbons
stateNote.visualZh: 香油浮光、葱花翠绿、橙红汤底、金黄蛋花
stateNote.signal: Best eaten immediately for optimal egg texture
stateNote.signalZh: 立即食用蛋花口感最佳

tips: The tomatoes must be very ripe — ripe tomatoes provide natural sweetness that balances the acid. Under-ripe tomatoes make the soup sour.
Do not over-stir after adding eggs — let them set for 10 seconds before gently pushing. This creates large, showy ribbons instead of shreds.
A pinch of sugar is essential — it balances the tomato acidity without making the soup sweet.
For a restaurant-style version, add a teaspoon of cornstarch slurry at the end to slightly thicken the broth.
tipsZh: 番茄一定要熟透——熟番茄的天然甜味能平衡酸度。生番茄会让汤过酸。
加蛋后不要狂搅——先静置 10 秒再轻推，这样蛋花大且好看。
一小撮糖必不可少——平衡番茄酸味，但不会让汤变甜。
想要餐厅级浓稠口感？出锅前淋入半茶匙淀粉水勾薄芡。

titleEn: Winter Melon Pork Rib Soup (冬瓜排骨汤)
versionNote: Classic Cantonese slow-simmered soup (老火汤) — the kind that simmers for hours and fills the house with comfort. Winter melon becomes translucent and melt-in-the-mouth; the broth is clean, subtly sweet, and deeply nourishing.
versionNoteZh: 经典广式老火汤——慢火煲数小时，满屋清香。冬瓜炖至半透明入口即化，汤色清澈微甜，温润滋补。
story: Winter melon pork rib soup (冬瓜排骨汤) is a Cantonese comfort soup that embodies the philosophy of 老火汤 — long, slow simmering extracts every ounce of flavor from the bones while the winter melon absorbs the broth and becomes silky. It is a staple in Cantonese households, especially during summer when the cooling properties of winter melon are prized. The soup requires patience but delivers an extraordinary depth of clean, savory flavor with zero heaviness.
storyZh: 冬瓜排骨汤是广式 comfort soup 的代表，体现老火汤的哲学——长时间慢火熬煮，骨头的鲜味全然释放，冬瓜吸收汤汁变得丝滑。是广东家庭的常客，尤其夏季——冬瓜的清凉属性备受推崇。这道汤需要耐心，但回报是无与伦比的清澈鲜香。

ingredients.nameEn: pork ribs, cut into 5 cm segments
winter melon, peeled and cut into 3 cm chunks
ingredients.nameZh: 冬瓜，去皮切 3 cm 块

steps.text: Blanch the pork ribs: place ribs in a pot of cold water, bring to a boil over high heat. Boil for 3 minutes to release scum. Drain and rinse ribs under cold running water. This step removes impurities and ensures a clear broth.
steps.textZh: 排骨焯水：冷水下锅，大火烧开煮 3 分钟，撇去浮沫。捞出用冷水冲洗。这一步去除杂质，确保汤清。

stateNote.visual: Gray-brown scum floats to the surface; water turns cloudy
stateNote.visualZh: 灰褐色浮沫浮起，水变浑浊
stateNote.signal: Scum is fully released and water is cloudy — time to drain
stateNote.signalZh: 浮沫充分释放，水浑浊，需倒掉

steps.text: Prepare the winter melon: peel the tough outer skin, remove seeds, and cut the flesh into 3 cm chunks. The rind can be left on for a firmer texture or removed for a softer result.
steps.textZh: 冬瓜去皮去籽，切 3 cm 块。保留部分瓜皮口感更爽脆，全部去皮更软糯。

stateNote.visual: Flesh is pure white, firm but yielding to slight pressure
stateNote.visualZh: 果肉纯白，质地坚实但按压微软
stateNote.signal: Knife meets slight resistance — not rock hard, not mushy
stateNote.signalZh: 刀切有轻微阻力——不硬不烂

steps.text: In a clean pot, combine blanched ribs, sliced ginger, knotted scallion, and Shaoxing wine. Add cold water (1.5 L). Bring to a boil over high heat.
steps.textZh: 新锅中放入焯好的排骨、姜片、葱结、料酒，加冷水 1.5 L，大火烧开。

stateNote.visual: Water is clear, small bubbles forming at the edges
stateNote.visualZh: 汤色清澈，锅边开始冒小泡
stateNote.signal: Vigorous rolling boil achieved
stateNote.signalZh: 剧烈沸腾

steps.text: Once boiling, reduce heat to the lowest possible setting. Cover partially and simmer for 40 minutes. The broth should barely move — a few occasional bubbles, not a rolling boil.
steps.textZh: 烧开后转最小火，半盖锅盖慢炖 40 分钟。汤面仅微冒泡，不能大滚。

stateNote.visual: Broth is clear golden, a few bubbles breaking the surface every few seconds
stateNote.visualZh: 汤色清亮微金，每隔几秒破出一两个小泡
stateNote.signal: Surface is almost still — only gentle movement
stateNote.signalZh: 汤面几近平静，仅微动

steps.text: Add winter melon chunks to the pot. Continue simmering uncovered for another 30-35 minutes, until the melon is translucent and fork-tender.
steps.textZh: 下冬瓜块，继续敞盖慢炖 30-35 分钟，至冬瓜半透明、筷子可轻松插入。

stateNote.visual: Winter melon turns from opaque white to semi-translucent, edges softening
stateNote.visualZh: 冬瓜由乳白转为半透明，边缘开始软化
stateNote.signal: Fork slides in with zero resistance — melon is melting
stateNote.signalZh: 筷子一插即入，冬瓜入口即化

steps.text: Remove ginger slices and scallion knot. Season with salt and white pepper to taste. Ladle into bowls and serve immediately.
steps.textZh: 捞出姜片和葱结不要。加盐和白胡椒粉调味，盛碗上桌。

stateNote.visual: Broth is crystal clear with a faint golden sheen, melon pieces floating like jade
stateNote.visualZh: 汤色清澈见底微泛金，冬瓜块如翡翠漂浮
stateNote.signal: Broth should be drinkable on its own — clean, savory, slightly sweet from the melon
stateNote.signalZh: 汤本身可直接饮用——清澈鲜香，带冬瓜微甜

tips: The key to clear soup is the blanching step — never skip it. Impure bones make cloudy, gamy soup.
Keep the simmer gentle — a rolling boil will cloud the broth and break apart the winter melon.
Winter melon is available in Asian supermarkets year-round. Look for heavy, hard pieces with intact white powdery bloom on the skin — this indicates freshness.
This soup improves with time — make it a day ahead and reheat gently. The flavors meld beautifully overnight.
tipsZh: 汤清的关键是焯水——绝不能省。血沫不去，汤浑且腥。
保持微沸——大火会搅浑汤底，冬瓜也会煮烂。
冬瓜在亚超全年有售。选沉重、坚硬、表皮有白色粉霜的——说明新鲜。
这道汤隔夜更美味——提前一天做好，第二天小火回温，风味更融合。

titleEn: Eggplant & Green Bean Casserole (茄子豆角煲)
versionNote: 家庭版——一锅炖，茄子软糯吸汁，豆角绵软入味。
versionNoteZh: 家庭版——一锅炖，茄子软糯吸汁，豆角绵软入味。
story: This one-pot casserole is a weekend staple in northern Chinese homes. Eggplant acts like a sponge, soaking up the savory soy-garlic braising liquid, while green beans soften into silky ribbons. The trick is salting the eggplant first to draw out moisture — without this step, the dish turns watery.
storyZh: 这道一锅炖是北方家庭的周末常客。茄子像海绵一样吸满咸香的酱油蒜味汤汁，豆角炖成绵软的丝条。秘诀是先给茄子撒盐脱水——这步不做，菜就会出水。

ingredients.nameEn: green beans (trimmed, broken into 5 cm lengths)
pork belly, sliced thin (optional, for flavor)

steps.text: Cut eggplant into 3 cm chunks. Sprinkle with 1/2 tsp salt, toss, and let sit 15 minutes. Rinse and squeeze dry — this removes bitterness and prevents oil splatter.
steps.textZh: 茄子切 3 厘米块，撒 1/2 茶匙盐拌匀，静置 15 分钟。冲洗后挤干水分——这一步去涩味、防炸锅。

stateNote.visual: Eggplant chunks release pale liquid; surface looks dull, not glossy
stateNote.visualZh: 茄子块渗出淡色液体；表面呈哑光，不反光
stateNote.signal: Eggplant feels slightly soft when pressed

steps.text: Heat oil in a heavy pot or Dutch oven over medium-high. Add pork belly slices and fry until edges crisp and fat renders — about 3 minutes.
steps.textZh: 锅中放油，中大火加热。下五花肉片煎至边缘微焦、油脂析出——约 3 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Pork turns translucent gold; pan fills with rendered fat
stateNote.visualZh: 猪肉变金黄透明；锅裡充满析出的油脂
stateNote.signal: Sizzle sound becomes gentler as moisture evaporates

steps.text: Add garlic, stir 10 seconds until fragrant. Add the drained eggplant and green beans. Toss to coat in oil.
steps.textZh: 下蒜片炒 10 秒出香。加入沥干的茄子和豆角，翻炒裹上油。

stateNote.visual: Garlic turns light golden at edges; eggplant begins to soften
stateNote.visualZh: 蒜片边缘微金黄；茄子开始变软
stateNote.signal: Garlic aroma fills the kitchen

steps.text: Pour in soy sauces, Shaoxing, sugar, and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce to medium-low. Cover and simmer 12 minutes.
steps.textZh: 倒入生抽、老抽、料酒、糖和水。大火烧开后转中火，盖盖焖 12 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Sauce is bubbling gently under the lid; eggplant is collapsing
stateNote.visualZh: 锅盖下汤汁微沸；茄子已经塌软
stateNote.signal: Bean stems look dull and slightly shriveled

steps.text: Uncover and stir gently — eggplant should be melting and beans tender. If liquid is thin, simmer uncovered 3 more minutes to reduce.
steps.textZh: 开盖轻搅——茄子应已融化，豆角绵软。汤汁若太稀，敞开再煮 3 分钟收浓。

stateNote.visual: Sauce coats the back of a spoon; eggplant breaks apart easily
stateNote.visualZh: 汤汁能挂勺；茄子轻轻一碰就散
stateNote.signal: Bubbles are slow and thick, not rapid and thin

steps.text: Taste and adjust salt if needed. Serve immediately over steamed rice.
steps.textZh: 尝味，按需补盐。配白米饭上桌。

stateNote.visual: Dish looks glossy and deeply colored; steam rises
stateNote.visualZh: 菜品油亮深褐；热气升腾
stateNote.signal: Ready when eggplant yields to gentle pressure

tips: Salting the eggplant is non-negotiable — skip it and your casserole will be watery and bitter.
Don't use wax eggplant (the shiny cylindrical type); Chinese eggplant (long, purplish, spongy) absorbs sauce best.
This dish tastes even better the next day — the flavors continue to meld in the fridge.
tipsZh: 茄子脱水这一步不能省——跳过这步，煲会出水发苦。
别用蜡质长茄（那种圆柱形、表皮发亮的）；中国茄子（长条形、紫黑、海绵质感）最吸汁。
这菜隔夜更入味——冰箱冷藏后风味继续融合。

titleEn: Ge Le Shan Lazi Chicken (歌乐山辣子鸡)
pinyin: gē lè shān là zǐ jī
versionNote: 源自重庆歌乐山农家，干辣椒堆里找鸡丁是这道菜的乐趣。
versionNoteZh: 源自重庆歌乐山农家，干辣椒堆里找鸡丁是这道菜的乐趣。
story: Ge Le Shan is a hill in Chongqing famous for its lazi chicken — a dish so loaded with dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns that finding the crispy chicken inside becomes a game. It's a street food staple and a beer-drinking favorite. This home version uses the same technique but with less oil (shallow-fried instead of deep-fried).
storyZh: 歌乐山是重庆的一座山，以辣子鸡闻名——这道菜干辣椒和花椒多到在辣椒堆里找鸡丁变成了一种游戏。它是街头小吃，也是啤酒绝配。家常版用同样的技法，但用油更少（半煎炸代替深炸）。

steps.text: Marinate chicken: mix with soy, Shaoxing, and a pinch of white pepper. Add cornstarch and toss until every cube is coated. Rest 20 minutes.
steps.textZh: 腌鸡丁：加生抽、料酒、少许白胡椒粉拌匀。加玉米淀粉，抓匀裹住。静置 20 分钟。

stateNote.visual: Chicken cubes are dull, coated in a thin matte film
stateNote.visualZh: 鸡丁呈哑光，表面裹着薄薄一层淀粉膜
stateNote.signal: Surface feels slightly tacky, not wet

steps.text: Heat oil to 170°C (medium-high). Fry chicken in 2 batches, 4-5 minutes per batch, until golden and crisp. Remove and drain on a rack.
steps.textZh: 油温 170°C（中大火）。鸡丁分两批炸，每批 4-5 分钟，至金黄酥脆。捞出沥油。

stateNote.visual: Oil bubbles vigorously around chicken; crust is deep golden and firm
stateNote.visualZh: 油泡剧烈；外壳深金黄、坚硬
stateNote.signal: Chicken floats and crust sounds crisp when tapped with chopsticks

steps.text: Pour out all but 2 tbsp oil. Lower heat to medium. Add Sichuan peppercorns and stir 15 seconds until fragrant.
steps.textZh: 倒出多余油，留 2 汤匙。转中火，下花椒炒 15 秒出香。

stateNote.visual: Peppercorns swell; oil takes on a faint citrusy aroma
stateNote.visualZh: 花椒微微膨胀；油带淡淡柑橘香
stateNote.signal: Numbing aroma rises — don't let it burn

steps.text: Add dried chilies, garlic, and ginger. Stir-fry 30 seconds until chilies darken to burgundy.
steps.textZh: 下干辣椒、蒜和姜片，翻炒 30 秒，辣椒变深红色。

stateNote.visual: Chilies turn deep burgundy; garlic edges just golden
stateNote.visualZh: 辣椒变深紫红色；蒜片边缘微金黄
stateNote.signal: Toasted chili and garlic aroma is intense

steps.text: Return all fried chicken to the wok. Toss on high heat for 1 minute so every piece gets coated in chili-peppercorn oil.
steps.textZh: 鸡丁全部回锅，大火翻炒 1 分钟，让每块都裹上辣椒花椒油。

stateNote.visual: Each chicken cube glistens red; chilies and peppercorns stick to the crust
stateNote.visualZh: 每块鸡丁泛红光；辣椒和花椒粒粘在脆壳上
stateNote.signal: Crust stays audible crisp — you hear the crunch as you toss

steps.text: Off heat, sprinkle sesame seeds and toss once. Serve on a platter — the fun is digging through the chilies to find the chicken.
steps.textZh: 关火，撒芝麻翻匀。装盘——乐趣就在于从辣椒堆里翻鸡丁。

stateNote.visual: Mound of dark red chilies studded with golden crispy chicken and white sesame
stateNote.visualZh: 深红辣椒堆里点缀着金黄酥脆鸡丁和白芝麻
stateNote.signal: Serve immediately — the crust softens within 10 minutes

tips: Two frying batches is essential — crowding drops oil temp and makes chicken greasy.
Snip the chilies open and shake out the seeds for less raw heat; keep them in for more kick.
This dish is best eaten with your hands — grab a handful of chilies, find the chicken, eat.
tipsZh: 分两批炸是必须的——一锅倒油温下降，鸡丁会吸油变腻。
剪开干辣椒抖掉籽，辣度降低；保留籽更辣。
这道菜用手抓着吃最过瘾——抓一把辣椒，找鸡丁，吃。

versionNote: 藤椒是四川特有的清香麻味花椒，比干花椒更清新，适合快手菜。
versionNoteZh: 藤椒是四川特有的清香麻味花椒，比干花椒更清新，适合快手菜。
story: Tengjiao (藤椒) is the fresh green Sichuan peppercorn picked in summer — it has a bright, citrusy, almost herbaceous numbing quality unlike dried peppercorns. Tengjiao chicken is a refreshing take on Sichuan chicken: poached until tender, then tossed in a bright green, numbing sauce. It's often served cold as an appetizer.
storyZh: 藤椒是夏季采摘的新鲜青花椒——它有明亮的柑橘清香和草本感的麻味，不同于干花椒。藤椒鸡是川菜里一道清爽的鸡肉做法：白煮至嫩，再拌入翠绿微麻的酱汁。常作为凉菜上桌。

ingredients.nameEn: fresh green Sichuan peppercorns (tengjiao) or frozen

steps.text: Poach chicken: place thighs in a pot, cover with water, add 1/2 tsp salt and 2 scallion segments. Bring to a boil, then reduce to low. Cover and cook 12 minutes. Remove and plunge into ice water.
steps.textZh: 白煮鸡：鸡腿入锅，加水没过，放 1/2 茶匙盐和 2 段葱白。大火烧开转小火，盖盖煮 12 分钟。捞出浸入冰水。

stateNote.visual: Water is at a gentle simmer (small bubbles); chicken is opaque through the thickest part
stateNote.visualZh: 水微沸（小气泡）；鸡肉最厚处呈不透明白色
stateNote.signal: Juices run clear when thickest part is pierced with a skewer

steps.text: Make the sauce: mix soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, sesame oil, minced garlic, and sliced scallions in a bowl. Taste — it should be salty, slightly sweet, with a bright vinegar note.
steps.textZh: 调酱汁：生抽、香醋、糖、香油、蒜末、葱丝搅匀。尝味——应咸中带甜、醋香鲜明。

stateNote.visual: Sauce is emulsified and glossy; sugar is fully dissolved
stateNote.visualZh: 酱汁乳化有光泽；糖已完全溶解
stateNote.signal: Balance: salty front, sweet middle, vinegar snap at the end

steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a small pan over medium. Add fresh tengjiao (or frozen) and fry 10 seconds until fragrant. Pour over the sauce.
steps.textZh: 小锅放 1 汤匙油，中火加热。下新鲜藤椒（或冷冻）炒 10 秒出香，倒入酱汁。

stateNote.visual: Peppercorns swell and release a bright green oil; aroma is citrusy and numbing
stateNote.visualZh: 花椒膨胀，释放翠绿色油；香气是柑橘清香带麻感
stateNote.signal: Lips tingle slightly when you waft the aroma toward you

steps.text: Remove chicken from ice water, pat dry, and cut into bite-size strips. Toss with the sauce until evenly coated.
steps.textZh: 鸡腿从冰水捞出，擦干，切条。倒入酱汁，拌匀。

stateNote.visual: Chicken strips are coated in glossy green sauce with visible tengjiao bits
stateNote.visualZh: 鸡条裹满翠绿色酱汁，可见藤椒碎粒
stateNote.signal: Each strip is uniformly green; no dry patches

steps.text: Let rest 10 minutes for flavors to penetrate. Serve at room temperature or chilled.
steps.textZh: 静置 10 分钟让味道渗入。室温或冷藏后上桌。

stateNote.visual: Sauce thickens slightly as it coats; chicken absorbs the green tint
stateNote.visualZh: 酱汁略浓稠，鸡肉染上绿色
stateNote.signal: Chicken is cool to the touch but not ice-cold

tips: Fresh tengjiao is hard to find outside China — frozen is available at Asian markets. If unavailable, use 1 tbsp dried green Sichuan peppercorns toasted and ground.
Don't overcook the chicken — 12 minutes is enough for 2-inch thighs. Overcooked chicken is dry no matter how good the sauce.
This is best served at room temperature or slightly chilled — not hot. The numbing sensation is more refreshing this way.
tipsZh: 新鲜藤椒在中国以外难买到——亚超有卖冷冻的。实在没有，用 1 汤匙干青花椒碾碎煸香代替。
鸡肉别煮过头——2 英寸厚的鸡腿 12 分钟刚好。煮老了再好的酱汁也救不回来。
这道菜适合室温或微凉吃——不是热的。麻味在凉的时候更清爽。
